title: WIND TECHNICIAN II
description:
EDP Renewables is a global leader in the renewable energy sector and the fourth-largest wind energy producer. With a sound development pipeline, first-class assets, and market-leading operating capacity, EDPR has undergone exceptional development in recent years and is currently present in 28 markets.

Our company is part of EDP, a global energy group present in around 30 markets with a particular emphasis on renewable energies. With more than 45 years of experience, we have been consolidating a relevant presence on the world energy scene based on the commitment to be all-green by 2030, leading the energy transition. With more than 13,000 employees around the world, we are committed to using our energy and heart to drive a better tomorrow.

What you will do

Role Overview:

Intermediate level position, the Wind Technician II is an integral member of the Wind farm with the responsibility of on-site operations, maintenance, repairs, and replacement of equipment at one of EDPR NA’s operating wind energy generation sites. Tasks include but are not limited to completing Lock-Out-Tag-Out (LOTO), Tail Board, and documentation that is necessary to support wind turbine maintenance safely. This team member will also conduct inspections of equipment, tools, and facilities for compliance with EDPR policies, governmental safety guidelines, and environmental regulations. The ideal candidate is experienced in renewable energy or related industry and is prepared to further their career as part of a global leader in the renewable energy sector.

Main responsibilities:

  • Ensure proper operation and maintenance of wind turbines and associated wind plant equipment, including substation and tower switchgear
  • Proactively look for improvement opportunities to job appropriate processes and procedures
  • Communicate through appropriate channels or implement improvements using the appropriate control management protocol
  • Seek assistance when encountering turbine issues outside the trained skill level to ensure success in resolution
  • Comply with all pertinent environmental health and safety programs and act as a safety role model
  • Demonstrate and promote integrity and strong initiative
  • Perform data collection and prepare reports in order to meet reporting requirements
  • Work with and respond to EDPRs Remote Operations Control Center when necessary to coordinate remote operations
  • Perform QA/QC inspections in accordance with applicable SOP
  • Facilitate periodic equipment inspections and reporting
  • Document all work performed using computer-based service reporting procedures
  • Complete all required training in a satisfactory manner and timeframe
  • Adhere to internal controls in effect
  • Additional duties as required

Employment type

Full-Time

Work site

Onsite - Meadow Lake Wind Farm - Chalmers, IN

What are we looking for

Minimum Requirements:

  • Must possess a valid driver’s license and be able to operate a motor vehicle.
  • 1+ years of college or technical school education, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
  • 2 – 5 years of relevant experience in wind energy or a related industry.
  • Proficient knowledge of MS Office software, SQL server software, facility management and reporting systems, and computerized diagnostics and troubleshooting tools
  • Familiarity with maintenance and electronic testing equipment (e.g., voltage testers, amp clamps, oscilloscopes, megohmmeters, infrared testers, hydraulic torque equipment, alignment tools, various hand and power tools, and heavy equipment required for facility maintenance)
  • Working knowledge of crane and rigging requirements
  • Understanding of Microsoft products and/or complementing products (preferred)
  • Competency in Analytical Problem Solving, Strong Communication, Customer/Partner Relationships, and Technology Expertise (preferred)
  • Experience with power plant operations and maintenance, wind plant operations and turbines (including turbine power converters specifically), high voltage switching, and post-operational repair and maintenance of turbines (preferred)

Travel:

Up to 10%

Behavioral Requirements:

  • Able to effectively collaborate with employees at all professional levels and ability to respectfully follow supervision and support initiatives.
  • Basic computer operation skills, familiarity with internet-based program navigation, and ability to generate and interpret computer data.
  • Ability to read, interpret and understand drawings and schematics to validate work activity and ensure that risks are identified and mitigated.

Physical demands & working conditions:

  • Sitting/Standing/Flexibility: Ability to frequently perform physical tasks including standing, sitting, walking, kneeling, bending, twisting, squatting, and reaching approximately 75% of the time while on wind farm sites; ability to stand and sit for 8 or more hours when in an office environment
  • Walking: Ability to walk .25 to .5 miles per day, including across unpaved and rough surfaces when on wind farm sites
  • Speech/Reading: Ability to speak, read, and write English proficiently and deliver a variety of instructions furnished in written, verbal, diagram, or scheduled form
  • Lifting: Ability to frequently lift items weighing up to 50 pounds
  • Climbing:
  • Ability to climb turbine towers in excess of 100 meters in height to access the work area
  • Weight must be between 125 lbs. and 275 lbs., excluding equipment/gear worn when performing job-related tasks, to be in accordance with the ANSI Fall Protection Standards.
  • Vision/Hearing: Ability to interpret and follow a variety of instructions furnished in written, verbal, diagram, or schedule form
  • Tolerance to Extreme Weather Conditions: Ability to work in adverse weather conditions 25% of the time while on wind farm sites
  • Safety: Ability to understand and communicate safety precautions when necessary

More than academic knowledge and technical skills, we are looking for ambitious people who are enthusiastic about the future and who bring human skills aligned with our purpose.

Equal opportunities for all
Our vision is that each person combines their unique characteristics and experiences to fulfill our mission of creating new energy for the planet. We are an inclusive employer, ensuring all candidates are treated fairly throughout the recruitment process. We welcome and value all people, and we are committed to fostering a sense of belonging for each person who is part of the EDP group.

Need more reasons to apply?
As a top employer we:
Empower our employees through a positive and innovative work environment that promotes collaboration and agile decision-making;
Respect and value each person, providing a flexible, healthy, and inclusive workplace with a range of attractive benefits;
Provide a meaningful work experience and prepare our people for future challenges through different opportunities for development and internal mobility;

Our efforts have resulted in several distinctions over time, highlighting the EDP group's strong positioning and its dedication and commitment to attracting and retaining the best talent:
Top employer certification by Top Employers Institute
Part of the Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index
Global certification as a family-responsible company by Fundación Másfamília
Top 100 Workplaces by Houston Chronicle

Discover our tips to enhance your performance during the recruitment process and apply until Month Day, Year, if you think you are the right fit for this opportunity.

title: Guest Experience Expert
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About Us

Great Deals E-Commerce Corporation is a leading player in the e-commerce industry, dedicated to providing exceptional service and innovative solutions to our customers. We are driven by a passion for excellence, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

As we continue to strengthen and elevate our brand presence, we are looking for a creative and talented Graphic Designer to join our team!

This role plays a vital part in bringing our brand to life through visually compelling designs, engaging digital creatives, and impactful visual content across our marketing and social media platforms. If you have a strong eye for design, a passion for creativity, and the skills to transform ideas into captivating visuals, we’d love to have you on our team!

Job Summary

The Graphic Designer is responsible for creating visual concepts using computer software such as Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator to communicate ideas that inspire, inform, or captivate consumers. He/She will develop the overall layout and graphic design for various E-Commerce platforms, advertisements, and social media channels.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Create visually appealing concepts using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and other design software.
  • Develop unique and innovative designs that communicate ideas effectively and captivate the target audience.
  • Design and produce various marketing materials, including advertisements, banners, social media graphics, and promotional content.
  • Ensure all designs are consistent with brand guidelines and meet the company's visual standards.
  • Develop the overall layout and graphic design for different E-Commerce platforms, ensuring a user-friendly and aesthetically pleasing experience.
  • Collaborate with the web development team to implement design elements on websites and other digital platforms
  • Work closely with the marketing team, copywriters, and other designers to develop cohesive and effective marketing materials.
  • Participate in brainstorming sessions to generate new ideas and creative solutions.
  • Other tasks that may be assigned from time to time.
Key Qualification and Specification:
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Film Production, Art/Design/Creative Multimedia, Information Technology or equivalent or a related field.
  • Preferably with experience in Graphic Design Digital Layout

  • Maintains a thorough understanding of company rules and regulations, and consistently adheres to them in all work activities.

title: High Voltage Network Specialist-1
description:
He kōrero mō mātou | About Watercare


Ki te ora te wai, ka ora te whenua, ka ora te tangata

When the water is healthy, the land and the people are healthy


There's never been a better time to join Watercare. We're delivering a $15.2 billion, 10-year capital investment programme, the largest in our history, creating opportunities to work on transformative infrastructure, sustainability and digital projects that will shape Auckland's future. With more than $4 million invested every day, you'll be part of work that makes a lasting difference to our communities and environment.


Reporting to the High Voltage Lead, the High Voltage (HV) Network Specialist is responsible for

the safe, compliant, and effective delivery of high-voltage operations across a defined region,

translating network-level plans into executable work and ensuring delivery aligns with safety,

operational, and performance requirements.

Provides regional planning and coordination, including developing and adjusting switching

schedules, sequencing work, and defining how work is executed in practice across sites.

This is a mobile, region-wide role, operating across the Auckland network and wider operational

footprint (Warkworth to Waikato). The HV Network Specialist travels between sites as required,

responding to planned works, unplanned faults, outages, and after-hours events, and acts as the

on-site operational authority where HV risks are present.

Acting as the on-site HV authority, the role provides operational oversight of works, approves

commencement of activities, supervises execution, and adapts plans in real time to manage site

conditions, risks, and operational constraints.

The combination of remote operational complexity, permit authority, multi-party coordination,

and the need for risk-based decisions beyond standard procedures elevates the role beyond

coordination into one of enhanced operational authority and technical judgement, while

remaining aligned with the HV Lead’s overall system ownership.

Ngā hua mōu | What's in it for you

We offer a competitive salary and staff benefits package including:
• Training and development opportunities
• Life and income protection insurance plans
• Generous parental leave
• Employee discounts at a range of large retailers

Me pēhea te tono mai | How to Apply

Come and join our team! If you are looking for an exciting career opportunity with a fantastic team then please apply online today - careers.watercare.co.nz.

title: Expressions of Interest - Class 5 Drivers
description:
Expression of Interest for 2027 – Class 5 Truck Driver Opportunities.


Mō te tūranga | About the role


We’re building our pipeline for potential civil truck driver opportunities across Fulton Hogan in 2027. If you’re an experienced driver with hands-on cartage, civil, roading or construction site experience, know how to keep standards high, and get good work done safely, we’d like to hear from you.


Based in Auckland, these opportunities will support the movement of aggregate, asphalt and other roading materials between quarries, plants, yards and major project sites. It’s hands-on, high-responsibility work that plays a real part in delivering Good Work for our customers and communities.


There’s more to this work than getting from A to B. You’ll be a key part of the wider operation, managing load security, timing, site access, compliance and vehicle care while helping keep things running smoothly. We’re after people who know truck driving, understand the pace of civil and roading work, and can switch on when it counts.


Ngā tino kawenga mahi | Key role responsibilities

  • Transport aggregate, asphalt and other roading materials safely and efficiently between Fulton Hogan quarries, plants, yards and project sites.
  • Complete cartage runs to delivery timeframes, helping crews and plants stay supplied and ready to go.
  • Load, cart and tip product safely, including working in quarry, plant and active construction environments.
  • Carry out daily vehicle condition checks, maintain logbooks, and keep your truck tidy, roadworthy and well cared for.
  • Build strong working relationships with dispatchers, site crews, plant teams and others across the business.

Kei te kimi mātou i tētahi e whai ana i ēnei pūkenga | We’re looking for someone with

  • A current Class 5 New Zealand driver licence.
  • Proven experience in general cartage, tipping and transport driving, ideally in civil construction, roading or a similar environment.
  • Experience delivering to asphalt, paving or construction sites, with a solid understanding of site safety and live operational environments.
  • A strong working knowledge of NZ Transport Regulations, logbook requirements and heavy vehicle compliance.
  • A proactive, team-focused approach and a strong commitment to safety, vehicle care and doing the job right.
  • Flexibility to work night shift as required.

He pai te mahi, he pai ngā painga | Good work, good benefits


At Fulton Hogan, we genuinely care about the wellbeing of our people and giving them the tools and opportunities they need to succeed and grow with us. You’ll have access to:

  • Medical insurance and Life insurance after the eligibility period.
  • KiwiSaver employer contributions after service milestones, up to 7%.
  • Parental leave top up payment with additional return to work support.
  • Ongoing training and development, with clear career growth and progression opportunities.
  • Great discounts at a wide range of retailers.

Ko wai mātou | About us


Fulton Hogan is an integrated infrastructure, construction and services business working across New Zealand and Australia. We partner with clients and communities to design, build, operate and maintain critical assets, from bitumen and quarries to roads, water and energy.


Around here, Good Work is about high expectations, low ego, and people who back each other to get the job done. We’re flat, friendly and forward moving. We take the work seriously, not ourselves, and we’re always looking for better ways to deliver for our customers and communities.


Me pēhea te tono | How to apply


If you’re keen to register your interest for Class 5 Truck Driver opportunities in 2027, apply now.


All successful candidates must undergo and pass a pre-employment medical and drug screen prior to employment.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
• You will build technology solutions for Global Markets
  • We are a team of big thinkers who are engineering the future of banking
  • Together we will build tomorrow’s bank today, using world-leading technology and innovation



Do work that matters

We're building tomorrow’s bank today, which means we need creative and diverse engineers to help us redefine what customers expect from a bank. Envisioning new technologies that are still waiting to be invented and reimagining products that support our customers and help build a brighter future for Australia.

Here, you will be empowered to deliver world-class, competitive banking products and services with unparalleled levels of service and reliability.



See yourself in our team

Join CommBank’s Institutional Banking & Markets Technology team, where we combine next-generation technology with leading banking and markets capabilities to help our clients succeed.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll work on Beacon, IBM’s strategic quantitative platform supporting Trading, Sales, Market Risk and Quant teams across Global Markets. You’ll use your strong Python engineering expertise to build scalable, resilient solutions for quantitative and trading workflows.

You’ll take ownership of complex features and services from design through to production, contribute to architecture and technical design decisions, and mentor other engineers. You’ll also help improve reliability, automation, observability and developer productivity across the team.



We are interested in hearing from people who

  • Bring strong Python engineering and system design skills, with experience building production-grade software.
  • Understand Financial Markets, particularly trading and derivatives.
  • Have experience working with Quant teams or in quantitative trading environments.
  • Solve complex technical and business problems with strong engineering judgement.
  • Collaborate effectively with Quants, Trading, Product, Architecture and engineering teams.
  • Contribute to engineering standards, code quality, mentoring and continuous improvement.



Tech Skills

We use a broad range of tools, languages, and frameworks. We do not expect you to know them all but experience or exposure with some of these, or a willing to learn these skillsets (or equivalents) will set you up for success in this team!

  • Certified AWS Solution Architect or Software Engineer
  • Hands-on Python software engineering, building scalable and maintainable production systems.
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals, including system design, clean code and automated testing.
  • Good understanding of Financial Markets, particularly trading and derivatives.
  • Background working with Quant teams or in quantitative trading environments.
  • Designing scalable applications, APIs and distributed or data-intensive systems.
  • Working knowledge of AWS, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and observability, using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins and Terraform.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of FX products, particularly currency swaps.
  • Exposure to pricing, risk, trading or quantitative platforms.



Working with us

Whether you’re passionate about customer service, driven by data, or called by creativity, a career with CommBank is for you.

We support our people with the flexibility to balance where work is done with at least half your time each month connecting in our Sydney office. We also have many other flexible working options available including changing start and finish times, part-time arrangements and job share to name a few. Talk to us about how these arrangements might work for you.

Here, you’ll thrive. You’ll be supported when faced with challenges and empowered to tackle new opportunities. We’re hiring engineers from across Australia and have opened technology hubs in Melbourne and Perth. We really love working here, and we think you will too.

If this sounds like you, apply now!

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

title: General Ledger Clerk
description:
Full time

As we continue to expand our European operations, we are creating new positions in Portugal to support our teams, and we are looking for a General Ledger Clerk.

We offer an international, collaborative environment built on trust, ownership, and long‑term development. This role provides meaningful exposure to fund accounting, interaction with cross‑border stakeholders, and the opportunity to support a growing platform and help build scalable processes from the ground up.

Join a leading asset manager and be part of a team where your contribution truly matters and where you can continue to grow professionally.

Responsibilities

  • Support General Ledger and Fixed Asset accounting activities, ensuring accurate postings, reconciliations, and compliance with IFRS, local GAAP, and company standards.
  • Process daily journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and other G/L adjustments while assisting with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closings.
  • Perform balance sheet and intercompany reconciliations, investigating and resolving discrepancies with relevant stakeholders.
  • Maintain fixed asset records, including capitalization, depreciation, transfers, disposals, and support physical asset verification processes.
  • Prepare audit documentation, support internal and external audits, and ensure proper filing and retention of accounting records.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (AP, AR, Divisional Accounting, and MDM) to improve data accuracy, resolve issues, and drive process improvements and automation

Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Experience in Accounting, preferably with exposure to General Ledger and Fixed Asset processes.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial processes.
  • Proficiency in managing accounting records, reconciliations, and financial data accurately.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken, for working in an international environment.
  • Fluent French communication skills, both written and spoken, for working in an international environment.

Only direct applications will be considered for this vacancy and we do not accept dossiers from recruitment agencies.

title: Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist
description:
About Turing
Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview
We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented Illustrator / Sketcher / Cartoonist with strong visual storytelling skills and the ability to work across a wide range of artistic styles. This opportunity is open to interns, freshers, and experienced artists who can create high-quality visual content, adapt to different creative directions, and accurately reproduce diverse illustration styles.

The ideal candidate will have a strong portfolio demonstrating artistic versatility, solid visual fundamentals, attention to detail, and the ability to incorporate feedback effectively.

Key Responsibilities
  • Create high-quality, stylized illustrations based on provided briefs, references, and creative requirements.
  • Adapt to and accurately replicate a variety of illustration, sketching, and artistic styles.
  • Produce multiple variations of artwork while maintaining consistency in composition, characters, and visual elements.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in composition, color, lighting, texture, perspective, and visual storytelling.
  • Create and render characters, environments, objects, and complete scenes as required.
  • Ensure final artwork is polished, visually consistent, production-ready, and aligned with project requirements.
  • Clearly document prompts, creative decisions, style choices, and relevant metadata when required.
  • Collaborate with team members, incorporate feedback, and make revisions efficiently.
  • Manage assigned tasks effectively while maintaining high standards of quality and attention to detail.

Style Expertise
  • Sketch & Drawing
  • Cinematic & Film Noir
  • Steampunk
  • Surreal / Dreamlike / Psychedelic Cyberpunk & Sci-Fi
  • Art Deco & Art Nouveau
  • Vintage & Retro Glitch & Vaporwave

Tools
  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Procreate
  • Adobe Illustrator (for vector illustration, if required)
  • Affinity Suite
  • Clip Studio Paint

Requirements
  • No minimum professional experience required. Interns, freshers, emerging artists, and experienced professionals are welcome to apply.
  • Background or demonstrated skills as an Illustrator, Sketch Artist, Cartoonist, Digital Artist, Concept Artist, or in a similar creative role.
  • A detailed portfolio is required and should demonstrate artistic ability and versatility across different styles.
  • Strong understanding of composition, color, lighting, perspective, and visual balance.
  • Ability to illustrate and render characters, scenes, objects, and/or environments.
  • Ability to understand references and accurately adapt or replicate different artistic styles.

Dr Kerrie Clarke, Principal Psychology Educator

kerrie.clarke@mercy.com.au


Where there’s life, there’s Mercy.

Where there’s care, there’s You.


Through the battles and the breakthroughs, we're there. Where will you be?


For over a century, our incredible teams have provided care for people when they need it most. Our people feel great pride in this, and they value the security and stability we offer. But it also means so much opportunity - to build on all that’s gone before, to grow your impact and gain experience that’s hard to find elsewhere.


As a for-purpose organisation with over 10,000 dedicated, compassionate people, we continue to offer more services and deeper care than ever before. With Mercy, you’ll have the chance to make an impact and gain experience that’s hard to find elsewhere.


At Mercy Health, it’s all about taking what we have and making it better.

To do that, we need you.

Join us at Mercy Health, and help our teams deliver even greater outcomes.


About the opportunity

Mercy Mental Health and Wellbeing Service (South West Area Mental Health Service) is a public mental health service supporting people in south-west metropolitan Melbourne with severe and complex mental illnesses by providing acute and community-based care. Services are available to adults through acute inpatient programs, residential rehabilitation programs and crisis and community recovery-focused treatment programs. We also deliver inpatient and community specialist perinatal mental health services to women and infants in western Victoria.


The Psychology Registrar Program at Mercy Mental Health and Wellbeing Service is a two-year training program that offers a diverse range of experiences for new graduate psychologists entering the workforce. You will benefit from the unique opportunity to immerse yourself in recovery-oriented, discipline-specific psychological practice in a public mental health setting in a supportive learning environment. The position is full time (including ADO) for a fixed term of 2 years, commencing February 2027.

The Registrar Program offers:


  • Diverse and comprehensive skill-building rotations across our adult inpatient, community and rehabilitative services, and our specialist perinatal inpatient / outpatient services.
  • The opportunity to develop a thorough understanding of the consumer journey through mental health services.
  • Opportunities to build competence and confidence as a psychologist within an enthusiastic and nurturing multidisciplinary team environment.
  • Reduced caseload to give time to focus on learning and development.
  • Ample opportunities to fulfil all the requirements of a Clinical Psychology Registrar program and subsequent endorsement as a Clinical Psychologist.
  • Regular supervision, opportunities for paid leave for professional development, protected learning time, and peer consultation and support from other psychology registrars and psychologists working at MMH&WS.

Key responsibilities:


  • Knowledge of the discipline and understanding of case formulation in planning evidence-based treatment.
  • Provision of specialist psychological assessments, interventions, individual and group therapy, with a focus on recovery, person-centred care, and effective outcomes for adult consumers and their families.
  • Participation in individual and group supervision, and active commitment to professional development as per the requirements of the Psychology Board of Australia Psychology Registrar Program.
  • Active participation in multidisciplinary team meetings and contribution to formulation, diagnosis and treatment planning.
  • Promote a psychologically safe work environment and contribute to service improvement initiatives
  • Work within scope of practice, prioritise safety, wellbeing, and professional growth

Please be aware that we intend to commence interviewing and recruitment prior to the advertisement closing date. It is possible that the advertisement may close early. We recommend submitting your application at your earliest convenience.

Please also be aware that this position commences at Mercy Mental Health and Wellbeing Service on Monday 8th February 2027.


What you’ll bring

You’re resilient, compassionate and have a whole lot of heart. Most importantly, you are committed to delivering exceptional consumer-centred care.


To thrive in this role, you will have:


  • A minimum of a Master's Degree in Clinical Psychology in an APAC accredited postgraduate course.
  • Registration with AHPRA as a Psychologist with eligibility to enter a Registrar Program for Area of Practice endorsement in Clinical Psychology. We will accept applicants that expect to obtain general registration by the end of January 2027.
  • Commitment to working within a recovery-oriented framework, with a compassionate, flexible and positive approach to effective consumer care.
  • Excellent clinical, organisational, interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to adapt and problem solve.
  • A compassionate, flexible and positive approach to effective consumer care and management.
  • The ability to nurture friendly, respectful relationships and contribute to a collaborative team environment.

You will also be required to provide evidence of, or in the process of obtaining:


  • A current Police Record Check and Working with Children Check.
  • Proof of current influenza vaccination and other vaccination status consistent with public health orders.

Ready to help us shape the future of healthcare?


Join us and make a meaningful difference in people’s lives - and your career.

title: Regulatory Group Director, International/APAC
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Regulatory Group Director, International/APAC

Position Summary

This position leads a PTR team, in the APAC region, responsible for management of regulatory CMC submissions for all Roche products. The team shall develop and implement robust end to end strategies of the local filings based on global development plan, global/regional/local business priorities, local regulatory requirements and landscape to accelerate drug access to the patients by ensuring right first-time submissions to Health Authorities.


Your opportunity


People Management

  • Recruit, onboard, train, develop and retain talent on the PTR International team. Ensure appropriate Regulatory Affairs resources and budgets are in place.
  • Lead a team of professionals responsible for regional/local management of regulatory submissions with diversified local regulatory requirements and business priorities. Regulatory submissions in scope include new drug registrations (NDA/BLA), line extensions (LE), post-approval submissions/variations (PAS), renewals and annual reports, for pharmaceutical small molecules and biological products.

Regulatory Submissions

  • Drive acceleration of the innovative products registration and ensure continuous supply of the compliant products to the patients through establishing a network and relationship with DRA Affiliates, Agents and Distributors, if applicable.
  • With your team, develop and maintain up-to-date regulatory knowledge repository including local regulations and other governing regulatory practices, policies, procedures, processes, systems and standards. Facilitate and promote timely updates and maintenance of CMC change management in alignment with the regulatory information submitted to / approved by externally Health Authority or internally by the appropriate functional area.
  • In cooperation with global PTR Technical Regulatory Leaders and Technical Regulatory Teams, lead, influence and contribute to innovative regulatory strategies utilizing country requirements knowledge, understanding of the local regulatory challenges and opportunities, and applying risk based principles to balance regulatory compliance and business/supply needs to maximize efficiency, quality and rate of submission approvals by Health Authorities.
  • Provide global and regional Regulatory Affairs input and guidance into local Affiliate business strategies (e.g. drug portfolio shaping, market access, medical affairs, technical assessments, technical agreements, local manufacturing/packaging activities, etc.)
  • In coordination with Affiliates DRA, act as direct liaison and CMC contact SME with regulatory authorities to facilitate the prompt review and approval of submissions.

Stakeholders Management

  • Collaborate with Regional Commercial, Medical Affairs, Supply Chain, Pharma Development Regulatory on strategic regional priorities aligned with the global business objectives.
  • To build, maintain and promote the partnership with the regional and local commercial organizations to further accelerate regulatory approvals and secure continuous availability of the innovative products to the patients.
  • To partnership with PDR ERAS counterpart to provide one unified regulatory voice toward affiliates, PTR/PDR management and regional functions for regulatory topics relating to International Markets and to ensure aligned strategic regulatory contribution to the key initiatives/projects for the region.
  • Sponsor, lead and contribute to global and regional projects and initiatives involving International Markets aimed to accelerate launches of the Roche products and to ensure availability of regulatory compliant products to the patients.

Who you are


Education

  • PhD/MC degree in science or related area is required.

Experience

  • At least 15 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, line management experience is an asset.
  • Industry recognized leader in the Regulatory Affairs / CMC field with significant experience in International Markets.
  • Strong proven experience in Regulatory Affairs, CMC requirements for small molecule/biologic products, development, manufacturing and/or quality assurance.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

  • Demonstrates, or has proven abilities to demonstrate PTR and Roche Core Competencies.
  • Ability to demonstrate Roche Values and Leadership Commitments.
  • Demonstrates effective problem solving, strong understanding of regulatory strategies, excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
  • Proven ability to lead successful negotiations with the internal and external stakeholders including Governance Bodies and consistently demonstrates efficient influential skills.
  • Proven ability to influence and work both independently and collaboratively in a team structure. • Strong team work ethics and experience to motivate team members.
  • Ability to work across various time zones.
  • Very high level of professionalism, efficiency, and follow-through.
  • Ideally fluent in 1-2 languages spoken in the region of responsibility, in addition to English.

Travel requirement

  • Ability to travel up to 20 %

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Dit ga je doen

Binnen het NCSC zijn we op zoek naar drie scrum masters die klaar zijn om een nieuwe uitdaging aan te gaan en te werken in een dynamische omgeving met multidisciplinaire resultaatteams binnen het cybersecuritydomein. Vanuit jouw thuisbasis zet je jouw expertise organisatiebreed in. Van het begeleiden van doorgewinterde DevOps teams tot het kickstarten van compleet nieuwe teams die de agile way-of-working aan het omarmen zijn. Daarnaast werk je samen met bevlogen interne en externe collega’s aan continue verbetering en innovatie binnen de organisatie.

Het NCSC bevindt zich in een belangrijke transitie naar het ‘nieuwe werken’. Hierbij wordt de organisatie ingericht rondom directies, waardestromen en resultaatteams, met als doel sneller waarde te leveren, beter samen te werken en wendbaarder te zijn. De focus ligt op flexibiliteit, samenwerking en maximale waardecreatie. Competentiegericht werken en kennisdeling binnen de Community of Practice (CoP) Agile staan hierbij centraal. De inzet van scrum masters is flexibel en afgestemd op de behoeften en de ontwikkelfase van resultaatteams. Zo maak jij het verschil waar dat het meest nodig is.

Je hebt de motivatie om mensen en teams grote stappen te laten maken. Je gebruikt de ruimte en het vertrouwen die je in deze rol krijgt om teams naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je speelt een sleutelrol in het begeleiden van teams in hun Agile volwassenheid, stimuleert eigenaarschap en samenwerking en neemt het voortouw in verandering. Jij weet als geen ander wat teams nodig hebben om te groeien en zet dat om in concrete verbeteringen met zichtbaar resultaat.

Een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Organiseren, faciliteren en begeleiden van Agile ceremonies;
  • Ondersteunen en coachen van teamleden op het gebied van zelfontwikkeling, samenwerking en resultaatgericht werken;
  • Stimuleren van Agile gedrag, proactief signaleren en aanpakken van structurele belemmeringen;
  • Samen met de product owner epics uitwerken tot heldere user stories die binnen sprints uitgevoerd kunnen worden volgens de Definition of Done;
  • Een actieve bijdrage leveren aan de organisatie van teamoverstijgende evenementen zoals System Demo’s en PI-planningsdagen;
  • Samenwerken en kennis delen met collega’s binnen de Agile Community of Practice (CoP).

Dit bieden we nog meer

Naast het salaris ontvang je een individueel keuzebudget (IKB). Het IKB bestaat uit geld (16,5% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en tijd. Met het IKB maak jij de keuzes die bij jou passen en kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Je kunt er bijvoorbeeld voor kiezen om een deel van je maandinkomen te laten uitbetalen wanneer jij dat wenst. Ook kun je dit budget omzetten in verlof en andersom of besteden aan fiscaalvriendelijke doelen. De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer verschillende studiefaciliteiten, bedrijfsfitness, volledige vergoeding van je ov-reiskosten woon-werkverkeer en gedeeltelijk betaald ouderschapsverlof.

Dit vragen wij

Je bent een gedreven scrum master met een passie voor Agile methodologieën en het begeleiden van teams naar succes. Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het faciliteren van Scrum processen en het optimaliseren van teamdynamiek. Met jouw sterke communicatieve vaardigheden weet je een omgeving te creëren waarin teamleden open kunnen communiceren en effectief kunnen samenwerken. Je bent proactief, oplossingsgericht en hebt een scherp oog voor het identificeren en wegnemen van obstakels die het team in de weg staan. Bovendien ben je continu op zoek naar manieren om processen te verbeteren en heb je een goed begrip van zowel de technische als de businesskant van de te ontwikkelen producten en diensten.

Verder beschik je over:

  • hbo-werk- en -denkniveau;
  • ruime aantoonbare ervaring als scrum master;
  • een Scrum Master certificering (PSM I en/of PSM II);
  • ervaring met de ontwikkeling en doorontwikkeling van scrumteams;
  • goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels in woord en geschrift.

Hier kom je te werken

Over Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum

Het NCSC werkt aan een digitaal veilig Nederland. Door het tempo waarin het cybersecuritydomein zich ontwikkelt en de rol van het NCSC daarin, ligt er een flinke uitdaging voor de toekomst. Het is voor ons als hét kennisinstituut van cybersecurity in Nederland essentieel dat wij Nederland van kwalitatief hoogwaardige en actuele informatie voorzien, in crisistijd en daarbuiten. Deze kennis en kunde halen wij mede uit en delen wij ook weer met ons netwerk (overheden, bedrijfsleven en andere nationale en internationale partners). Op deze wijze proberen we tijdig in te springen op nieuw ontdekte kwetsbaarheden, aanvalscampagnes en ernstige ICT-verstoringen om deze te voorkomen en op te lossen. Als het toch misgaat beperken we op deze manier de impact.

Bijzonderheden

Het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum (NCSC) is een groeiende organisatie in transitie met uiteenlopende vraagstukken waarbij flexibiliteit gewenst is om ook in de toekomst wendbaar te blijven tegen cyberdreigingen. Interesse? Graag ontvangen wij jouw cv en motivatie als word- of pdf-bestand via onderstaande sollicitatiebutton. Werken bij een crisisorganisatie vraagt om flexibiliteit van onze medewerkers. Via een piket- en-of bereikbaarheid dienst (bepaalde functie) kan er in het geval van acute dreigingen en incidenten, ook buiten kantooruren een beroep op je worden gedaan. Als we goede sollicitaties binnenkrijgen kan het zijn dat we de sluitingstermijn niet afwachten. Heb je interesse, reageer dan snel!

Wat mag je van ons verwachten? Wanneer we een match zien nemen we contact met je op om een eerste sollicitatiegesprek in te plannen. De sollicitatieprocedure bestaat uit twee sollicitatiegesprekken gevolgd door een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek. Een casus, opdracht, assessment en/of vaardigheidstest kan deel uitmaken van het sollicitatieproces, net als het opvragen van referenties en het inzetten van een (online) screening.

Het toetsen van de integriteit van onze nieuwe collega’s is voor het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum van groot belang. Om die reden maakt een veiligheidsonderzoek op niveau A of B deel uit van het sollicitatieproces. Dit onderzoek wordt uitgevoerd door de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst en neemt doorgaans acht weken in beslag. Meer informatie over het onderzoek vind je op . Jouw werklocatie zal thuis en op kantoor zijn. Meer informatie hierover kun je terugvinden op CAO Rijk.

title: Pomočnik direktorja – z možnostjo dolgoročnega nasledstva (m/ž)
description:
Na kratko o podjetju in priložnosti:

Naš naročnik je podjetje z dolgoletno tradicijo na področju razvoja in proizvodnje tehnološko naprednih rešitev. Odlikujejo ga lastno znanje, razvojna usmerjenost, visoki standardi kakovosti ter prisotnost na zahtevnih mednarodnih trgih.

V začetnem obdobju bo ključna naloga pomočnika direktorja povezovanje produktnega vodenja, prodaje, marketinga in razvoja (R&D) ter zagotavljanje njihovega usklajenega delovanja v smeri tržnih potreb, konkurenčnih produktov in poslovnih rezultatov. V tej vlogi bo spoznal poslovanje, ključne procese in ekipo ter postopoma prevzemal širše vodstvene odgovornosti z dolgoročno perspektivo prevzema vodenja družbe.

Vaše odgovornosti bodo:

  • Povezovanje in usklajevanje produktnega vodenja, prodaje, marketinga in razvoja (R&D),

  • Sodelovanje pri oblikovanju produktne strategije in poslovnih usmeritev,

  • Povezovanje potreb kupcev in mednarodnih trgov s produktnim razvojem,

  • Usklajevanje prodajnih, marketinških in razvojnih prioritet,

  • Vodenje ključnih projektov od ideje do lansiranja produktov,

  • Sodelovanje pri strateških in operativnih poslovnih odločitvah,

  • Postopno prevzemanje širših vodstvenih odgovornosti.

Pričakujemo

Od vas pričakujemo:

  • Univerzitetno ali magistrsko izobrazbo tehnične smeri, prednostno elektrotehnike,

  • Zaželena dodatna poslovna izobrazba oziroma znanja s področja managementa ali poslovodenja,

  • Izkušnje s produktnim vodenjem, prodajo ali poslovnim razvojem,

  • Dobro razumevanje razvoja kompleksnih tehničnih produktov in sodelovanja z R&D,

  • Izkušnje iz mednarodnega industrijskega oziroma tehnološkega B2B-okolja,

  • Izkušnje z vodenjem medfunkcijskih ekip in projektov,

  • Sposobnost povezovanja inženirskega razmišljanja s poslovnimi cilji, tržnimi potrebami in strateškim razvojem podjetja,

  • Strateško razmišljanje, samostojnost in razvite vodstvene sposobnosti,

  • Dobro znanje angleškega jezika.

Nudimo

Ponujamo:

  • Pomembno in dolgoročno perspektivno vodstveno vlogo,

  • Neposredno vključevanje v ključne poslovne in strateške odločitve,

  • Strukturirano uvajalno obdobje in celovit vpogled v poslovanje podjetja,

  • Postopno prevzemanje odgovornosti z možnostjo dolgoročnega nasledstva in prevzema vodenja družbe.

Vabimo vas, da se pridružite pri soustvarjanju prihodnjega razvoja in uspešnosti podjetja.

title: Kundeveiledere
description:
Vil du ha en deltidsjobb der du jobber selvstendig, tar egne beslutninger og får relevant erfaring fra en bransje som er helt sentral for fremtidens energiløsninger?

Vi søker flere kundeveiledere til midlertidige deltidsstillinger på 40–60 %, med arbeidstid primært på kveld, natt og helg. Stillingene passer godt for deg som ønsker fleksibilitet ved siden av studier eller annet.

Hvorfor velge oss?

  • Erfaring fra en fremtidsrettet bransje innen fornybar energi og infrastruktur
  • En jobb der du bruker hodet, tar egne beslutninger og har reelt ansvar
  • Fleksibel arbeidshverdag med mulighet for hjemmekontor deler av tiden
  • Gode lønnsvilkår med tillegg for kveld, natt og helg

Om stillingen
Som kundeveileder hos oss vil du være vår stemme utad. Din hovedoppgave er å bistå til at våre kunder får god service i alle kanaler på en profesjonell og effektiv måte. Du vil håndtere varierte kundehenvendelser hvor målet er å finne de beste løsningene for våre kunder. Balanse mellom kvalitet og effektivitet vil være nøkkel til suksess i denne rollen.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Kundeservice på telefon, chat og epost
  • Veiledning, problemløsning og teknisk brukerstøtte
  • Beredskap og håndtering av henvendelser utenfor ordinær arbeidstid
  • Bidra til gode kundeopplevelser i alle kanaler

Hvem passer i rollen?
Dette er en jobb for deg som trives med ansvar og selvstendighet. Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har minimum generell studiekompetanse eller fagbrev
  • Er trygg i egne vurderinger og tar ansvar når du er på vakt
  • Trives med å jobbe selvstendig og strukturert
  • Er serviceinnstilt, løsningsorientert og kommuniserer klart og profesjonelt
  • Kan kommunisere flytende på norsk og engelsk - både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Lærer nye systemer og rutiner raskt

Vi tilbyr

  • En rolle i en bransje som er avgjørende for det grønne skiftet
  • God opplæring og oppfølging
  • Mulighet for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Fleksibilitet og mulighet for hjemmekontor deler av tiden
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser med gode tillegg for kveld, natt og helg
  • Et varmt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø, med engasjerte kolleger

Praktisk informasjon
Arbeidssted: Solheimsviken, Bergen
Arbeidstid: Kveld, natt og helg
Varighet: Frem til 30.06.2027, med gode muligheter for forlengelse.
Opplæringen foregår på dagtid de første ukene. Du må derfor kunne jobbe dagtid i denne perioden.

Vi gjennomfører intervjuer fortløpende.

Kjenner du deg igjen? Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

title: Research Fellow in Psychology (Gambling)
description:
• Full time,12-month fixed term position, located in Camperdown at the Brain and Mind Centre
  • Work within an internationally renowned gambling research centre and lead research programs that aim to have real-world impact on policies and practices within gambling and related fields
  • Base Salary, Academic Level A $117,936 - $125,896 p.a + 17% superannuation

About the opportunity

The School of Psychology at the University of Sydney is currently seeking a Research Fellow in Psychology (Gambling) to join Professor Sally Gainsbury and a multidisciplinary team at the Brain and Mind Centre.

The position will involve leading research and working with colleagues across disciplines to conduct applied research. The position will include translating research outcomes and disseminating these to inform gambling harm reduction policy and practice and lead to real-world changes.


Your key responsibilities will be to:

  • contribute to and independently lead projects on topics of gambling and problematic risk taking and decision making related to emerging technologies including developing and evaluating strategies to enhance wellbeing and minimize harms
  • work closely with Professor Gainsbury and researchers within the Gambling Research and Policy Unit and collaborate with academics at senior levels across the University of Sydney
  • independently lead research projects and work with students and junior researchers
  • develop project plans and data analysis plans including registrations for Open Science Frameworks
  • submit ethics applications and adhere to ethical principles in conducting research
  • manage research projects including recruitment and data collection
  • lead analysis of qualitative and quantitative research data
  • disseminate research findings through prepared technical reports, manuscripts for academic journals, lay summaries, and presentations
  • write funding and grant applications.


About you

The University values courage and creativity; openness and engagement; inclusion and diversity; and respect and integrity. As such, we see the importance of recruiting talent aligned to these values and are looking for a Research Fellow in Psychology (Gambling) who has:

  • a PhD in psychology (or related field)
  • demonstrated experience in ethical science practices
  • excellent project management skills
  • ability to lead a research team including junior and senior multidisciplinary researchers
  • expertise and experience analysing qualitative and quantitative data
  • demonstrated ability to produce academic outputs
  • experience translating research to impact policy and practice
  • successfully applied for and received competitive research funding.


Sponsorship / work rights for Australia

You must have unrestricted work rights in Australia for the duration of this employment to be eligible to apply. Visa sponsorship is not available for this appointment.

Pre-employment checks and declarations

Also, to meet the University’s obligations under the National Higher Education Code to Prevent and Respond to Gender-Based Violence you will be asked to declare if you have been investigated for, or found to engaged in, sexual harm or gender-based violence in the course of previous employment or in a legal process. title: JavaScript Engineer
description:
About the Projects: we are building LLM evaluation and training datasets to train LLM to work on realistic software engineering problems. One of our approaches, in this project, is to build verifiable SWE tasks based on public repository histories in a synthetic approach with human-in-the-loop; while expanding the dataset coverage to different types of tasks in terms of programming language, difficulty level, and etc.

About the Role:
We are looking for experienced software engineers (tech lead level) who are familiar with high-quality public GitHub repositories and can contribute to this project. This role involves hands-on software engineering work, including development environment automation, issue triaging, and evaluating test coverage and quality.

Why Join Us?
Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. You’ll be at the forefront of evaluating how LLMs interact with real code, influencing the future of AI-assisted software development. This is a unique opportunity to blend practical software engineering with AI research.

What does day-to-day look like:
  • Analyze and triage GitHub issues across trending open-source libraries.
  • Set up and configure code repositories, including Dockerization and environment setup.
  • Evaluating unit test coverage and quality.
  • Modify and run codebases locally to assess LLM performance in bug-fixing scenarios.
  • Collaborate with researchers to design and identify repositories and issues that are challenging for LLMs.
  • Opportunities to lead a team of junior engineers to collaborate on projects.

Required Skills:
  • Minimum 3+ years of overall experience.
  • Strong experience in JavaScript / TypeScript.
  • Proficiency with Git, Docker, and basic software pipeline setup.
  • Ability to understand and navigate complex codebases.
  • Comfortable running, modifying, and testing real-world projects locally.
  • Experience contributing to or evaluating open-source projects is a plus.

Nice to Have:
  • Previous participation in LLM research or evaluation projects.
  • Experience building or testing developer tools or automation agents.
  • Perks of Freelancing With Turing:
    • Work in a fully remote environment.
    • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

Offer Details:
  • Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST. (We have 3 options of time commitment: 20 hrs/week, 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week).
  • Employment type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave).

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: WorkCover Adminstration Coordinator
description:
About the team

You’ll be part of the WorkCover team, working closely with the Injury and Claims Manager, Injury and Claims Advisors, Payroll, Finance, insurers and other internal stakeholders. The team manages workers' compensation claims, insurance policies and premium requirements, providing essential administrative support to ensure claims and related processes are managed accurately and within required timeframes.

About the role

As a WorkCover Administration Coordinator, you’ll provide high-quality administrative support across workers' compensation claims, insurance policies, premiums and payroll processes. You’ll coordinate claims documentation, process payments and maintain accurate records while liaising with insurers, brokers and internal stakeholders. You’ll also support new store openings, ownership changes and policy renewals, ensuring all WorkCover administration is completed accurately and within required timeframes.

Key responsibilities

  • Coordinate end-to-end claims administration, including claim lodgements, return-to-work documentation, certificates of capacity and maintaining accurate records in Solv Injury.

  • Process workers' compensation payments, wage reimbursements, payroll reports and supporting documentation in line with state-specific requirements.

  • Manage WorkCover correspondence, phone enquiries, inboxes and document processing, ensuring all matters are actioned within required timeframes.

  • Maintain WorkCover policies and premium records, including processing invoices, adjustments, renewals, wage declarations and payment coordination.

  • Liaise with insurers, third-party brokers, Payroll and Finance to resolve policy and premium queries, confirm coverage and ensure payments are made by their due dates.

  • Coordinate insurance requirements for new stores, ownership changes and takeovers, including applying for policies and notifying insurers of relevant changes.

  • Maintain WorkCover spreadsheets, trackers, reporting structures and policy information across Solv Injury and relevant state portals.

  • Prepare and provide Certificates of Currency and other insurance documentation to internal stakeholders, ensuring records are accurate and accessible.

Who we are looking for

  • Minimum two years' administrative experience in WorkCover or workers' compensation, with a sound understanding of relevant legislation; a qualification in WorkCover, HR, WHS, Business or Finance is desirable.

  • Strong administration, analytical and systems skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage high-volume workloads and competing priorities.

  • Proactive and reliable team player with strong organisational, communication and time management skills; Microsoft Office and Solv Injury experience will be highly regarded.

Why Join Us?

Grow your career with purpose – Access a wide range of learning and development programs, including our internally designed leadership pathway to support your long‑term growth. Be part of a purpose-driven organisation making a difference in healthcare, working with a collaborative and supportive team.

Be rewarded for your impact – Enjoy annual salary reviews linked to your performance, recognising the value you bring to the team.

Flexibility that works – Work from home one day per week, while staying connected with your team at our vibrant Preston Support Office four days a week. We’re committed to supporting our people through life’s important moments. Alongside our formal flexibility policies, we recognise that some circumstances, such as returning from parental leave or managing personal wellbeing may require additional consideration. In these situations, we work collaboratively on case‑by‑case arrangements to provide the support needed while balancing the requirements of the role and team.

Paid parental leave – We support growing families with six weeks of paid parental leave for primary carers and one week of paid parental leave for secondary carers.

Exclusive savings – Access generous employee discounts across a wide range of products with our partnership with Flare, including company-wide corporate offers on healthcare premiums with Bupa Healthcare, banking benefits with Comm Bank and novated leasing.

Support when you need it – Tap into confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services for personal or professional support.

Take advantage of our subsidised and convenient onsite canteen for varied and affordable meals, coffee, confectionary and bakery items.

Easy commuting – Enjoy our complimentary shuttle bus connecting nearby train stations to the Preston Support Office, making public transport travel simple and stress‑free.

About Us

Sigma Healthcare is powering pharmacy! We have the largest pharmacy network in Australia with trusted brands including Chemist Warehouse, Amcal, Discount Drug Stores and Ultra Beauty! We are powered by our dedicated people and our leading Australian full line pharmacy wholesale and distribution business that delivers medicines to any pharmacy anywhere in Australia. With Chemist Warehouse now operating in four countries outside Australia, we continue to expand our reach.

How to Apply!

If you're ready to join a team that is shaping the future of healthcare and retail, click Apply Now to visit our Careers Page and submit your application.

Sigma Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.

title: Director - Mechanical Engineering (Building Services)
description:
Due to continued growth, we are looking for an experienced Director (Mechanical) to help lead and grow the Building Services team in Adelaide.

This role presents a unique opportunity to be recognised as a Director in our national Building Engineering team, delivering some iconic projects across ANZ and across a variety of market sectors, while still having a focus on growing and shaping the local team in Adelaide.

How you’ll make a difference:

  • Lead the delivery of complex, multi-disciplinary projects across sectors such as health, defence, transport, commercial, aviation, data-centre or other major building sectors around NSW/ACT.
  • Lead mechanical and multidiscipline building services design and end-to-end project delivery, including oversight of technical quality, coordination and design management across other disciplines such as electrical, fire protection and hydraulics.
  • Actively build and maintain strong client relationships to support business development and further secure a robust pipeline of future work.
  • Collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary engineering teams, applying deep technical expertise to drive quality outcomes through rigorous review of design calculations, specifications, models and drawings, ensuring best-practice documentation and coordinated project outputs.
  • Provide leadership, coaching and mentoring to junior and intermediate engineers, contributing to their technical development and supporting high-quality design documentation and project delivery.
  • Leverage an established local network to strengthen AECOM’s presence in South Australia, with a clear expectation to grow and develop the Adelaide building services team as part of the national Building Engineering team.

The following qualifications and experience are highly desired, but if you don’t tick all the boxes, you could still be a perfect fit for this role. Please apply, all applications will be considered.

The qualities that help you thrive:

  • Ideally, 15+ years’ experience in building services consultancy or contracting design with a strong mechanical engineering background. Furthermore, Chartered status (CPEng) essential, other registrations highly regarded
  • Demonstrated leadership in technical design and multi-disciplinary project delivery
  • Deep knowledge of building services systems, standards and best-practice design, with the ability to guide clients, mentor junior engineers and provide technical direction across complex project environments.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, lead multidiscipline bids for building engineering projects, and collaborate effectively with senior leaders to support business development and operational performance.
  • Proven track record of enhancing long-term client relationships and working across key sectors such as data centres, commercial, aviation, defence or broader building markets.
  • Strong communicator and leader with a passion for growing teams, coaching emerging engineers and driving quality, innovation and continuous improvement within the building services team.

Given the nature of our projects, Australian Citizenship is required with current (or previously held) defence clearance.

Why you’ll love working with us:

  • Be part of a nationally recognised, global engineering business
  • Work on high-profile, technically challenging projects across key sectors across ANZ
  • Join a collaborative culture and work with teams across ANZ
  • Flexible work arrangements, including alternative start/finish times, job-sharing and hybrid work options
  • Purchase up to 6 weeks additional annual leave per year
  • Flex public holidays – swap Easter or other holidays for ones that suit you better
  • Continuous learning and growth - lunch and learns, professional development courses, financial study assistance, 5 days paid study leave, global career opportunities

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities, additional health or mental health needs, and/or neurodiverse conditions. If you require any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know.

Applications are reviewed as they come in, and the role may close earlier than expected, so if this opportunity sounds like you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Learn more about life at AECOM: LinkedIn, Facebook , Instagram, X, YouTube - explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

title: Senior Project Manager - B2B Partnership, Customer Experience Group (Based in Bangkok, Thailand | Relocation Provided)
description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team
The Customer Experience Group (CEG) of Agoda effectively serves our customers and partners to ensure satisfying results. This great task is accomplished with the support of our Global Service Verticals (GSV) team. We serve as the backbone for CEG’s global operations. Our team is comprised of project managers, process owners, analysts, and talent management. Together we work nonstop to improve the quality and efficiency of our customer and partner support processes. We are a very data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation. A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance.

This role is within the B2B Partnerships team, which is a part of CEG’s Global Service Verticals. The team focuses on driving end‑to‑end partner experience and process improvements, and scaling impact through automation, AI, and tooling across both partner-facing and agent-facing journeys for our B2B partnerships.

The Opportunity:

This role is responsible for leading a portfolio of global partner excellence programmes with a focus on complex system support in the Customer Experience Group (CEG), with a focus on: (i) process optimization and PX improvements across the post‑booking partner journey, (ii) automation, AI, and tooling to enhance customer and agent experience, (iii) collaboration with product and commercial teams to drive structural changes and (iv) reduce partner effort and CEG cost‑to‑serve, unlock commercial value from partner support insights

You will lead a high‑performing team of project managers/experts to drive measurable impact on customer satisfaction, efficiency, quality, and cost. The role combines strategic problem solving, hands‑on data-driven execution, and strong stakeholder management with both technical (Product/Tech/Data) and non‑technical (Operations/Support/Commercial) teams.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Lead and Own a Portfolio of Transformational Initiatives

  • Own from end‑to‑end a collection of projects and/or areas of business in CEG (global coverage), spanning commercial enablement and process excellence initiatives.
  • Prioritize, plan, and drive initiatives that improve mission‑critical metrics: partner or customer satisfaction (e.g., PSAT, CSAT), service levels, automation quality, productivity, cost efficiency, and employee/agent engagement.
  • Ensure CEG readiness to support B2B partnerships and product initiatives by working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Strategic Partnerships, Partner Services, Finance, Legal, and other CEG teams.

Shape End‑to‑End Customer & Process Improvements

  • Continuously improve CEG end‑to‑end processes across the post‑booking journey to remove pain points, and improve operational performance through targeted initiatives and data driven insights.
  • Own and evolve frameworks and roadmaps for how we continuously improve our internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and related processes; balancing CX/PX outcomes vs. efficiency/cost.
  • Define clear problem statements and build business cases to define and prioritize customer/partner pain points and success metrics.

Drive Commercial driven Solutions & Insights in Operations

  • Partner with Product Management / Technology /CEG teams to design, prioritize, and implement solutions, from experimentation and configuration through to global rollout and impact measurement.
  • Drive strategic initiatives across CEG such as improving complex systems support in key growth markets, regulatory initiatives and partner closely with our commercial teams in order to improve partner/supplier pain points.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and tooling across customer, partner and agent journeys (e.g., self‑service, post-booking APIs).

Lead and Develop a High‑Performing Team

  • Set long‑term vision, strategy, and annual/quarterly OKRs for your team, aligning with CEG and company-wide priorities.
  • Manage and coach a team of project managers (and potentially people managers), building talent, capability, and succession within the team.
  • Provide structured feedback, mentoring, and support to enable your team’s growth and to consistently raise the bar for quality and impact.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders and stakeholders across CEG and other functions, effectively influencing priorities and decisions.
  • Monitor project milestones, identify risks and dependencies, troubleshoot issues, and implement mitigation plans—acting at all times as the ultimate owner of the portfolio’s outcomes.

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

Experience & Background

  • At least 8–10+ years of experience in project/program management, strategy & operations, commercial excellence, process improvement, management consulting, or similar fields.
  • Significant people leadership experience, including building and managing high‑performing teams (ideally including people managers and individual contributors).
  • Proven track record of leading and influencing complex, cross‑functional initiatives from idea to implementation, with clear, measurable business impact.
  • Experience working closely with Product/Technology/Data teams on technical or automation/AI-focused projects is highly advantageous.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Strong analytical mindset; comfortable with numbers and quantitative problem solving. Able to define analysis structures, interpret data, challenge existing metrics, and make recommendations.
  • Familiarity with data and analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Metabase, VBA, or similar) and experience leveraging them to drive decisions.
  • Comfort working with or overseeing workflow / automation / agent guidance tools, and the ability to engage in technical discussions with Product/Engineering/Data teams. Coding ability is a plus(you have to be willing to learn)
  • Exposure to AI/ML‑driven solutions in an operational or PX context (e.g., chatbots, recommendation engines, routing, classification, or decision support tools) is a strong plus.

Commercial Excellence, Process, and Delivery Skills
