title: Manager - Vendor Governance Management (Risk)
description:
The Manager, Vendor Governance Management (Risk) leads a team responsible for consistent, timely, and risk-based execution of the vendor governance lifecycle. The role translates policy and regulatory requirements into effective operational controls across intake, inherent risk stratification, due diligence, ongoing monitoring, renewal and reassessment, issue remediation, and closure. units.


Role Responsibilities

1. Risk Governance and Assessment Oversight

· Own the day-to-day governance and delivery of vendor risk assessments, including inherent risk screening, due diligence, reassessments, renewals, material changes, and event-driven reviews.

· Ensure assessments are risk-based, evidence-supported, complete, and aligned with applicable outsourcing and third-party risk policies, standards, procedures, and jurisdictional requirements.

· Provide independent review and challenge on risk ratings, control gaps, residual risk, compensating controls, and proposed risk acceptance or treatment decisions.

· Coordinate with Privacy, Information Security, Business Continuity, Compliance, Legal, Sourcing, Procurement, and business owners to obtain timely specialist input and resolve complex cases.

· Escalate material risks, policy exceptions, overdue actions, control failures, and unresolved ownership issues through the appropriate governance channels.

2. Corrective Action, Incident, and Emerging Risk Management

· Lead governance of corrective action plans, including clear ownership, achievable target dates, evidence standards, aging controls, escalation thresholds, and closure validation.

· Oversee third-party risk incidents and emerging-risk monitoring, ensuring impact assessment, stakeholder notification, root-cause analysis, remediation, and follow-through.

· Use external risk intelligence and internal data to identify financial, cyber, operational, reputational, concentration, geographic, and business-continuity concerns that require action.

· Ensure highest-risk and critical vendors receive appropriate monitoring intensity, contingency planning, exit considerations, and senior-management visibility.

3. Operational Performance, Data Quality, and Reporting

· Manage team capacity, work allocation, priorities, and service levels across markets, segments, and assessment types, balancing urgency, risk, and customer impact.

· Maintain reliable management information covering assessment volumes, turnaround time, aging, backlog, overdue corrective actions, risk distribution, quality results, and recurring control themes.

· Validate the accuracy, completeness, and traceability of vendor risk data and supporting evidence in the systems of record before reporting or governance submission.

· Prepare concise executive insights and path-to-green actions for monthly operating reviews, quarterly business reviews, risk forums, audits, and regulatory inquiries.

· Drive process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across intake, assessment, quality assurance, tracking, communications, and reporting.

4. Stakeholder and Regulatory Partnership

· Act as the operational subject-matter expert for vendor risk governance and clearly communicate requirements, decisions, dependencies, and consequences to business and functional stakeholders.

· Partner with Procurement and Sourcing so risk results inform vendor selection, contracting strategy, protective clauses, renewals, remediation commitments, and exit decisions.

· Support audits, regulatory reviews, internal control testing, and management attestations with complete, accurate, and timely evidence.

· Build trusted relationships with onshore partners, market stakeholders, vendor owners, and risk subject-matter experts while maintaining appropriate independence and constructive challenge.

5. People Leadership and Capability Building

· Set clear performance expectations and measurable goals for analysts and specialists, including productivity, quality, timeliness, risk judgment, documentation, and stakeholder management.

· Coach team members through regular one-on-ones, case reviews, calibration sessions, quality feedback, and individual development plans.

· Build cross-training, succession, and backup coverage to reduce key-person dependency and maintain continuity during peaks, transitions, and absences.

· Create an accountable and inclusive team culture that encourages early escalation, continuous learning, collaboration, and ownership of outcomes.

· Identify skills gaps and deliver targeted learning on policy, regulatory expectations, risk domains, systems, data analysis, executive communication, and decision quality.


Qualifications and Experience

· Undergraduate degree in business, risk management, finance, procurement, information systems, or a related discipline; relevant postgraduate study is an advantage.

· Typically 8 or more years of progressive experience in third-party risk, vendor governance, operational risk, procurement, compliance, outsourcing governance, or a related field, including demonstrated people or team leadership.

· Experience managing risk assessments and remediation across multiple business units, markets, or jurisdictions in a regulated and globally distributed environment.

· Working knowledge of third-party risk domains, including cybersecurity, privacy, business continuity, financial viability, compliance, reputational risk, concentration risk, and subcontractor or fourth-party risk.

· Experience with workflow and reporting tools such as Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, and enterprise governance, risk, procurement, or vendor-management platforms.

· Relevant credentials such as CTPRP, CRVPM, CERP, CISA, CRISC, CISM, CGRC, or procurement and operational-risk certifications are advantageous but not mandatory.


Leadership Competencies

· Risk-based judgment: distinguishes material risk from process noise and makes timely, defensible decisions.

· Execution discipline: converts requirements into clear ownership, milestones, controls, and measurable outcomes.

· Constructive challenge: influences stakeholders confidently while preserving partnership and independence.

· Executive communication: simplifies complex risk information into concise implications, options, and recommendations.

· People development: raises team capability through coaching, calibration, feedback, empowerment, and succession planning.

· Transformation mindset: uses data, standardization, automation, and root-cause analysis to improve control effectiveness and customer experience.

· Integrity and accountability: owns outcomes, escalates transparently, protects confidential information, and models sound risk behavior.

title: CyberArk Engineer Senior
description:
SAIC is currently seeking a CyberArk Engineer Senior to support DOT. As a CyberArk Senior Systems Engineer, you'll play a key role in enhancing our cybersecurity and identity management capabilities. You'll coordinate with external stakeholders, including DHS CISA integrators, to implement the Identity Lifecycle Management (ILM)/Mandatory User Re-Authentication (MUR) solutions at the Department of Transportation (DOT). This involves integrating DOT's SailPoint infrastructure with the ServiceNow environment and maintaining the ILM solution across development, testing, and production environments.

Your responsibilities will also include:

  • Supporting ILM workflows for Privileged Account Management (PAM) tools and Active Directory (AD), building new system connections, and maintaining Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) Dashboard integrations.
  • You'll be responsible for deploying software updates, reporting on SailPoint IdentityIQ operations, and supporting the identification and remediation of security vulnerabilities.
  • This position requires providing on-call and after-hours support, participating in annual Disaster Recovery testing, documenting recovery plans, and offering subject matter expertise to recommend and implement improvements.
  • You'll ensure compliance with DOT processes for change management and enhance reporting capabilities, ensuring data integrity for CDM dashboard compliance per DHS CISA requirements.

Top Qualifications, Skills, Experience or Certifications:

  • 8+ years of related experience providing business solutions engineering support, to include architectural design, engineering design, proof of concept development, pilots, analysis, results, and documentation.
  • Performs day-to-day activities required to assist and identify technology solutions that meet enterprise requirements.
  • Maps functional requirements into technological requirements, and identifies technologies that meet the technological requirements.
  • Conducts proof of concept, pilots and demos for the purposes of evaluating the suitability of given technologies for meeting requirements.
  • Evaluates the tradeoffs between competing solutions and develops quantitative driven analysis of alternatives.
  • Produces written analysis of research and recommendation papers that clearly describe the process followed, alternatives considered, evaluation criteria and rationale for recommendation and need for additional work.

Job Role Specific Requirements:

  • CyberArk Sentry Certification: Certified CyberArk Sentry qualification to be obtained within 1 year of start of employment, demonstrating advanced knowledge and skills in managing the CyberArk Privileged Access Security Solution. SAIC will carry the cost of the exam to be certified.
  • Proven CyberArk Implementation Expertise: Three years of experience in designing and implementing comprehensive lifecycle management processes for CyberArk within an organization comparable to the Department of Transportation (DOT), showcasing a deep understanding of privileged access management solutions.
  • Extensive Server Administration Experience: Five years of server administration experience, including proficiency with Windows Server 2019 and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 8, indicating a strong foundation in managing and maintaining critical server infrastructure.
  • CyberArk Design Architect Proficiency: Three years of dedicated CyberArk experience in a design architect role, encompassing disaster recovery planning, ensuring high availability, and conducting system administration within a large-scale enterprise environment similar to DOT, highlighting the ability to architect robust and resilient CyberArk deployments.

Preferred skills and qualifications:

  • CyberArk and SailPoint Integration Acumen: Demonstrated proficiency in integrating CyberArk with SailPoint, showcasing the capability to harmonize privileged access management with identity governance solutions for enhanced security protocols.
  • Advanced Active Directory Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of both the user interface aspects of Active Directory, such as account management and Group Policy, and the technical components, including AD Schema, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and automation via PowerShell, ensuring a well-rounded approach to directory services management.
  • Database Management Skills: Solid foundational understanding of database management, specifically with SQL Server 2019. This includes experience with backups, indexing, integrity checks, installation and configuration, managing ports and protocols, developing maintenance plans, and adept troubleshooting. Additionally, proficient in data modeling and schema, with the ability to interpret and navigate Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERDs), indicating a comprehensive grasp of database architecture and operations.
  • CyberArk Configuration Knowledge: Proven ability to configure CyberArk for secure integration with a variety of systems and devices, including networks, iDRAC interfaces, applications, cloud services, storage solutions, servers, and appliances, ensuring a secure and efficient privileged access ecosystem across the IT landscape.

Note: Candidate must be a U.S. citizen or green card holder who has resided in the U.S. for at least 3 years and the ability to obtain a public trust.

title: Product Certification Client Manager / Auditor
location: Auckland or Wellington, Other/Not Applicable, NZ
description:
About Bureau Veritas

Created in 1828, Bureau Veritas is a world leader in laboratory testing, inspection and certification services.

We have a vital role in maintaining quality, safety and environmental standards of countless products, commodities, systems, buildings, infrastructure, and projects.

In every industry sector we play, Bureau Veritas acts as a trusted guardian of the quality, safety and environmental standards which protect our population and safeguard our communities.

For over 70 years, Bureau Veritas has been serving the Pacific, including Australia and New Zealand. Today, our business employs 2,800+ employees and operates 50 offices and labs across the Pacific.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Product Certification Client Manager / Auditor to join our growing Product Certification business in New Zealand. Based in Auckland or Wellington and reporting to the Product Certification Manager (Australia), you will play a key role in delivering product certification services across a diverse range of clients and industries.

Working both independently and as part of a collaborative certification team, you will be responsible for conducting desktop and on-site assessments, reviewing technical documentation and test reports, assessing compliance with relevant Standards, Building Code(s), and regulatory requirements, and making certification recommendations. You will also manage client relationships throughout the certification lifecycle, providing technical guidance and ensuring exceptional service delivery.

This role requires strong technical expertise, sound professional judgement, and a customer-focused approach to support accreditation requirements, deliver high-quality certification outcomes, and contribute to the continued growth and success of the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct product certification assessments in accordance with Bureau Veritas policies, procedures, and applicable product standards, while managing and maintaining client relationships within the Product Certification team.
  • Evaluate products for compliance with relevant New Zealand, Australian, and international standards, building codes, and regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare comprehensive audit and assessment reports, communicate findings to clients, and ensure a clear understanding of certification decisions, including required corrective actions where applicable.
  • Perform technical reviews of new products, product modifications, and certification updates to support client requirements and business objectives.
  • Recommend the issuance, renewal, suspension, or withdrawal of certification approvals and certificates in accordance with Bureau Veritas governance requirements.
  • Build and maintain strong client partnerships that enhance customer satisfaction, strengthen commercial relationships, and identify opportunities for business growth and service expansion.
  • Effectively plan and manage audit schedules, assessment activities, and workload priorities to optimise operational efficiency and revenue-generating activities.
  • Maintain technical competence through ongoing professional development and by keeping abreast of developments in product certification schemes, standards, regulations, and industry practices.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, knowledge sharing, and the ongoing development of certification processes and technical expertise within the team.

About You

  • A minimum of five years' experience in a comparable technical, certification, compliance, quality assurance, or manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in Product Certification, product compliance, conformity assessment, or management systems auditing.
  • Strong client engagement and stakeholder management skills, with a proven customer-focused approach.
  • Sound project management capabilities, including the ability to independently manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • Solid understanding of Standards, regulatory frameworks, and legislative requirements, and their practical application.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively influence and engage a broad range of stakeholders.
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally, including to remote locations, as required.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience working with accreditation bodies and a sound understanding of ISO/IEC 17065 requirements.
  • Advanced experience in Product Certification, conformity assessment, and regulatory compliance activities.
  • Experience within the construction materials and building products sector, including areas such as structural steel, glass, timber, windows and doors, prefabricated or modular construction, or related industries.
  • Experience with the New Zealand Building Code, relevant legislation, and the CodeMark Certification Scheme.
  • Knowledge of Australasian building regulatory frameworks and construction product compliance requirements.

Education

It is mandatory to have:

  • Tertiary qualification in Engineering (preferably Mechanical, Industrial, Civil, Materials, or a related discipline).

It is desirable to have:

title: Electrical Hardware Engineer, AI Satellites (Starmind)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

ELECTRICAL HARDWARE ENGINEER, AI SATELLITES (STARMIND)

SpaceX is leveraging its experience deploying and operating the world’s largest satellite constellation to develop Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth. Realizing this vision demands highly reliable, high performance electrical hardware ranging from power electronics, high speed digital systems, mixed signal designs, robust avionics, networking, and custom compute electronics. These systems must operate in the extreme environment of space while delivering the connectivity, control, power distribution, and processing needed for orbital AI inference.

We are seeking best-in-class Electrical Hardware Engineers to own the full lifecycle of the electronics that make Starmind possible. You’ll apply deep electrical engineering skill sets at the intersection of power conversion and distribution, high-speed digital communications, analog design, network integration, thermal management, signal integrity, and on-orbit compute to create the hardware backbone for next-generation space-based AI infrastructure.

We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system. Your work sits at the intersection of electrical, mechanical, thermal analysis, software, and networking engineering that enables orbital compute capability. Challenges range from high-speed digital communications, analog, network system integration, power electronics, RF/optical devices, and high-performance compute electronics for space. Your work will include everything from system design and schematic capture to PCB layout oversight; as well as hardware troubleshooting to driving requirements for the underlying silicon and complete product production and test. This also includes driving successful business outcomes across interdisciplinary subsystems of the satellite, inclusive of mechanical and software engineering peers among other engineering disciplines. Sub-teams include:

Avionics: The backbone of Starmind satellites are the bus avionics systems which control the vehicle, convert and distribute kilowatts of power, route high-speed vehicle and user/compute traffic, and connect satellites to each other via our state-of-the-art Space Lasers! The team is responsible for the design, development, and ultimate success of these avionics systems from concept to grave.

Payload: The Payload team is responsible for the design of custom AI compute electronics that push the forefront of AI chip performance, interconnectivity, and cluster size. Everything from high-power AI chips to high throughput network switching to high density storage conversion. The team owns the design, development, and ultimate success of this hardware from concept to grave.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Rapidly develop high-reliability electronics for satellites and spacecraft.
  • Drive system trades, requirements capture, component selection, analysis, schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, hardware bring-up, debugging, documentation, manufacturing, test, and on-orbit performance of complex electrical designs
  • Get hands-on and support hardware through production, satellite integration, and flight
  • Determine layer stackup, perform component package selection, component placement, routing feasibility studies, and signal routing of digital, analog, RF, and power conversion of PCBs
  • Library creation and maintenance
  • Create and release documentation for fabrication of PCBs
  • Collaborate with internal teams and PCB vendors to continually improve design rules, constraints and design for test and manufacture guidelines
  • Work closely with engineers from adjacent disciplines (mechanical, thermal, software, test engineering, supply chain, silicon design, etc.) to deliver tightly integrated, high-performance hardware
  • Challenge assumptions, question requirements, learn from your mistakes, and approach problems with an open mind

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or physics
  • 1+ years of experience designing circuits, electronic products, or hardware (internships/co-ops are applicable)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or similar engineering degree
  • 2+ years of professional experience rapidly designing and delivering highly reliable products
  • 2+ years of electronic product experience designing hardware from concept through production; strong emphasis on full life-cycle development of new hardware products and not small incremental updates to legacy hardware
  • 2+ years of experience designing and implementing mixed-signal circuit boards from concept through production using processors, FPGAs, Ethernet, multi-GHz Serdes, DRAM interfaces (DDR4), I2C, SPI, operational amplifiers, analog to digital and digital to analog converters, and power supply components
  • 2+ years of professional experience testing, troubleshooting, and debugging electronics
  • Strong understanding of computers and programming languages (Python, C/C++)
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a highly cross-functional role
  • 2+ years working on aerospace systems

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • This position is 100% onsite and requires relocation to the Austin-Bastrop area if not already local – remote or hybrid work not considered
  • Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission critical deadlines
  • Some travel may occasionally be required

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Product Lead, Deposits
description:
Product Lead – Deposits

See yourself in our team

Our purpose is to improve the financial wellbeing of our customers and communities. The Everyday Banking team supports the full spectrum of customers’ transaction banking and deposits needs from birth through to retirement. We support more than 9 million customers to manage their day-to-day spending, save towards their financial goals and meet other banking needs. We have end-to-end accountability for Retail Deposits and Transactions products and customer experiences, the Group’s Open Banking obligations, and key customer journeys including Disputes and Deceased Estates.

Do work that matters

As Product Lead for Deposits, you will work with the Product Stream Lead, other Product Leads and Product Managers to develop and evolve the product vision, strategy and roadmap. With direction and leadership from the Product Stream Lead, you will translate the agreed direction into clear, measurable outcomes for your defined product area.

Within your defined product area, you will be accountable for product discovery, prioritisation, product performance, lifecycle health, run performance and continuous optimisation, and will contribute to the development and management of the broader product roadmap. Working closely with the Product Stream Lead, Product Managers and partners across Technology, Design, Data, Operations, Risk and other specialist teams, you will make evidence-based recommendations and trade-offs that deliver customer, commercial, operational and risk outcomes safely and sustainably.

Specifically, you will:

  • Contribute to the development and evolution of the Deposits product vision and strategy, under the leadership of the Product Stream Lead and aligned to Product Stream and Crew objectives.
  • Translate agreed strategy into clear, measurable customer, commercial, operational and risk outcomes for your defined product area.
  • Lead continuous discovery to identify, define, validate and prioritise meaningful customer and business problems before committing to solutions.
  • Help shape and maintain an outcome-driven roadmap, making evidence-based prioritisation recommendations and decisions within your defined product area across customer value, commercial opportunity, operational impact, technology considerations, risk and regulatory requirements.
  • Use customer research, product data, market insight, operational evidence and experimentation to inform product decisions rather than assumptions or stakeholder preference.
  • Frame clear problem and opportunity statements, identify critical assumptions and hypotheses, and use proportionate experiments, prototypes and feedback loops to reduce uncertainty before scaling delivery.
  • Partner with the Squad Tech Lead, Design, Data, Operations, Risk and specialist teams to assess desirability, viability, feasibility and usability, and to provide confidence in sequencing and delivery.
  • Lead the defined product area across discovery, delivery, lifecycle management, run performance and continuous optimisation.
  • Monitor product performance using leading and lagging indicators, and adapt priorities when evidence shows that intended outcomes are not being achieved.
  • Embed risk, controls, regulatory requirements, privacy, security and operational resilience throughout discovery, prioritisation, delivery and optimisation.
  • Own product lifecycle health and run performance within your defined product area, partnering with Technology, Operations and Risk to prioritise incidents, recurring problems, vulnerabilities, resilience concerns and technology debt according to customer impact, risk and product outcomes.
  • Assess the value and viability of product opportunities, including customer demand, commercial benefit, costs, operational impacts, market dynamics and regulatory considerations.
  • Develop clear recommendations and investment cases that articulate the problem, evidence, expected outcomes, options, trade-offs and measures of success.
  • Lead and coach Product Managers, strengthening product judgement, discovery, commercial, risk and stakeholder capabilities.
  • Align the squad and stakeholders around agreed product direction, priorities, trade-offs and decisions, communicating progress through outcomes, insights and learning.
  • Create an inclusive, high-performing environment in which team members understand the product vision, contribute to decisions, challenge assumptions and share accountability for outcomes.
  • Support incremental, safe delivery of validated solutions and use real-world feedback to inform ongoing discovery and optimisation.

Help us deliver a better future in Everyday Banking

We are interested in hearing from people who have:

  • Product roadmap and prioritization - Advanced capability in translating agreed strategy into coherent priorities and outcomes, contributing to roadmap development and making evidence-based trade-offs within a defined product area.
  • Product discovery and problem definition - Advanced capability in using customer insight, data and experimentation to define problems, test assumptions and reduce uncertainty.
  • Customer and user experience practices - Advanced capability in understanding journeys, personas and pain points, and applying research and feedback to product decisions.
  • Decision making, influencing and communication - Advanced judgement in complex and ambiguous situations, with the ability to align stakeholders and communicate product strategy, evidence, trade-offs and outcomes.
  • Commercial and market analysis - Sound capability in opportunity sizing, product economics, market dynamics, pricing, costs and investment trade-offs.
  • Product lifecycle and service management - Sound capability in managing product performance, run health, controls and continuous optimisation across the lifecycle
  • Risk management - Sound capability in embedding risk and regulatory considerations into product decisions and delivering better risk outcomes.
  • AI literacy - Sound understanding of AI concepts and responsible use of role-appropriate AI tools, including data, privacy and responsible AI considerations.
  • People and partnership leadership - Experience leading or coaching Product Managers and building effective partnerships in empowered, cross-functional product teams.
  • Relevant experience - Demonstrated product management or equivalent product leadership experience in financial services or another complex, regulated environment.
  • Ways of working - Experience applying continuous discovery and adaptive delivery practices to achieve measurable outcomes.

Your development

Our team is committed to supporting your development. You will have the opportunity to build a strong network, demonstrate your potential through high-impact work and strengthen your product leadership capability. You will receive coaching and support to focus on your growth and development. If you live our values and demonstrate our leadership principles, we can offer meaningful opportunities to build your career.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Principal Software Engineer

  • Set the technical direction for platforms that detect and investigate financial crime.
  • Shape domain-wide architecture while remaining close to engineering and code.
  • Advance shared platforms, modern cloud engineering and responsible AI at CommBank.

Do work that matters


Join EC Technology, where our crews build the detection, investigation and data capabilities that help protect customers and keep financial crime out of the bank.


As a Principal Software Engineer, you’ll set the engineering direction across a technology domain rather than a single squad. You’ll shape architecture, platform investment and build-versus-reuse decisions, helping multiple teams move from fragmented systems towards shared, scalable capabilities.


This is an opportunity to influence technology that operates in a highly regulated environment. You’ll set patterns for resilience, security, observability and responsible AI, while remaining hands-on enough to turn technical direction into practical engineering outcomes.


Bring your ambition and help shape secure, future-ready engineering that delivers meaningful outcomes for customers and communities.


See yourself in our team


EC Technology brings together engineers, product professionals, data scientists and architects to strengthen the bank’s crime-detection, investigation and data platforms.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the domain’s technical strategy, including architecture direction, platform choices and build-versus-reuse decisions.
  • Drive consolidation and decommissioning, reducing system and pipeline duplication while establishing reusable golden paths.
  • Scale platforms from minimum viable products into resilient, highly available and enterprise-ready services.
  • Set engineering standards across continuous integration and delivery, testing, observability, operational readiness and security.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership across the stack, guiding the development of scalable services, well-designed APIs, backend-for-frontend layers and fit-for-purpose internal interfaces.
  • Define reliable, observable and responsible approaches to AI and agentic systems, with appropriate human oversight.
  • Embed regulatory, control, security and privacy considerations into engineering decisions from the outset.
  • Mentor senior engineers and lift engineering capability through influence, technical leadership and hands-on contribution.

We’re interested in hearing from people who


You’re a foundations-strong engineering leader who can reason across technologies, connect strategy with delivery and create clarity in complex environments. You bring broad, full-stack software engineering experience and can influence teams without relying on formal authority.

You’ll bring:

  • Strong computer-science foundations across algorithms, data structures, concurrency and distributed-system design.
  • Proven experience owning technical outcomes across complete product or platform surfaces, with the judgement to move between breadth and depth.
  • Experience designing and operating production services and APIs at scale using a modern typed language such as Python, Java, Kotlin or Go.
  • Strong API, contract and integration-design capability, including experience with REST, OpenAPI, API gateways or equivalent technologies.
  • Full-stack capability, including experience with React and TypeScript or equivalent technologies, as well as backend-for-frontend layers.
  • A practical approach to frontend engineering. The role principally supports internal, systems-facing applications rather than consumer-grade interfaces, but you’ll be comfortable contributing across the stack when required.
  • Cloud-native engineering experience involving technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions or ArgoCD, with a focus on high availability and operational excellence.
  • Experience with platform strategy, reusable capabilities, legacy-system modernisation, event-driven integration, observability, security-first engineering, or reliable AI and agentic systems.

title: Quality Completions Manager
description:
Completions Manager

The opportunity

Downer is seeking an experienced Completions Manager to join our Energy & Utilities business and support the delivery of a major transmission infrastructure project.

This is a key project leadership role responsible for coordinating completions and handover activities from fabrication and construction through pre commissioning, commissioning and final close out.

You will work across engineering, construction, quality, commissioning and document control teams to ensure project assets are completed safely, accurately and in accordance with contractual and client requirements.

Key responsibilities include:

• Lead the day to day delivery of project completions and handover activities

• Establish and maintain asset hierarchies, system boundaries, handover packages and completion schedules

• Coordinate staged completions from fabrication through construction, pre commissioning, commissioning and final acceptance

• Manage completion records including ITPs, ITRs, punchlists, NCRs, as built documentation, Manufacturer Data Reports and handover certificates

• Administer and maintain the Completions Management System, ensuring project data remains accurate, current and traceable

• Coordinate completion readiness across engineering, construction, quality, commissioning and document control teams

• Monitor punchlist and NCR close out and ensure critical issues are resolved before assets progress through completion stages

• Support commissioning readiness, energisation activities, system handovers and final client acceptance

• Maintain completion dashboards, forecasts and reporting to identify risks and support upcoming project milestones

• Drive progressive close out throughout project delivery to support safe and efficient handover

What we’re looking for

To be successful in this role, you will bring:

• Demonstrated completions and handover experience within major transmission, substation, utilities or comparable high risk construction projects

• A tertiary qualification in engineering, construction management, quality management or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience

• Experience coordinating a Completions Management System across construction, commissioning and final handover

• Practical experience with ITPs, ITRs, asset registers, punchlists, NCRs, as built drawings, Manufacturer Data Reports and client handover packages

• Strong understanding of completions, quality assurance, commissioning interfaces, document control and configuration management

• Strong planning, reporting, stakeholder engagement and client facing communication skills

• High attention to detail with strong systems and record management capability

• Experience with GoTechnology, InEight Document Control and Microsoft 365 reporting tools would be highly regarded

What we offer

At Downer, we plan, create and sustain. We offer the opportunity to work on significant infrastructure projects alongside experienced teams across our Energy & Utilities business.

You will have the opportunity to play an important role in the successful delivery and handover of major transmission infrastructure while developing your experience within a large and diverse organisation.

About Energy & Utilities

Downer is a leading provider of integrated services in Australia and New Zealand. Through our Energy & Utilities business, we provide services across power, gas, water and renewable energy infrastructure.

Our teams work across the lifecycle of essential infrastructure, supporting the communities and industries that rely on these networks every day.

Downer is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone belongs. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.

How to apply

If you are an experienced completions professional looking to contribute to the delivery of major transmission infrastructure, we would like to hear from you.

Please submit your application online, including your current resume.

Please note that Downer does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. All recruitment activity must be coordinated through our internal recruitment team.

title: Utility Operator
description:
Portfolio Business: Huber Engineered Materials

J.M. Huber Corporation is one of the largest privately held, family-owned companies in the United States. Established in 1883, we are a diversified, global supplier of specialty and commodity chemicals, hydrocolloid solutions, engineered wood products and natural resources to customers spanning a wide variety of industries. With approximately $3 billion in sales and 4,000 employees worldwide, we have a material presence in more than 20 countries.

Position Summary

To ensure that finished product meets the customer and In Process Controls (IPC) as dictated by customer specifications. Verify that packing, labeling and plant load out to QDC meets all internal and customer requirements. Certify that all customer requirements listed in the production schedule are met. This position works a rotating 12-hour night shift schedule from 6:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. The rotation provides a predictable schedule with built-in weekdays off and only two weekends per month. Overtime may be required to support operational needs.

Principal Duties & Responsibilities

The individual is responsible for maintaining compliance with the Huber Sustainability Management System (HSMS) within their sphere of influence. This may include compliance with any air permits, wastewater permits, storm water permits, or other rules as presented to the employee as requirements. In addition, compliance with all MSHA, FDA and other regulatory agencies is required. Responsible for bringing all environmental, health and safety and/or quality incidents or concerns to management for resolution.

  1. Sets up pack out equipment configuration to meet production needs.
  2. Operate and monitor finished product pack out systems and ensure that bag weights are within specification. Pack out systems may consist of manual, automatic or a combination of the two. Manual stacking may be needed.
  3. Conducts Mill service, PM’s and assists Maintenance with minor repairs of equipment as directed.
  4. Responsible for maintaining packaging supply inventory within the production facility.
  5. Fills out paperwork such as: batch records, plant orders, sample bags, lift truck inspection reports, etc.
  6. Stencils product with customer information, repalletizes product, labels and scans nonconforming product.
  7. Keeps work area, warehouse and outside of plant in a neat and orderly condition following GMP guidelines.
  8. Employee must follow all applicable company policies and safe practices and perform all duties assigned by supervisor. This description covers the significant duties of the job but may not include additional assignments assigned by supervisor.

Specialized/Technical Knowledge or Required Skills

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Must be able to operate a tow motor (experience preferred).
  • Experience in a food or pharmaceutical environment is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to read and comprehend safety policy, SOP’s, SDS, Quality Manual and various production schedules/reports.
  • Must be able to lift and move 50 lbs (constantly throughout shift if packaging), must be able to ascend and descend ladders, climb stairs, stoop, kneel, bend, crouch and crawl. Must be able to work in a dusty environment where temperatures vary from extremely hot to cold, work in humidity and around various chemicals.

Physical Requirements

Must be able to operate automatic and manual packers, set bag weights, operate bulk bag filling station, operate forklifts, assist operator in monitoring automatic pack out system. Troubleshoots and solves problems, services equipment, and cleans the plant. Must comply with all company and GMP/FDA rules and regulations and complete annual GMP training. Assists in ensuring top quality housekeeping is maintained. Performs other duties as directed by Production Supervisor.

High School Diploma
GED

title: PRU017T
description:
This is a remote/ rotational position, working in Prudhoe Bay, AK. The typical schedule is 84 hours per week (40 hours straight time and a minimum of 44 hours at time and a half). All meals and lodging are provided by Worley while the employee is on location. Transportation between Anchorage and Prudhoe Bay is provided.

Worley offers a competitive benefits package, with company paid short-term disability, life insurance, paid sick leave, and 4.5% employer match on 401k.

Job Purpose\:

Installs, maintains and repairs electrical systems, equipment, wiring and controls in a petrochemical facility.

Essential Job Functions\:

  • Responsible for maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, installation and construction of industrial electrical equipment and systems found in an industrial or commercial environment through the proper use of standard wire, conduit, fittings and hardware commonly found in industrial plants.

  • Reads and understands conduit drawings, schematics, drawings, and specifications.

  • Responsible for use and care of the tools and equipment commonly employed in industrial construction such as hydraulic/electric benders, knockout punch sets, cable puller, meggers, hi-pot equipment, volt meters, multi-testers and ammeters.

  • Able to set and coordinate overcurrent protective devices, size feeder circuits and work on systems up to and including 13.8 kV.

  • Must be able to follow all company, client, safety and regulatory requirements, including, but not limited to, policies, procedures, standards and guidelines as they relate to this position and the work duties being performed.

  • Bend, cut, thread and install conduit.

  • Install and terminate wiring.

  • Check out and troubleshoot simple electric circuits and electrical devices and machinery.

  • Accountable for testing, troubleshooting, setting and calibrating power distribution systems, while working with protective relaying and motor control circuits.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities\:

  • Possesses current knowledge of Journeyman Electrician, have Physical Fitness Card and an understanding of organizational practices.

  • Basic understanding of electrical circuits including the operation and function of typical electrical devices and machinery such as solenoids, relays, motors, transformers, switches, motor control centers, generators, batteries and lighting systems.

  • Possess an excellent knowledge of the National Electric Code.

  • Adequate written and oral communications applicable to standards set by organization.

  • Ability to interpret electrical drawings and schematics.

  • Proficient in NFPA70E.

Physical Demands/Work Environment\:


Work is performed in a remote Arctic environment with limited medical resources. Candidate understands the site is approximately 840 miles (at least 4 hours by air ambulance) from surgical, specialist, and tertiary medical care, and where medical evacuation from this location may be significantly delayed due to weather conditions. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the essential functions of this job, the employee is required to\:

  • Must have ability to stand, walk on level, uneven and slippery surfaces, sit, squat, kneel, crawl, reach through low and high ranges, work overhead, and exhibit normal balance and coordination. These basic physical requirements are essential for safe performance of the job in harsh environments with exposure to very cold temperatures and while wearing arctic gear.

  • Standing for prolonged periods of time.

  • Driving for prolonged periods of time in the dark and inclement weather

  • Ability to climb scaffold, ramps, stairs, equipment, portable ladders, and/or wellhouse/tank/facility fixed ladders of 20 feet or greater.

  • Ability to wear and utilize fall protection within manufacturer specifications.

  • Lift 50 lbs. from floor to waist with two hands.

  • Lift 50 lbs. from floor to shoulder with two hands.

  • Carry 50 lbs. for 15 feet with two hands.

  • Push/pull 60 lbs. sled for 20 feet.

  • Push/pull 90 lbs. cart for 20 feet.

This job description is intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of the job incumbents. Worley provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, including both applicants and employees, to allow the individual to perform the essential functions of the job, unless doing so would create an undue hardship.

In-Vehicle Monitoring System\: As part of our commitment to safety and accountability, company vehicles are equipped with in-cab cameras and vehicle monitoring systems. These systems may record video and audio, as well as collect GPS location, vehicle speed, harsh braking, rapid acceleration and other driving behaviors. All data is subject to review by management to ensure compliance with company policies and safe driving practices.

title: Business Technology Solutions Manager
description:
SUMMARY

The Business Technology Solutions Manager is responsible for on going management of the cross service line technology solution, including facilities, projects, space/occupancy planning, energy, and business analytics technologies. The role is accountable for interfacing directly with the client and with multiple business units within BGIS, with BGIS Information Technology and client account to ensure that the technology solution meets contractual requirements and enables the successful delivery of BGIS services. This includes client and BGIS end user support and administration as well as supporting new internal or client driven initiatives. The individual influences the activities of business and information technology individuals engaged in any IT related activities. The individual works with various BGIS and client concerned parties to determine priorities, escalate issues or concerns, set expectations, and ensure resolution.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Account Business Technology Management

  • Builds relationships with the multiple concerned parties within account, client and with BGIS w leads.

  • Monthly and quarterly reporting of IT related metrics and KPI’s.

  • Contributes to the prioritization of incoming work to ensure initiatives meet client requirements, in particular in understanding and documenting business needs.

  • Monitors corporate IT’s efforts for special projects and initiatives in requirements gathering, approvals, solution creation phase through to the entire software development lifecycle for the account.

  • Identifies IT system risks and client escalations and raises those risks to corporate IT for management through mitigation strategies, and plan or implement contingencies where necessary.

  • Communicates initiative status and risks to internal and external concerned parties including account leadership and client. Reports on initiative progress against timelines and budgets.

  • Develops and maintains relationships with operations and other BGIS teams to deliver quality and timely products.

  • Supports customer-initiated Information Security Reviews and coordinates with corporate Information Security and other resources to obtain responses in a timely manner.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Communicates to the client on behalf of BGIS of the status of IT and BI dashboard initiatives.

    • Engages with the client and with BGIS IT and BI teams to ensure client requests are reasonable and actionable and that they are within the parameters of the contract.

  • Represent the customer as a concerned party in discussions with BGIS corporate. The role must represent client needs and interests in planning and delivery communications, streamlining the process of project delivery and planning.

  • Work with client to develop a roadmap of future client needs / initiatives. Ensure client roadmap coalesces and aligns with BGIS corporate direction and proper funding and approval is obtained where required.

BGIS Corporate Communication

  • Stay connected with and follow corporate processes for initiative sharing and prioritization:

    • Alignment meetings for awareness of ongoing corporate initiatives

      • Project Proposal Process for initiative submission

      • Change Advisory Board process for releases

    • Follow up on outstanding requests with BGIS Corporate as needed via BGIS Corporate processes.

Initiative Management & Coordination (Coordination for small projects and initiatives with client and BGIS corporate)

  • Provide project management and project coordination for point in time initiatives to enhance / develop new projects with BGIS and client, including business intelligence dashboard maintenance and new development.

    • Drive initiatives & maintain schedule of key milestones and delivery dates.

    • Collaborate and oversee BGIS technical delivery teams to ensure BGIS can deliver on reasonable client expectation.

  • Support BGIS ticket management and escalation as required.

    • Follow BGIS Corporate process similar to SIM role.

User Support, Training and System Administration

  • Client and BGIS end user support (BGIS Assist and RealConnect).

    • System configuration, permission management, and release coordination with corporate BI and IT teams (RealConnect).

    • User administration and audit following corporate IT processes (RealConnect).

    • Development of account specific user guides, quick reference guides, training videos and other system training materials.

    • Client and BGIS user training (RealConnect).

    • Coordinate with client and BGIS IT teams as required for any client supported initiatives (i.e. on-site internet connectivity, client document repository, etc.)

Process Automation & Data Analytics

  • Working with the account Governance lead and other account Team Leads to maintain and enhance the data quality plan and measure data quality through business intelligence dashboards and other means.

    • Ability to develop & manage customer user interfaces for applications with software tools such as: Microsoft Power Apps.

    • Ability to develop & manage automated workflows and integrating applications using software such as: Microsoft Power Automate.

    • Strong Data Analysis & Summarization capability (e.g. consolidating various sources of data and in tools such as MS Excel, Power BI, and presenting findings in a concise manner).

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • University or college degree in a related discipline (Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Technology) or equivalent technical training (e.g. CBAP, PMP, LEAN Six Sigma).

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience.

  • Skilled business management ability and business acumen.

  • Skilled at influencing, persuading and negotiating with client representatives at the management level.

  • Skilled at building and managing relationships with client representatives at management level.

  • Exceptionally skilled at managing client expectations.

  • Possesses a continuous improvement and quality mindset along with a desire to continuously seek and incorporate innovative practices and technologies in order to deliver value to the client.

  • Computer proficiency in MS Office applications in particular – MS Project, MS Excel, MS Outlook, along with ability to quickly learn new applications.

  • Experience in the Real Estate or Facilities Management domain is desirable. Proven expertise on all aspects of software development from business analysis, development, quality assurance, database architecture.

Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation

  • None required.

This is a regular, full-time position with a salary range of $84,493 - $105,616 per annum. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role.

title: Director of Food and Beverage
location: Marina Del Rey, CA, United States
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Functions as the strategic business leader of the property’s food and beverage/culinary operation, including Restaurants/Bars, Room Service and Banquets/Catering, where applicable. Position oversees the development and implementation of departmental strategies and ensures implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives. The position ensures the food and beverage/culinary operation meets the brand’s target customer needs, ensures employee satisfaction, and focuses on growing revenues and maximizing the financial performance of the department. Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, event management, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, event management, or related professional area.

Skills and Knowledge

• Customer and Personal Service - Knowledge of principles and processes for providing customer and personal services. This includes customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction.

• Management of Financial Resources - Determining how money will be spent to get the work done, and accounting for these expenditures.

• Administration and Management - Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, human resources modeling, leadership technique, production methods, and coordination of people and resources.

• Applied Business Knowledge - Understanding market dynamics, enterprise level objectives and important aspects of the company’s business to accurately diagnose strengths and weaknesses, anticipate opportunities and risks, identify issues, and develop strategies and plans. Aligning individual and team actions with strategies and plans to drive business results.

• Management of Material Resources - Obtaining and seeing to the appropriate use of equipment, facilities, and materials needed to do certain work.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Developing and Maintaining Food and Beverage/Culinary Goals

• Sets expectations and holds food and beverage leadership team accountable for demonstrating desired service behaviors.

• Reviews financial reports and statements to determine how Food and Beverage is performing against budget.

• Makes recommendations for CAPEX funding of food and beverage equipment and renovations in accordance with brand business strategy.

• Works with food and beverage leadership team to determine areas of concern and develops strategies to improve the department’s financial performance.

• Establishes challenging, realistic and obtainable goals to guide operation and performance.

• Strives to improve service performance.

Developing and Maintaining Budgets

• Develops and manages Food and Beverage budget.

• Monitors the department’s actual and projected sales to ensure revenue goals are met or exceeded and opportunities are identified and addressed.

• Ensures cash control and liquor control policies are in place in food & beverage areas and followed by all related employees.

• Focuses on maintaining profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.

Leading Food and Beverage/Culinary Team

• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

• Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

• Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.

• Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.

• Develops means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc.

• Identifies opportunities to increase profits and create value by challenging existing processes, encouraging innovation and driving necessary change.

• Ensures that regular, on-going communication occurs in all areas of food and beverage (e.g., pre-meal briefings, staff meetings, culinary team).

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with direct reports and entire food & beverage team. Ensures direct reports do the same for their team.

• Develops a food and beverage operating strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.

• Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.

• Stays aware of market trends and introduces new food and beverage products to meet or exceed customer expectations, generate increased revenue and ensure a competitive position in the market.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

• Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.

• Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.

• Reviews findings from comment cards and guest satisfaction results with F& B team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.

• Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.

• Empowers employees to provide excellent guest service.

• Estimates cost and benefit ratio, maintaining balance between profit and service satisfaction.

• Shares plans to take corrective action based on comment cards and guest satisfaction results with property leadership.

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.

• Coaches and supports food & beverage leadership team to effectively manage wages, food & beverage cost and controllable expenses (e.g., restaurant supplies, uniforms, etc.).

• Hires food & beverage leadership team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.

• Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance.

• Ensures that expectations and objectives are clearly communicated to subordinates; subordinates are also open to raise questions and/or concerns.

• Brings issues to the attention of Human Resources as necessary.

• Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.

• Coaches team by providing specific feedback to improve performance.

Additional Responsibilities

• Informs and/or update the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.

• Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

• Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

• Estimate food, liquor, wine, and other beverage consumption in order to anticipate amounts to be purchased or requisitioned.

• Order and purchase equipment and supplies.

title: Financial auditor EU-fondsen
description:
Dit ga je doen

“Ik draag bij aan een slagvaardige Europese Unie! Dagelijks zet ik mij in voor de ontwikkeling van Nederland en Europa. Ja, daar krijg ik energie van. Mijn job is veelzijdig, uitdagend en leerzaam. De projecten, werkzaamheden en organisaties die ik onderzoek zijn heel verschillend; de ene keer verdiep ik me in het Europese subsidiebeheer en de andere keer voer ik een staatssteun-analyse uit.” Ousama Abouyakob, Projectleider EU-audits
Alle lidstaten van de Europese Unie ontvangen geld van de Europese Commissie, dit geld is verdeeld over diverse fondsen. Voor Nederland is de Auditdienst Rijk de auditautoriteit die deze geldstromen controleert. Maak jij het verschil door jouw auditexpertise, samenwerkingsgerichtheid en nieuwsgierigheid? Lees dan verder over de functie van auditor EU-audits.

Welke werkzaamheden ga jij uitvoeren:

  • Je voert een mix van auditactiviteiten uit zoals financial audits, compliance audits, system audits (inclusief IT) en performance audits.
  • Je voert controles uit én hebt een adviserende rol. Zo richt je je bijvoorbeeld op verbeteringen van systemen en interne beheersingsprocessen binnen Nederland. Daarnaast krijgen actuele belangrijke onderwerpen, denk aan duurzaamheid, steeds meer een plek in je controleaanpak.
  • Je controleert projecten bij bedrijven, organisaties uit de landbouw- en visserijsector, de overheid (Rijk, provincies en gemeenten) en instellingen die overheidstaken uitvoeren, zoals gevangenissen en scholen. Tijdens deze controles krijg je te maken met de meest uiteenlopende thema’s. Zoals de innovatie van hoogwaardige scanapparatuur voor ziekenhuizen, het opleiden van werklozen ter vergroting van hun arbeidsmarktperspectief, en het verstrekken van steun aan boeren op grond van oppervlakteberekeningen met behulp van satellietbeelden.
  • Je adviseert de subsidieverstrekker over diverse aspecten van de management- en controlesystemen, zoals de aanpak van fraude, de verbetering van IT-omgeving en de effectiviteit en efficiency van de subsidieprocessen.

Kortom: jij controleert bij ons verschillende EU-subsidieprojecten met een gezonde dosis nieuwsgierigheid en zelfstandigheid. Hierbij draai je vanaf de eerste dag mee met onderzoeken en word je verder opgeleid in specialistische onderwerpen, zoals Europese aanbestedingen, staatssteun en de inzet en beoordeling van financiële instrumenten. Voor een overzicht van de fondsen zie Fondsen Europa om de Hoek | Europa om de hoek.
Word jij de nieuwe collega van Ousama? Of wil je liever eerst eens praten over jouw misschien wel toekomstige werkzaamheden? Neem dan contact op met Suzanne Brom, sectormanager EU, via 06 – 21 94 23 89.

Dit bieden we nog meer

Naast het salaris ontvang je een individueel keuzebudget (IKB). Het IKB bestaat uit geld (16,5% van je brutojaarsalaris) en tijd. Met het IKB maak jij de keuzes die bij jou passen en kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Je kunt er bijvoorbeeld voor kiezen om een deel van je maandinkomen te laten uitbetalen wanneer jij dat wenst. Ook kun je dit budget omzetten in verlof en andersom of besteden aan fiscaalvriendelijke doelen. De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer verschillende studiefaciliteiten, bedrijfsfitness, volledige vergoeding van je ov-reiskosten woon-werkverkeer en gedeeltelijk betaald ouderschapsverlof.

Dit vragen wij

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding Accountancy.
  • Minimaal twee jaar actuele werkervaring binnen de externe audit of financiële auditpraktijk, bijvoorbeeld bij een accountantskantoor of interne auditdienst.
  • Ervaring met het uitvoeren van controlewerkzaamheden volgens professionele auditstandaarden.

Herken jij jezelf ook hierin?

  • Je bent enorm leergierig, wilt de onderste steen boven halen en legt risico’s bloot.
  • Je kunt flexibel schakelen tussen verschillende rollen en hecht niet aan een vaste werkplek of omgeving.
  • Je vindt het plezierig en zinvol om relaties op te bouwen. Ook samenwerken gaat je goed af.
  • Je wilt investeren in je toekomst én vindt het een voorrecht om bij te dragen aan het algemeen belang.
  • Je ambieert werken in een politiek dynamische omgeving en krijgt energie van de internationale context waarbinnen je opereert.

Hier kom je te werken

Meer over SG-Cluster

De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) is de onafhankelijke interne auditdienst van de Rijksoverheid. In opdracht van alle ministeries onderzoeken wij of beleid, processen, systemen en geldstromen betrouwbaar, doelmatig en goed beheerst zijn. Daarmee helpen we de overheid om beter te functioneren en publiek geld zorgvuldig te besteden.

De ADR telt ruim zeshonderd medewerkers met verschillende achtergronden, zoals accountancy, bestuurskunde, IT, data-analyse, psychologie en kunstmatige intelligentie. Een groot deel werkt in de financial audit. Daarnaast werken collega’s als IT-auditor, operational auditor of auditor EU-fondsen.

De sector EU bestaat uit ruim 40 collega’s met verschillende expertises, ervaringen en achtergronden. Als auditor EU-fondsen werk je in één van de multidisciplinaire projectteams bestaande uit auditors met een diverse achtergrond, juristen, IT’ers en collega’s met projectmanagement vaardigheden. Natuurlijk is er ook ruimte om voor verschillende EU-fondsen werkzaamheden te verrichten. Kortom, je werkt in een divers en dynamisch team, waarbij persoonlijke en professionele groei centraal staan.

Er heerst een prettige, open en informele werksfeer, waarbij onderlinge samenwerking centraal staat. Jouw ontwikkeling is essentieel. Zo is er ook de mogelijkheid om naast je werk door te studeren, bijvoorbeeld door een post-masteropleiding tot registeraccountant te volgen of te continueren. Hierin neem je de verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen kansen en ontwikkeling.

Audit EU-fondsen | Onze vakgebieden | Auditdienst Rijk

SG-Cluster

Over Ministerie van Financiën

Samen werken aan een financieel gezond Nederland

Het werk van het ministerie van Financiën gaat over meer dan cijfers en geld alleen. Het gaat over mensen zoals jij en ik. Mensen met verwachtingen, zorgen, vragen, dromen en plannen. We rekenen bijvoorbeeld allemaal op financiering voor goede zorg en goed onderwijs. Op duidelijkheid over belastingtarieven en op betrouwbare banken en verzekeraars, in Nederland en daarbuiten. En we rekenen allemaal op duidelijkheid over exportregels en wat we wel en niet mee mogen nemen vanuit de vakantiebestemming.

Het ministerie van Financiën luistert naar wat er speelt in de samenleving van vandaag en heeft aandacht voor hoe Nederlanders hun toekomst zien. Met die kennis en inzichten leggen we samen met andere ministeries en binnen ons internationale netwerk de juiste verbindingen en brengen we Nederland verder. We zorgen ervoor dat Nederland en onze economie klaar zijn voor de steeds sneller veranderende wereld van morgen. Op alle fronten. Dat gaat niet vanzelf. En natuurlijk is daar ook geld voor nodig. Dat geld brengen burgers en bedrijven via belastingen bijeen, en verdeelt de overheid over zaken die we als samenleving belangrijk vinden. Daarvoor moeten er keuzes worden gemaakt en worden ingegrepen als dat nodig is. Om ons land financieel gezond te houden, moet onze economie namelijk in balans blijven en tegelijk ook ruimte krijgen om te groeien.

Samen zorgen we ervoor dat er in Nederland kansen zijn voor welvaart en groei voor iedereen, vandaag, morgen en daarna. Samen werken we aan een financieel gezond Nederland.

Onze kernwaarden: integer, deskundig, duidelijk, durf en samenwerken zijn leidend voor ons gedrag en geven ons een gezamenlijke taal, waarmee we onderling bespreekbaar maken wat we doen en hoe we dat doen.

Lees meer over het ministerie van Financiën:

Ministerie van Financiën

Bijzonderheden

We willen dat iedereen zich thuis voelt bij het ministerie van Financiën en zichzelf volledig kan ontwikkelen. Want samen werken aan een financieel gezond Nederland is waar we voor staan. Dit doen we vanuit verschillende perspectieven, achtergronden en inzichten, omdat we geloven dat dit onze denkkracht vergroot. Iedereen is welkom ongeacht culturele achtergrond, leeftijd, arbeidsvermogen, gender of seksuele geaardheid. Met jouw unieke bijdrage spelen we beter in op de behoeften uit onze samenleving.

  • Draag jij graag bij aan een financieel gezond Nederland? Je bent van harte welkom. Solliciteren kan door je cv en motivatie in te sturen. Maar we staan ook open voor andere vormen, zoals een video- (met bijgevoegd je cv) of presentatie-sollicitatie (in PowerPoint). In het laatste geval plak je de link van je sollicitatie in een pdf- of word-bestand. Zo kunnen we je sollicitatie goed verwerken.
  • De selectieprocedure bestaat uit twee gesprekken en een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek. De eerste ronde sollicitatiegesprekken staat gepland op woensdag 2 december. De tweede ronde vindt plaats op dinsdag 8 december.
  • De inschaling voor deze functie vindt plaats op basis van kennis en ervaring.
  • De keuze voor een nieuwe baan kan best spannend zijn. We richten jouw overstap daarom zo persoonlijk mogelijk in. Via een introductiebijeenkomst en een onboarding app helpen we je om je weg te vinden en leer je hoe alles werkt binnen Financiën. Heb je nog vragen over de vacature of het selectieproces? Neem dan vooral contact met ons op. We helpen je graag in je overweging.
  • Wanneer je solliciteert op een functie maak je eenmalig een account aan. Met je account kan je de status van je sollicitatie inzien.
  • Wanneer de inschrijving van de vacature is gesloten zal de vacaturetekst online niet meer zichtbaar zijn. Mocht je deze op een later moment terug willen lezen dan adviseren wij je een kopie van de vacaturetekst op te slaan.
  • Heb je een studieschuld? Dan kun je vanaf 2025 maximaal € 2.000 per jaar aflossen met je Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB‐budget). Het aflossen van je studieschuld is een fiscaalvriendelijk doel. Dit betekent dat je over het bedrag wat je aan dit doel besteedt, geen belasting hoeft te betalen.

title: Commercial Property Manager
description:
BFO Management is seeking an experienced, hands-on Property Manager to join our team in Boca Raton, Florida. This position will be responsible for overseeing and supporting our portfolio of commercial properties located throughout Florida, South Carolina, Georgia, and New Jersey.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, professional, and comfortable managing multiple properties, tenants, vendors, projects, and priorities simultaneously. This is not strictly a desk position—we are looking for someone who takes ownership of their properties and is willing to be actively involved in day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of assigned commercial properties across FL, SC, GA, and NJ.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for tenants and respond promptly and professionally to tenant concerns and requests.
  • Conduct regular property inspections and identify maintenance, safety, appearance, and operational issues.
  • Coordinate repairs, preventative maintenance, and capital improvement projects.
  • Manage and communicate with vendors, contractors, landscapers, cleaning companies, security providers, HVAC contractors, plumbers, electricians, and other service providers.
  • Obtain and compare vendor proposals and ensure work is completed properly, on time, and within approved budgets.
  • Review vendor invoices and confirm that work has been completed before approving invoices for payment.
  • Assist with annual property budgets, operating expenses, CAM expenses, and expense tracking.
  • Monitor tenant compliance with lease requirements and coordinate lease-related matters with management and legal counsel when necessary.
  • Assist with tenant move-ins, move-outs, renewals, expansions, and property turnover.
  • Coordinate with leasing, accounting, maintenance, legal, and executive management.
  • Maintain organized property records, contracts, certificates of insurance, inspection reports, permits, warranties, and vendor documentation.
  • Track open maintenance items and projects through completion.
  • Assist with insurance claims and property-related incidents when necessary.
  • Help ensure properties remain clean, safe, properly maintained, and professionally presented.
  • Assist with construction, renovations, tenant improvements, and other special projects.
  • Provide regular updates to senior management regarding property conditions, tenant issues, outstanding projects, expenses, and priorities.
  • Travel to properties outside of Florida as needed.
Qualifications

  • Previous commercial property management experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple properties or a multi-state portfolio is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of commercial leases, CAM expenses, property maintenance, vendor management, and tenant relations.
  • Excellent organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable communicating with tenants, contractors, attorneys, brokers, executives, and ownership.
  • Ability to review proposals, invoices, contracts, and property-related documentation.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office; experience with Yardi or similar property management software is preferred.
  • Must be comfortable working independently and taking ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.
  • Ability and willingness to travel to properties in Florida, South Carolina, Georgia, and New Jersey as needed.
What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who does more than simply report problems. The successful candidate will identify issues, develop solutions, follow through, and make sure the job gets completed.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys being involved in all aspects of commercial real estate operations and wants the opportunity to manage a diverse portfolio while working closely with ownership and senior management.

Position Details

Location: Boca Raton, FL
Company: BFO Management
Position: Full-Time Property Manager
Portfolio: Commercial properties throughout Florida, South Carolina, Georgia, and New Jersey
Travel: Required as needed
Compensation: Competitive and based on experience

Qualified candidates are encouraged to submit their resume along with a brief description of their commercial property management experience.
