  • Provide technical and non-technical range operation and maintenance, including booking management, site preparedness and support services.
  • Conduct inspection, maintenance and upkeep of all training areas and camp assets.
  • Capture TARM and EU performance metrics. Provide input into reporting to support the PAS Manager.

What You’ll Bring

  • Extensive experience in estate development and infrastructure management.
  • Strong understanding of Defence estate planning and compliance frameworks.
  • Excellent project management and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Proficiency in planning, budgeting, and reporting for infrastructure projects.
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in engineering, project management, or related fields.

More than anything, you’ll bring a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes for our clients.

Why Downer?
At Downer, we plan, create, and sustain essential public services across Australia and New Zealand. From hospitals to data centres and defence partnerships, we manage critical infrastructure that keeps communities thriving.

Downer is a sovereign-owned, ASX-listed Australian company and proud recipient of the Estate & Infrastructure Business of the Year (2025) and Prime Contractor of the Year for two consecutive years (2024, 2025). With over 80 years of support to the Australian Defence Force (ADF), our Base and Estate Management team delivers innovative solutions and integrated services to both the ADF and New Zealand Defence Force (NZDF).

What It Means to Belong at Downer
We’re proud of our high-performance culture and commitment to diversity, offering:

  • Training and development to support and diversify your career.
  • With 30% of vacancies filled internally you’ll find real opportunities to advance your career.
  • Perks@Downer: healthcare discounts, great savings on retail purchases, car purchases and much more.
  • Employee Assistance Program: professional support for you and your family when you need it most.

You want your work to matter and so do we. With over 26,000 people across Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific, our team is made up of individuals with unique perspectives, backgrounds, and ideas.

We know that diversity makes us stronger and we actively celebrate it through our commitment to inclusion and belonging.

We’re committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve and we welcome people of all ages, genders, sexual orientations, cultures, abilities, and lived experiences. We especially encourage applications from those whose voices have traditionally been underrepresented in our industry, including women, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples, Māori and Pasifika Peoples, veterans, people with disability, and neurodivergent individuals. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with this role, we’d still like to hear from you. If it feels like the right fit, apply - potential counts, and so do you.

As a WORK180 Endorsed Employer, we support flexibility that works for your life, inclusive leadership that values your voice, and equitable access to opportunity so you can do your best work and bring your whole self to it.

If you need support or adjustments through the recruitment process, just let us know, we’re here to help you put your best foot forward.

title: Leerarbeidsplaats Integrale Veiligheidskunde
description:
Ben jij maatschappelijk betrokken en geïnteresseerd in vraagstukken rondom radicalisering en extremisme? Wil jij bijdragen aan een veilig en veerkrachtig Delft? Dan hebben wij een uitdagende leerarbeidsplaats voor jou!

De gemeente Delft onderneemt actie als mensen radicaliseren, extremistische ideeën krijgen of groepen tegen elkaar opstoken. Dit doen we samen met politie, justitie en andere gemeenten vanuit de aanpak van radicalisering en extremisme. Ook werken we aan het voorkomen van radicalisering en extremisme. We werken samen met inwoners, maatschappelijke organisaties en andere overheidsinstellingen aan weerbaarheid. Samen staan we voor een veilig en veerkrachtig Delft voor iedereen. Vanaf 2027 starten we met een aangescherpte aanpak radicalisering en extremisme.

Jouw rol

Voor de Zorg- en Veiligheidskamer Delft zoeken wij een enthousiaste, zelfstandige en organisatorisch sterke derde- of vierdejaars student die ons team helpt bij het opzetten en uitrollen van de vernieuwde onderdelen preventie en signalering binnen de aanpak radicalisering en extremisme.

Samen met ons sta je aan de start van een gloednieuw preventief programma die de weerbaarheid van jongeren, professionals en ouders/verzorgers tegen radicalisering en extremisme versterkt. Jij helpt ons om dit programma in de praktijk te brengen. Je ondersteunt bij de praktische voorbereidingen en uitvoering, organiseert activiteiten en legt en onderhoudt contacten met scholen, jongerenwerk en maatschappelijke organisaties. Daarnaast ga je aan de slag met het inplannen van trainingen en voorlichtingen voor professionals. Hiermee zorg je ervoor dat onze partners radicalisering tijdig kunnen signaleren en weten hoe zij moeten handelen. Ook ondersteun je het team waar nodig bij andere werkzaamheden, zoals communicatie en monitoring en evaluatie. Je krijgt daarbij volop ruimte om zelfstandig zaken op te pakken en mee te denken over de praktische uitvoering van onze aanpak.

Je gaat voor 32 uur per week aan de slag voor de periode februari t/m december 2027. De indeling ziet er als volgt uit:

  • Januari – augustus: je treft samen met ons de voorbereidingen voor het preventieprogramma. Ook help je mee bij het organiseren van trainingen en voorlichtingen voor professionals, ondersteun je bij communicatiewerkzaamheden en monitoring en evaluatie.
  • September – december: je gaat samen met ons actief aan de slag met de uitvoering van het preventieprogramma. Daarnaast lopen de trainingen voor de professionals en de werkzaamheden van communicatie en monitoring en evaluatie ook door.

Dit ben jij

Wil jij deze bijzondere en vooral leerzame periode bij ons doorlopen? Dan zien wij graag het volgende terug:

  • Je bent derde- of vierdejaars student Integrale Veiligheidskunde of Safety and Security Management Studies aan de Haagse Hogeschool;
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
  • Een proactieve en zelfstandige werkhouding. Je neemt graag initiatief en maakt ruimte voor wederzijdse constructieve feedback;
  • Je bent organisatorisch sterk, werkt gestructureerd en houdt goed overzicht over verschillende werkzaamheden;
  • Je vindt het leuk om samen te werken met verschillende organisaties en professionals;
  • Affiniteit met maatschappelijke veiligheidsvraagstukken, in het bijzonder met radicalisering en extremisme, is een pré.

Ons aanbod

  • Een betaalde leerarbeidsplaats voor 32 uur per week, waarbij je een salaris ontvangt op basis van het wettelijk minimumloon Bedragen minimumloon 2026 | Minimumloon | Rijksoverheid.nl;
  • Een dynamische werkomgeving waarin je veel kunt leren van professionals binnen de gemeente en externe partners;
  • Begeleiding door vaste collega's en de mogelijkheid om met verschillende experts uit diverse vakgebieden samen te werken;
  • Aan de start te staan van een gloednieuw preventief programma om de weerbaarheid van jongeren, professionals en ouders/verzorgers tegen radicalisering en extremisme te versterken.

Onze organisatie

De gemeente Delft is een innovatieve en moderne werkgever. Je krijgt hier alle kans om je te ontwikkelen. Er heerst een toegankelijke en informele werksfeer waar we samen hard werken aan het bereiken van resultaten voor de stad en het bestuur.

Je komt te werken in een team dat zich dagelijks inzet voor een veiliger Delft en het versterken van de weerbaarheid van inwoners tegen radicalisering en extremisme. Er wordt nauw samengewerkt met diverse partners, waaronder andere lokale overheden, zorg- en hulpverleningsinstanties en maatschappelijke organisaties, om radicalisering en extremisme te voorkomen, signalen tijdig te herkennen en waar nodig passende maatregelen te treffen. Het team maakt onderdeel uit van de Zorg- en Veiligheidskamer Delft.

Kennismaken

Enthousiast geworden door wat je leest? We zien je sollicitatie graag uiterlijk 30 november tegemoet. De gesprekken vinden plaats in de week van 7 december.

Wil je inhoudelijk meer weten over deze functie? Neem dan contact op met Lili-Anne de Jongh via 06-53986038 of radicalisering@delft.nl.

title: Senior Principal, Program Management (IT Planning & Governance)
description:
Korean text will follow English.

Company Introduction

We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did I ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we are collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and establishing an unparalleled reputation for being leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce.
We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At Our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview

The Principal, IT Governance & PMO is responsible for driving IT governance, portfolio management, and Rhythm of Business (RoB) mechanisms across the technology organization. This role ensures technology initiatives align with business objectives, enterprise standards, and transformation priorities while providing governance, operational oversight, and executive visibility across strategic programs and services.
The role partners closely with business leaders, technology teams, and stakeholders to establish governance frameworks, manage strategic planning cycles, oversee portfolio performance, drive risk and compliance activities, and enable successful execution of enterprise technology initiatives.

What You Will Do

IT Governance & Strategic Alignment
• Develop, implement, and maintain IT governance frameworks, policies, standards, and operating mechanisms
• Ensure alignment of technology initiatives with enterprise objectives, transformation priorities, and organizational standards
• Monitor governance, security, risk, and compliance metrics, highlighting areas requiring leadership attention
• Drive continuous improvement of governance processes and operational effectiveness

Rhythm of Business (RoB) Management
• Own and coordinate planning and review cadences including Annual Operating Planning (AOP), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), and executive operating reviews
• Facilitate leadership forums, decision tracking, action management, and follow-up governance activities
• Establish reporting mechanisms, scorecards, and KPIs that drive accountability and transparency

PMO & Portfolio Management
• Develop and govern program management processes, tools, templates, policies, and performance metrics
• Provide oversight across strategic programs and initiatives, tracking milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery performance
• Drive cross-functional alignment and support resolution of delivery challenges and escalations
• Develop executive-ready dashboards, reports, and presentations for leadership review

Risk, Compliance & Operational Excellence
• Manage risk, issue, change, and compliance governance processes
• Ensure adherence to IT policies, regulatory requirements, and enterprise standards
• Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and operational efficiency
• Govern IT knowledge management practices and promote continuous improvement across the organization

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, or related field
• 7+ years of experience in Program Management, Portfolio Management, or Operations
• Experience establishing and operating governance frameworks, executive reporting, and operational review mechanisms
• Strong understanding of risk management, compliance, process improvement, and organizational governance
• Experience with performance metrics, KPI development, data analysis, benchmarking, and business process optimization
• Excellent presentation, written, and verbal communication skills
• Strong planning, organizational, and stakeholder management capabilities
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed environment

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience leading IT Governance, PMO, Portfolio Management, or Technology Operations functions
• Experience managing enterprise Rhythm of Business (RoB) processes, including AOP, MBRs, QBRs, and executive reviews
• Knowledge across multiple technology domains, including infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, and IT operations
• Experience working within ITIL-based service management environments
• Experience supporting business transformation, change management, and operational excellence initiatives
• Experience working within global, matrixed organizations and influencing senior stakeholders
• PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, Agile, Lean, or equivalent professional certifications preferred

Recruitment Process and Others

Recruitment Process
• Application Review - Job Fit Interview - Focus Interview – Offer
• The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances.
• Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e-mail address submitted at the application stage.

Details to Consider
• This job posting may be closed prior to the stated end date for application if all openings are filled.
• Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process.
• Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran's benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws.
• Job titles and responsibilities may be subject to change depending on the candidate's overall experience, etc. This will be communicated to the candidate at the appropriate time before the offer.
• Hiring may be restricted in case the legal qualifications required for hiring and work performance is not met.
• This is a full-time regular position and includes 12 weeks of probation period; provided, however, the probationary period may be either skipped, shortened or extended if necessary for business purposes.

Privacy Notice
• Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below.
https://www.coupang.jobs/en/privacy-policy

Document Return Policy
1. This notification is given pursuant to Article 11 (6) of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act.
2. A job applicant, who has applied but not been finally selected for a position at Coupang (the "Company"), may request the Company to return his/her hiring documents submitted pursuant to the Fair Hiring Procedure Act. However, this will not apply where the hiring documents were submitted via the website of the Company or e-mail, or where the job applicant submitted those documents voluntarily without a request from the Company. In addition, if the hiring documents were destroyed due to a natural disaster or any other reasons not attributable to the Company, such documents will be deemed to have been returned to the job applicant.
3. A job applicant who wishes to request the return of his/her hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above should fill out a "Request for Return of Hiring Documents" [Annex Form No. 3 in the Enforcement Rule of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act] and submit It by email (recruitingops@coupang.com). In such case, within fourteen (14) days from the date of identifying the receipt of the request, the Company will send the hiring documents to the job applicant's designated address via registered mail. Please be informed that the job applicant is required to pay the postage on the registered mail.
4. In preparation for a job applicant's request for the return of hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above, the Company shall retain the original hiring documents submitted by the job applicant for 180 days from the completion of the recruiting process. If no request is made until the end of this period, all his/her hiring documents will be destroyed immediately in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act.
5. The above paragraphs 1 - 4 shall only apply when the labor-related laws of Korea govern the application. They are otherwise not applicable.

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

IT Governance & PMO 담당 Principal은 기술 조직 전반에 걸쳐 IT 거버넌스, 포트폴리오 관리 및 Rhythm of Business(RoB) 메커니즘을 주도하는 역할을 담당합니다. 본 역할은 기술 이니셔티브가 비즈니스 목표, 엔터프라이즈 표준 및 전환 우선순위에 부합하도록 보장하며, 전략적 프로그램 및 서비스 전반에 걸쳐 거버넌스, 운영 감독 및 경영진 가시성을 제공합니다.
본 역할은 비즈니스 리더, 기술 팀 및 이해관계자들과 긴밀히 협력하여 거버넌스 프레임워크를 수립하고, 전략적 기획 주기를 관리하며, 포트폴리오 성과를 감독하고, 리스크 및 컴플라이언스 활동을 추진하며, 엔터프라이즈 기술 이니셔티브의 성공적인 실행을 지원합니다.

업무 내용

IT Governance & Strategic Alignment
• IT 거버넌스 프레임워크, 정책, 표준 및 운영 메커니즘을 개발, 구현 및 유지 관리
• 기술 이니셔티브가 엔터프라이즈 목표, 전환 우선순위 및 조직 표준에 부합하도록 보장
• 거버넌스, 보안, 리스크 및 컴플라이언스 지표를 모니터링하고, 리더십의 주의가 필요한 영역을 강조
• 거버넌스 프로세스 및 운영 효율성의 지속적인 개선 추진

Rhythm of Business(RoB) Management
• 연간 운영 계획(AOP), 분기별 비즈니스 리뷰(QBR), 월간 비즈니스 리뷰(MBR) 및 경영진 운영 리뷰를 포함한 기획 및 리뷰 주기를 주도하고 조율
• 리더십 포럼, 의사결정 추적, 액션 관리 및 후속 거버넌스 활동을 촉진
• 책임성과 투명성을 높이는 보고 메커니즘, 스코어카드 및 KPI를 수립

PMO & Portfolio Management
• 프로그램 관리 프로세스, 도구, 템플릿, 정책 및 성과 지표를 개발 및 관리
• 전략적 프로그램 및 이니셔티브 전반에 걸쳐 마일스톤, 리스크, 이슈, 의존성 및 전달 성과를 추적하며 감독을 제공
• 교차 기능 정렬을 추진하고, 전달 과제 및 에스컬레이션 해결을 지원
• 리더십 리뷰를 위한 경영진 수준의 대시보드, 보고서 및 프레젠테이션을 개발

Risk, Compliance & Operational Excellence
• 리스크, 이슈, 변경 및 컴플라이언스 거버넌스 프로세스를 관리
• IT 정책, 규제 요건 및 엔터프라이즈 표준 준수를 보장
• 프로세스 간소화, 자동화 및 운영 효율성을 위한 기회를 발굴
• IT 지식 관리 관행을 관리하고, 조직 전반의 지속적인 개선을 촉진

자격 요건

• 경영학 또는 관련 분야 학사 학위를 보유하신 분
• 프로그램 관리, 포트폴리오 관리 또는 운영 분야에서 7년 이상의 경험을 보유하신 분
• 거버넌스 프레임워크, 경영진 보고 및 운영 리뷰 메커니즘을 수립하고 운영한 경험이 있으신 분
• 리스크 관리, 컴플라이언스, 프로세스 개선 및 조직 거버넌스에 대한 높은 이해도를 보유하신 분
• 성과 지표, KPI 개발, 데이터 분석, 벤치마킹 및 비즈니스 프로세스 최적화 경험이 있으신 분
• 뛰어난 프레젠테이션, 문서 작성 및 구두 커뮤니케이션 역량을 보유하신 분
• 우수한 기획, 조직 관리 및 이해관계자 관리 역량을 갖추신 분
• 빠르게 변화하는 매트릭스 환경에서 다양한 우선순위를 관리한 경험이 있으신 분

우대 사항

• IT 거버넌스, PMO, 포트폴리오 관리 또는 기술 운영 기능을 5년 이상 리딩한 경험이 있으신 분
• AOP, MBR, QBR 및 경영진 리뷰를 포함한 엔터프라이즈 Rhythm of Business(RoB) 프로세스를 관리한 경험이 있으신 분
• 인프라, 클라우드, 사이버보안, 엔터프라이즈 애플리케이션, IT 운영 등 다양한 기술 도메인에 대한 지식을 보유하신 분
• ITIL 기반 서비스 관리 환경에서 근무한 경험이 있으신 분
• 비즈니스 전환, 변화 관리 및 운영 우수성 이니셔티브를 지원한 경험이 있으신 분
• 글로벌 매트릭스 조직에서 근무하며 시니어 이해관계자에게 영향력을 발휘한 경험이 있으신 분
• PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, Agile, Lean 또는 이에 상응하는 전문 자격증을 보유하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차
• 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
• 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동 될 수 있습니다.
• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항
• 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
• 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요한 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
• 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
• 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침
• 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.
https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류반환정책
1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.

5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Accountants & Auditors
description:
Turing is looking for candidates with strong experience in accounting, auditing, and financial reporting.

Role overview:
  • In this role, you will contribute to projects that help evaluate and enhance AI systems using your financial and analytical expertise.
  • No prior AI experience is required.
  • These projects will help you explore how AI can be leveraged to improve financial analysis, audit precision, and compliance automation across industries.

What does day-to-day look like:
  • Design and solve real-world accounting, audit, and financial reporting scenarios to test AI reasoning.
  • Write clear, structured explanations covering GAAP/IFRS standards, cost accounting, internal controls, and audit practices.
  • Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, clarity, and alignment with financial standards.
  • Collaborate with researchers to refine AI understanding of financial data interpretation, regulatory compliance, and professional audit methodologies.

Requirements:
  • 4+ years of experience as an Accountant, Auditor, or Financial Analyst.
  • Background in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • CPA, CA, or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Strong understanding of financial regulations, reporting standards, and audit processes.
  • Excellent English communication and reasoning skills.
  • Comfortable using web-based tools for data review and annotation.

Perks of freelancing with Turing:
  • Strong compensation (exact amount varies by project).
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer, potentially full-time.
  • Duration of projects: approximately 1 month, with the possibility for extension.

What Turing is NOT seeking from your expertise:
  • Confidential or proprietary information from any employer, university, etc.
  • Trade secrets or internal company or university data.
  • Specific client information or case details.
  • Any information that would violate NDAs, employment agreements or other confidentiality obligations.

About Turing:
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

title: Store Supervisor
description:
At Jackson Hewitt, and its independently owned and operated franchisees, we provide an invaluable service in guiding our clients through the tax codes, rules, and processes. We do this with integrity, quality, and consistency. The role you play is critical to our success and together we are “Working Hard for the Hardest Working Americans”. This is our mission and it’s a large part of why we work here. Together we are highly passionate about what we do, and how we can help our clients.

What you'll do here:
Under general supervision and in accordance with established company policies and procedures, the Store Supervisor (SS) participates in the management activities (staffing, productivity, tax prep work, marketing) for one office / kiosk within an assigned district. This position has access to and regularly works with information of a sensitive, highly confidential nature, and regularly deals with diverse matters which require a working knowledge of the business.
  • Supervises one or more seasonal hourly staff members at a single location or kiosk
  • Communicates with the Manager on the status of recruiting, interviewing and hiring of seasonal employees for assigned locations when applicable
  • Maximize customer service and increase sales
  • Performs administrative functions
  • Develops, reviews, approves, and monitors office work schedules and hours worked
  • Monitors associate performance to ensure adherence to quality standards, deadlines, and proper procedures, correcting errors or problems
  • Reviews productivity reports, discount reports, AAG, and other various reports and takes appropriate action where necessary
  • Maintains a comprehensible filing system for filing, acknowledged, rejected and complete tax returns
  • Prints client checks each morning and ensures timely distribution of refund checks
  • Follows up with all void/hold tax return clients to persuade them to return to the office and file their tax return
Skills you'll bring for success:
  • High School Degree or equivalent related business experience
  • Course of study in management or in tax preparation and/or accounting preferred
  • Previous tax preparation experience and possess a PTIN (Preparer Tax Identification Number)
  • One year of previous management or supervisory experience desired
  • Proficiency with a variety of computer software applications such as electronic mail, internet browser, Word, Excel, and accounting or tax preparation software

title: Lead Engineer - CMBD, Discovery & Intergration
description:
Job Title: Lead Engineer - CMBD, Discovery & Integration

GCL: E

Introduction to role:

Are you ready to own and elevate the ServiceNow CMDB that underpins operational resilience, security, and speed at a global scale? This is a rare opportunity to lead the technical spine of our digital enterprise—Discovery, Service Mapping, CSDM and integrations—so our teams can deliver life-changing medicines with confidence and pace.

In this role, you will set the standards, solve complex data and modeling challenges, and guide engineering teams to deliver a trusted, consolidated source of configuration truth. You will work across platform, cloud, security, infrastructure and application groups to ensure configuration data is accurate, transparent and actionable. Can you picture yourself diagnosing critical issues in minutes, enabling faster incident response, seamless change, and stronger risk decisions for thousands of colleagues worldwide?

Accountabilities:

  • Act as the technical authority for CI classes, attributes, and relationships. Optimize IRE rules and reconciliation precedence. Maintain a single, reconciled source of truth. Use CMDB Health, the 360-degree CMDB view, and the Data Manager tool to improve data quality continuously.
  • Discovery and Service Mapping Skills: Build, provide, and resolve issues in asset identification and the visualization of services for both on-premises and cloud environments, adjusting schedules, MID Servers, credentials, ranges, and patterns to improve coverage, precision, and dependability of application-to-infrastructure connections.
  • CSDM Modelling and Implementation: Define and socialize modeling patterns across Business Applications, Application and Business Services, Technical Services and Service Offerings; remediate legacy models and embed consistent, standards-based onboarding.
  • CMDB Integrations and Data Controls: Engineer robust Service Graph and IntegrationHub ETL integrations for cloud, endpoint, security and network sources; normalize and reconcile data across APIs, transforms and IRE with clear monitoring, exception handling and data-quality controls.
  • Standards, Reviews and Guidance: Set technical standards, challenge unnecessary customization, review solution designs and provide hands-on guidance to implementation teams to ensure scalable, maintainable outcomes.
  • Influence Across Multiple Functions: Partner with platform, cyber, cloud, infrastructure, network, architecture and application collaborators to align builds, resolve issues at speed and increase business value from configuration data.
  • Continuous Improvement and Automation: Use scripting, Flow Designer and ATF to automate quality checks, lifecycle controls and regression testing; drive an experimentation approach to simplify, standardize and scale.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent experience.
  • 8–12+ years of technology experience, including 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow CMDB / ITOM delivery and 2+ years in a technical lead capacity.
  • Experience delivering at least two major enterprise CMDB implementations or transformations, with strong hands-on experience in automated resource identification and service topology documentation.
  • Practical enterprise CSDM implementation experience, with expertise in CI class models, IRE, identification and reconciliation, and ITIL 4 configuration management practices.
  • Significant hands-on experience configuring and administering CMDB, Discovery, MID Servers, patterns, Service Graph Connectors and CMDB Health, with working-to-advanced knowledge of CMDB 360 and Data Manager.
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate multiple authoritative data sources through IntegrationHub ETL, REST/SOAP APIs and transform maps, including AWS and/or Azure environments.
  • Proficiency in ServiceNow scripting and automation, encompassing JavaScript, developing with Flow Designer features and Business Rules, plus platform governance with update sets, Automated Test Framework (ATF) and release management.
  • Experience leading technical delivery, mentoring engineers and handling third-party or outsourced service provider resources.
  • Strong analytical and root-cause skills in fixing issues within large enterprise environments, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical collaborators.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Relevant ServiceNow certifications in system administration, CMDB, Discovery or Service Mapping; ITIL 4 Foundation or above.
  • Experience in the biopharmaceutical or life sciences industry, or another regulated environment, including GxP.
  • Experience with ServiceNow Predictive Intelligence.
  • Experience with security exposure and vulnerability management tooling.
  • Experience working across cultures and time zones, including a Global Technology Centre operating model.
  • Experience with software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile and Scrum methodologies.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

Why AstraZeneca:

You will join a technology community that is scaling a bold digital and data-led strategy to transform how science moves from lab to patient. We bring diverse technologists and scientists together to spark new ideas, experiment through hackathons and real-world pilots, and ship solutions that simplify data, automate operations and unlock speed at enterprise scale. With meaningful investment, modern platforms and a culture that values kindness alongside ambition, your leadership will directly strengthen the backbone of our operations and help deliver medicines to people who need them faster.

Call to Action:

If you are ready to shape the CMDB foundation that accelerates discovery, fortifies resilience and multiplies impact, take the lead and make your mark today!

title: Assistent Inspecteur Import
description:
Dit ga je doen

De Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) zet zich dagelijks in voor veilige voedselketens, gezonde dieren en eerlijke handel. Als assistent inspecteur Import lever jij hier een directe bijdrage aan. In deze rol ondersteun je het toezicht op dierlijke producten die, aan de buitengrens van de EU, Nederland en de rest van Europa binnenkomen via de Rotterdamse haven. Je werkt nauw samen met (senior)inspecteurs en draagt bij aan zorgvuldige en goed onderbouwde keuringsbeslissingen.

Jouw rol als assistent inspecteur
Je voert in de zogenoemde ‘verlengde arm constructie’ veterinaire importcontroles uit, waarbij je samenwerkt met een (senior) inspecteur: met jouw kennis van bijvoorbeeld vlees, vis, pluimvee, wild of dierlijke bijproducten kom je tot een inhoudelijk keuringsadvies en op basis daarvan besluit de (senior)inspecteur of een zending wordt toegelaten tot de EU. Als startend assistent inspecteur word je gedurende 2 tot 3 maanden ingewerkt in het team onder begeleiding van een van de mentoren.

Je werkzaamheden vinden hoofdzakelijk plaats in de Rotterdamse haven, op veterinaire inspectiecentra in logistieke hallen en keurlokalen. Daarbij zijn jouw kerntaken:
• Uitvoeren van veterinaire importcontroles onder verantwoordelijkheid van een (senior)inspecteur
• Controleren van producten, verpakkingen en verzegelingen volgens wet- en regelgeving
• Nemen van monsters en uitvoeren van organoleptisch onderzoek
• Opstellen van keuringsadviezen voor zendingsbeslissingen
• Zorgdragen voor een juiste en volledige administratieve afhandeling
• Samenwerken met inspecteurs en externe partijen op de keurpunten
• Signaleren van bijzonderheden en proactief bijdragen aan verbeteringen in het werkproces

Tijdens de inspecties laat je je assisteren door de medewerkers van koel- en vrieshuizen en geef je invulling aan je rol als toezichthouder, waarbij je oog houdt voor een goede samenwerking met deze externe partijen.

De werkzaamheden worden uitgevoerd in roosterdiensten, voornamelijk op werkdagen tussen 06:30 en 14:00 uur, met incidenteel een avonddienst tot circa 20:00 uur. Om op locaties te kunnen komen krijg je de beschikking over een dienstauto. Indien noodzakelijk kan je ook team overschrijdend ingezet worden, bijvoorbeeld bij uitval of een crisissituatie.

Lijkt dit werk je impactvol, herken jij je in de functie-eisen en wil je je idealen om zetten in daden? Dan zien we graag je sollicitatie tegemoet.

Dit bieden we nog meer

Naast een inwerkprogramma dat past bij jouw functie en ruime opleidings- en/of coaching mogelijkheden voor jouw verdere professionele ontwikkeling, bieden we ook de onderstaande secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden:

Individueel Keuze Budget
Je krijgt een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) van 16,50% van je bruto jaarsalaris. Je kunt je IKB bijvoorbeeld laten uitbetalen, bijvoorbeeld per maand of per jaar, maar je kunt ook extra verlofuren kopen. Daarnaast kun je je IKB gebruiken om belastingvrij een (elektrische) fiets voor woon-werkverkeer aan te schaffen, je thuiskantoor in te richten, fiscaal voordelig je studieschuld af te lossen tot een max van €2000,- per jaar of zelfs je woning te verduurzamen. Om dit aan te moedigen biedt de Rijksoverheid bovenop het IKB hierbij ook een werkgeversbijdrage.

Vakantiedagen
Per jaar heb je recht op 144 vakantie-uren en 64 IKB-verlofuren, wanneer je 36 uur per week werkt. Werk je meer of minder? Dan worden deze uren naar verhouding berekend. En heb je wat minder behoefte aan vakantie? Dan kun je je er ook voor kiezen om je 64 IKB-verlofuren uit te laten betalen of laten toevoegen aan je IKB-spaarverlof

Reiskostenvergoeding
Je ontvangt een mobiliteitskaart waarmee je voor woon-werk verkeer 2e klas met de trein kunt reizen. Daarnaast kun je deze gebruiken voor dienstreizen indien je naar andere locaties moet voor je werk. Ga je met de fiets naar het werk? Dan ontvang je per gefietste kilometer een reiskostenvergoeding.
Indien het voor je werkzaamheden noodzakelijk is kun je onder bepaalde voorwaarden, die staan in de sub-autoregeling van de NVWA, in aanmerking komen voor een elektrische dienstauto. Dit betreft geen persoonlijke arbeidsvoorwaarde maar een dienstauto wordt ter beschikking gesteld op basis van de sub-autoregeling van de NVWA. Deze dienstauto mag je op basis van de bijtelling plus een eigen bijdrage ook privé gebruiken.

Verlofregelingen
Voor verschillende situaties kent het Rijk verlofregelingen, zoals (aanvullend) geboorteverlof (maximaal 5 weken 100% doorbetaald), ouderschapsverlof (maximaal 9 weken 100% doorbetaald in het eerste jaar en aanvullend 75% voor 4 weken), zorgverlof en adoptie-/pleegzorgverlof.

Pensioen
De Rijksoverheid heeft een aantrekkelijke pensioensregeling bij ABP, het Algemeen Burgerlijk Pensioenfonds. Lees hier meer over de pensioensregeling bij ABP.

Extra toeslagen en vergoedingen
Voor sommige functies bij de NVWA is het nodig om buiten de reguliere kantoortijden te werken of bereikbaar te zijn. Daar staan echter ook extra toeslagen of vergoedingen tegenover. Zo kennen wij een toelage bereikbaarheids- en beschikbaarheidsdienst en een toelage onregelmatige dienst.

Dit vragen wij

Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd en hebt oog voor detail. Tegelijkertijd ben je praktisch ingesteld en pak je werkzaamheden proactief op. Je communiceert helder en prettig met collega’s en externe partijen en weet goed samen te werken in een dynamische werkomgeving. Je bent betrouwbaar, klantgericht en houdt overzicht in je werkzaamheden, ook wanneer het druk is. In jouw rol combineer je een dienstverlenende houding met het vermogen om toezicht te houden en regie te nemen waar nodig. Van nature ben je leergierig en ontwikkel je snel in inhoudelijke kennis, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van roodvlees, vis, pluimvee, wild of dierlijke bijproducten.

Daarnaast zien we graag het volgende:
• Een afgeronde (relevante) mbo-opleiding
• Bij voorkeur al praktijkervaring binnen het werkgebied van importcontroles
• Digitale vaardigheden en het vermogen om systemen snel eigen te maken
• Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (mondeling en schriftelijk)
• Voldoende beheersing van de Engelse taal (leesvaardigheid)
• Vaardigheid in het interpreteren van wet- en regelgeving
• Bij voorkeur kennis van één of meerdere relevante expertisegebieden (zoals roodvlees, vis, pluimvee, wild of dierlijke bijproducten)
• Rijbewijs B

Competenties
• Samenwerken
• Flexibiliteit
• Mondelingen uitdrukkingsvaardigheid
• Voortgangscontrole

De NVWA werkt hard aan een maatschappelijk representatief personeelsbestand en hecht veel waarde aan een inclusief aannamebeleid. Wij moedigen daarom iedereen aan om te solliciteren, ongeacht (culturele)achtergrond, leeftijd, genderidentiteit, religie, Arbeidsbijzonderheid of geaardheid.

Hier kom je te werken

Meer over Handelstoezicht

Je komt te werken voor de afdeling Import van de NVWA, in een betrokken en professioneel team van circa 45 enthousiaste collega’s. Wat jullie bindt, is een gezamenlijke inzet voor voedselveiligheid en zorgvuldig toezicht aan de buitengrens van de EU.

De werkzaamheden vinden voornamelijk plaats in de Rotterdamse haven, een dynamische omgeving waar logistiek, handel en toezicht samenkomen. Je werkt op locatie in en rondom de veterinaire inspectiecentra, waar je samen met collega’s zorgt voor een soepel en zorgvuldig verloop van de importcontroles

Over Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

We vinden het in Nederland heel normaal dat de producten die we gebruiken en alles wat wij eten veilig is. Dat dieren goed worden behandeld, ook als ze voor de slacht bestemd zijn. Groente en fruit willen we gedachteloos kunnen consumeren en ook andere producten zijn ‘natuurlijk’ in orde. We willen onbekommerd in de natuur kunnen wandelen en speelgoed voor onze kinderen kopen zonder achterdocht. Als consumenten vertrouwen we daar gewoon op, voor ons is dat vanzelfsprekend.

Maar we vergeten soms dat bedrijven dagelijks hard werken aan die hoge standaard. Dat het voor ondernemers niet altijd makkelijk is om aan alle geldende wet- en regelgeving te voldoen. We vergeten ook dat de overheid daarop toeziet. Veiligheid klinkt zo eenvoudig, maar dat is het niet.

Wat doet de NVWA?
De medewerkers van de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) werken dagelijks hard om die standaard te behouden. In gesprek met ondernemers in de horeca, de slachterijen, de plantenteelt en met andere producenten ziet de NVWA toe op de voedsel- en productveiligheid, plantgezondheid en het welzijn van dieren, natuur en milieu. Met (inter)nationale wet- en regelgeving in de hand. We gaan uit van vertrouwen, maar tegen ondernemers die het niet zo nauw nemen, treden we stevig op. In het belang van de samenleving.

Wij kijken scherp waar de grootste risico’s zitten en waar toezicht het hardst nodig is, zodat we consumenten en anderen tijdig kunnen informeren. Ook heeft de NVWA een belangrijke rol bij exportkeuringen en bij de import van producten in Europa.

Waar staat de NVWA voor?
De NVWA is verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht op dierenwelzijn, diergezondheid, voedselveiligheid, productveiligheid, tabaks- en alcoholontmoediging, plantgezondheid en natuur en milieu.

De Rijksoverheid streeft ernaar een werkgever te zijn waar iedere medewerker, ongeacht leeftijd, sekse, geaardheid, etnische afkomst en arbeidsbeperking voor wil werken. Werken aan maatschappelijke vraagstukken in divers samengestelde teams maakt ons effectiever en innovatiever. Dat maakt het werk waardevol en uitdagend.

Bij de NVWA vragen we van medewerkers flexibiliteit om mee te bewegen met veranderende prioriteiten – bijvoorbeeld door taken binnen je expertise op te pakken, tijdelijk in een ander team te werken of nieuwe werkwijzen te omarmen. Dit gebeurt binnen de bandbreedte van je functie, in overleg met je manager, zodat jouw talenten en vakmanschap optimaal bijdragen aan onze doelen.

Wij werken in opdracht van de ministeries van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) en van Landbouw, Visserij, Voedselzekerheid en Natuur (LVVN). Zij maken het beleid en de regels waar bedrijven zich aan moeten houden.

Als toezichthouder doen wij controles en keuringen, en spreken bedrijven aan op hun rol in de maatschappij en de geldende regels. Als het nodig is grijpen we in.

Bijzonderheden

  • De sollicitaties worden volgens geldende afspraken in beschouwing genomen, waaronder de CAO Rijk- en NVP-sollicitatiecode.
  • Voor werken bij de NVWA is een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) vereist.
  • Betreft het een vacature met een arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op vast, dan wordt het vaste contract allereerst voorafgegaan door een jaarcontract. Bij gebleken geschiktheid volgt in beginsel na een jaar omzetting in een vast contract voor onbepaalde tijd.
  • Betreft het een vacature met een arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op vast, maar heb jij al een vast dienstverband als rijksambtenaar? Dan behoud je dit vast dienstverband.
  • Betreft de vacature in eerste instantie een functie voor bepaalde tijd, dan wordt deze vacature niet opnieuw opengesteld als deze functie vast ingebed kan worden in de organisatie en de (in eerste instantie) tijdelijke vacature vervuld werd door een interne medewerker met een vast dienstverband.
  • Een online screening via bijvoorbeeld zoekmachines of sociale media, kan onderdeel zijn van het selectieproces.
  • Een competentietest en/of een assessment kunnen deel uitmaken van de selectieprocedure.
  • Een uitgebreide screening A of B door de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) kan een vereiste zijn voor een aantal functies bij de NVWA, o.a. bij de Inlichtingen- en Opsporingsdienst (IOD).
  • Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.
  • Wij nemen je sollicitatie in behandeling en komen uiterlijk 10 werkdagen na de sluitingsdatum met een reactie.
  • Reageer jij op deze vacature als kandidaat met een voorrangspositie vanuit VWNW of arbeidsongeschiktheid (voorrangskandidaat)? Dan heb je naast je CV en motivatiebrief ook een aanwijs- en voordrachtbrief. De voordrachtbrief is gemaakt door de VWNW-manager. De extra documenten zoals de aanwijs- en voordrachtbrief kun je toevoegen door eerst je sollicitatie zonder aanwijs– en voordrachtbrief te verzenden en vervolgens door te klikken op de link in de bevestigingsmail van je sollicitatie. Na inloggen kun je dan de aanwijs- en voordrachtbrief toevoegen bij ‘Extra documenten’.

title: Parts Coordinator
description:
Job Summary:

Support the Newman service team by coordinating parts for planned repairs and breakdowns, processing and allocating orders, and maintaining accurate inventory and parts records. The role will monitor stock availability and delivery schedules, respond to parts enquiries and escalations, and coordinate the receipt, transfer and dispatch of parts.

The position will also provide occasional warehouse coverage and work closely with the service and warehouse teams to ensure parts are available when required.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Maintain a strong focus on safety and follow all HSE policies, procedures and requirements.

  • Coordinate parts requirements for planned repairs, breakdowns and field service work supporting the Newman operation.

  • Process and allocate parts orders accurately and ensure parts are available when required.

  • Monitor stock levels, parts availability and delivery schedules, escalating potential shortages or delays early.

  • Maintain accurate parts, inventory and order records within relevant systems.

  • Coordinate the transfer and movement of parts between Perth and Newman to support operational requirements.

  • Work closely with Service, Parts and Warehouse teams to prioritise urgent breakdown and repair requirements.

  • Respond to parts enquiries and follow up outstanding orders, backorders and delivery issues.

  • Support inventory control, including reviewing stock requirements and maintaining appropriate safety stock levels.

  • Assist with receiving, picking, packing and dispatch activities when warehouse support is required.

  • Identify and escalate discrepancies, damaged goods or supply issues that may impact customers or service operations.

  • Monitor and maintain Parts KPIs, including aged orders, backorders, open orders and outstanding parts requirements.

  • Communicate effectively with team members and support functions to ensure smooth operations.

  • Provide regular updates on outstanding and critical parts requirements to the service team.

  • Remain flexible and assist with additional duties as required to support the Newman operation.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

Competencies:

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Service, Parts and Warehouse teams.

  • Strong customer focus with the ability to understand priorities and respond to urgent operational requirements.

  • Takes ownership of parts requirements and follows through until orders are completed or issues are resolved.

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, including planned work and breakdown requirements.

  • Ability to monitor and maintain Parts KPIs, including aged orders, backorders, open orders and outstanding parts requirements.

  • Proactive approach to following up overdue orders, delivery dates and parts availability.

  • Good understanding of inventory management and maintaining appropriate stock levels to support operational requirements.

  • High level of accuracy when processing orders and maintaining parts and inventory records.

  • Ability to identify potential supply issues early and escalate where they may impact service delivery.

  • Sound problem-solving and decision-making skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while supporting a remote operation.

  • Commitment to safety, continuous improvement and delivering results.

  • Values and respects diverse perspectives and cultures.



Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

Proficiency in Microsoft applications, generating reports and advanced level computer skills.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires some work experience or intermediate level knowledge obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

  • Process and coordinate parts orders for the Service team, ensuring parts are correctly identified, ordered and allocated to the appropriate service jobs.
  • Plan parts requirements for breakdowns and planned repairs, working closely with Service Advisors to ensure parts are available when required.
  • Maintain appropriate safety stock levels for critical parts, monitoring usage and availability to support mining customer breakdowns and operational requirements.
  • Work closely with the Newman warehouse team to coordinate picking, receipting, issuing, returns and movement of parts, ensuring stock and job allocations remain accurate.
  • Provide occasional warehouse coverage at the Newman branch when required, assisting with day-to-day warehouse activities to maintain continuity of branch operations.

title: CRA I
description:
CRA I

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health
• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiological Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and with guidance develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • For the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes
    Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records
    Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete
    Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines
    Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical project data review and capture
    Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt, with the oversight of the Lead CRA, to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with project site personnel, or in collaboration with another CRA or Central Monitoring Associate (CMA). Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • For Real World Late Phase, the CRA I will use the business card title of Site Management Associate I. Additional responsibilities include:
    Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out
    Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs
    Chart Abstraction activities and data collection
    Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

Get to know Syneos Health


Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information


Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

title: Second de Patisserie (H/F)
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

With a guestbook signed by everyone from Elizabeth Taylor to Winston Churchill and an enviable perch overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, the palatial spread of the Grand-Hôtel du Cap-Ferrat, A Four Seasons Hotel has been the epitome of Côte d’Azur chic for more than a century. Véritable bras droit du service, vous contribuez à l'organisation quotidienne du laboratoire, à l'encadrement de la brigade et à la supervision des productions, tout en garantissant le respect des standards d'excellence Four Seasons.


Par votre expertise technique, votre sens de l'organisation et votre créativité, vous participez activement à offrir à nos clients une expérience gourmande mémorable.


Vos missions principales :

  • Contribuer à la valorisation des produits et à la réduction du gaspillage alimentaire.
  • Remplacer le Chef Pâtissier en son absence et assurer la continuité des opérations du service.

Profil recherché :


  • Français courant exigé.
  • Bon niveau d'anglais souhaité.
  • Formation en pâtisserie, cuisine ou hôtellerie-restauration.
  • Expérience significative en pâtisserie au sein d'un établissement de luxe, Palace ou restaurant gastronomique.
  • Excellente maîtrise des techniques de pâtisserie contemporaines et traditionnelles.
  • Solides compétences en management et en encadrement d'équipe.
  • Sens aigu du détail, de l'organisation et de la qualité.
  • Créativité, rigueur et passion pour l'excellence.
  • Maîtrise des normes HACCP et des règles de sécurité alimentaire.
  • Excellente présentation, réactivité et esprit d'équipe.

Votre créativité, votre leadership et votre passion pour l'excellence feront toute la différence !


Rejoignez l’équipe prestigieuse du Grand-Hôtel du Cap-Ferrat, A Four Seasons Hotel, et découvrez une carrière où le luxe rime avec excellence.

En tant que membre de notre famille Four Seasons, vous bénéficiez de nombreux avantages :

Rejoindre le Grand-Hôtel du Cap-Ferrat, A Four Seasons Hotel, c'est bien plus qu'un simple emploi. C'est intégrer une maison d'excellence, où chaque détail compte, et où votre bien-être est notre priorité.


À bientôt parmi nous !

title: Coordinator, Research Contracts
description:

About You

We are seeking a proactive Coordinator, Research Contracts to support the review, negotiation and management of research agreements within RMIT's Research and Innovation Portfolio. You'll bring strong organisational skills, sound judgement and the ability to manage competing priorities in a busy, fast-paced environment. A confident communicator and relationship builder, you'll enjoy working collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders to deliver positive outcomes.

Experience in contract management, legal administration, and an understanding of research grants will be highly regarded. A legal background or qualification is advantageous but not essential. Above all, you'll bring excellent attention to detail, a solutions-focused mindset and a commitment to delivering high-quality service.


To be successful in this position, you will have as a minimum:


  • A legal qualification and/or substantial experience in a legal, contracts or advisory role, preferably within higher education, research, government or a comparable complex environment. Ability to review and critique a wide range of draft funding and general commercial agreements, and to provide clear, concise feedback and advice to stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to work systematically and simultaneously on multiple projects with different levels of priority and complexity, whilst meeting deadlines in a timely manner.
  • Proven ability to pay close attention to detail and produce work that is of a high quality and accuracy.
  • Demonstrated ability to use initiative, judgement and problem-solving skills in order to provide creative and practical solutions to problems.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, in particular the ability to advise, influence and negotiate effectively and sensitively with staff from a range of workplace settings to build relationships and facilitate the desired action.
  • A proven track record in providing high quality, customer focused service.
  • Demonstrated high level of computer literacy including an understanding of available information communication technologies and how to apply these innovatively to work situations.

Please Note: Appointment to this position is subject to passing a Working with Children and National Police Check.

title: Pod Lead - Material Science
description:
About Turing:
Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:
  • We are seeking an experienced Materials Science expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
  • In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review materials science tasks for technical accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic computational materials research workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging scientific tasks.

What you'll do:
  • Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of materials science tasks.
  • Review scientific tasks end to end, including problem statements, crystal structures, interatomic potentials, thermodynamic databases, simulation inputs, reference solutions, and automated tests.
  • Validate tasks involving density functional theory (DFT), molecular dynamics, computational thermodynamics, phase diagrams, crystallography, materials characterization, mechanical properties, semiconductors, and energy materials.
  • Ensure tasks reflect realistic materials research workflows and require meaningful multi-step scientific reasoning rather than simple database lookups or library calls.
  • Verify scientific correctness across units, crystal symmetry, convergence criteria, electronic structure calculations, thermodynamic consistency, and simulation parameters.
  • Validate computational environments, scientific software, pseudopotentials, interatomic potentials, and dependencies to ensure reproducible results.
  • Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful scientific outputs such as lattice parameters, formation energies, band gaps, elastic constants, phonon properties, phase fractions, diffusion coefficients, and microstructure metrics.
  • Identify technical inaccuracies, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect numerical tolerances, and opportunities to bypass scientific calculations or simulations.
  • Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
  • Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

What we're looking for:
  • Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Materials Science, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, Fortran, or Julia, with proficiency in Linux and terminal-based environments.
  • Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: atomistic simulation, computational thermodynamics, mesoscale modeling, electronic structure calculations, or materials characterization data analysis.
  • Strong understanding of materials science fundamentals, numerical methods, computational modeling, and scientific validation.
  • Experience reviewing complex technical work, scientific code, computational simulations, manuscripts, or research outputs.
  • Ability to evaluate scientific assumptions, numerical accuracy, simulation convergence, and the reliability of computational results.
  • Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed scientific assumptions.
  • Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical or research teams.
  • Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

Nice to have:
  • Experience with computational materials science tools such as Quantum ESPRESSO, VASP, GPAW, ABINIT, LAMMPS, pymatgen, ASE, spglib, phonopy, pycalphad, MOOSE, FiPy, OVITO, or DREAM3D.
  • Experience with machine-learned interatomic potentials, high-throughput materials simulations, or materials databases such as Materials Project.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and high-performance computing (HPC) environments.
  • Experience developing scientific benchmarks, programming challenges, simulation-based evaluations, or automated grading systems.
  • Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated scientific solutions.
  • Industry experience in semiconductors, batteries, alloys, advanced materials, or manufacturing.
  • Publications, research contributions, or open-source development experience in computational materials science.
  • Prior experience in AI training, scientific quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

Offer Details:
  • Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: Research Fellow in Wireless Communications and Digital System Design
description:
• Full time Fixed term for 4 years at Camperdown
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research and strengthen national and international research excellence
  • Base Salary (Level B) $132,533 - $157,381 p.a + 17% superannuation


About the opportunity


The University of Sydney is seeking a Research Fellow in Wireless Communications and Digital System Design to join a high-performing research team and contribute to innovative research programs within the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Faculty of Engineering. Working under broad direction, you will apply your expertise in research methodologies, design and delivery to undertake high-quality research that advances knowledge in your discipline and enhances the University's reputation for research excellence.

The successful candidate will conduct original research, contribute to securing external research funding, develop productive collaborations with academic and industry partners, and support the development of emerging researchers and postgraduate students

Your key responsibilities will be to:


  • conduct original research independently and collaboratively, producing high-quality scholarly outputs

Mercy Palliative Care is a 24-hour community-based palliative care service providing in home care to people of all ages with life limiting illnesses. title: Director Central Maintenance
description:
EDP Renewables is a global leader in the renewable energy sector and the fourth-largest wind energy producer. With a sound development pipeline, first-class assets, and market-leading operating capacity, EDPR has undergone exceptional development in recent years and is currently present in 28 markets.

Our company is part of EDP, a global energy group present in around 30 markets with a particular emphasis on renewable energies. With more than 45 years of experience, we have been consolidating a relevant presence on the world energy scene based on the commitment to be all-green by 2030, leading the energy transition. With more than 13,000 employees around the world, we are committed to using our energy and heart to drive a better tomorrow.

What you will do:

The Director Central Maintenance will owns the strategy and day-to-day management of small and spare parts, inventory and purchasing for the EDPR Group across Wind, Solar, High Voltage and BESS. Leading a team of inventory coordinators and spare parts specialists, this role ensures the right parts are available at the right time and at the lowest total cost, and is a critical contributor to EDP Renewables’ financial and technical performance. The role works directly with sites, Procurement, Finance and Internal Audit, and manages the annual spare parts budget.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for small and spare parts across the Group, namely the North American fleet, from physical stock in SAP and work order consumption to MRP central purchasing, RFP contracts and contract management
  • Own the annual spare parts budget, track spend and usage against it, and explain variances to senior leadership
  • Lead RFP and framework agreement processes for consumables and spare parts, including awards, purchase orders and ongoing contract management with Procurement
  • Manage supplier relationships and escalations, including OEM delivery performance, pricing and lead times
  • Define and run inventory control: cycle counts, physical counts, and the related SOPs
  • Own and deliver Internal Audit actions on stock management, including the High Voltage small parts plan, with clear owners and dates
  • Extend the small parts model to High Voltage and other technologies, aligning scope with the relevant business leads
  • Drive standardisation of SAP processes and master data (materials, work order types, valuation) and support the rollout of Dynamics and the SAP S/4HANA transition
  • Develop, coach and manage the small parts team, including talent acquisition, performance, development conversations and team structure
  • Build consensus across cross-functional teams and influence decision-making of leadership audiences
  • Gather and analyze data, formulate and test hypotheses, and develop implementation plans that turn recommendations into results
  • Maintain a current view of industry best practices in spare parts optimisation and inventory management
  • Interface with sites, external suppliers and internal stakeholders up to Director level
  • Other duties as required to fulfill the job description

Direct reports: 12 Direct

Travel: up to 25%

Work place: Houston

What we are looking for:

  • BS/BA in a technical, engineering, supply chain or business field (Preferred)
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in spare parts, inventory management, materials or supply chain, preferably in wind, solar or other asset-intensive energy operations
  • Strong working knowledge of SAP (MM and PM), including work order types, material master and valuation; familiarity with Dynamics is a plus
  • Experience with RFPs, contract negotiation and supplier management
  • Familiarity with industry-leading practices for inventory control, cycle counting and spare parts planning
  • Ability and willingness to travel to operational sites within the US and Europe as needed
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license and the ability to operate a motor vehicle
  • Advanced skills in Analytical Problem Solving, Strong Communication, Customer/Partner Relationships, and Technology Expertise
  • Experience managing cross-functional projects or teams

Behavioral Requirements:

  • Ability to work in adverse weather conditions
  • Ability to work around low, medium, and high-voltage equipment
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of variables in situations where only limited standardization exists

Physical demands & working conditions:

  • Sitting/Standing/Flexibility: Ability to stand and sit for 8 or more hours when in an office environment.
  • Walking: Ability to walk .5 to 2 miles per day, including across unpaved and rough surfaces when on project sites.
  • Speech/Reading: Ability to speak, read, and write English proficiently and deliver a variety of instructions furnished in written, verbal, diagram, or schedule form.
  • Lifting: Ability to lift items weighing up to 10 pounds
  • Vision/Hearing: Ability to understand a variety of instructions furnished in written, verbal, diagram, or schedule form.
  • Safety: Ability to understand and communicate safety precautions when necessary

More than academic knowledge and technical skills, we are looking for ambitious people who are enthusiastic about the future and who bring human skills aligned with our purpose.

Our vision is that each person combines their unique characteristics and experiences to fulfill our mission of creating new energy for the planet. We are an inclusive employer, ensuring all candidates are treated fairly throughout the recruitment process. We welcome and value all people, and we are committed to fostering a sense of belonging for each person who is part of the EDP group.

description:
