This is a hands-on role running AI agents day to day and helping launch a new AI-powered marketing agency. The role is posted by OZK and reports directly to the owner of a portfolio of Northwest Arkansas businesses. OZK will be the agency's top-priority client.

Across the portfolio, most digital execution is handled by AI agents. The owner sets strategy, design and marketing direction; agents build websites, content, campaigns and workflows. You will keep those agents productive, catch their mistakes and turn repeatable work into systems.

At the same time, we are building an agency that acts as the AI department for client businesses, starting with OZK. Our core job is driving leads to clients and nurturing them into customers. When a client needs AI agents inside their business, we set them up and manage them. Prove your value and this grows into a full-time, senior seat.

What You'll Do:
Your job is to multiply the owner's output: more finished work, fewer bottlenecks, no babysitting.

  • Managing AI Agents
    • Write, test and refine prompts and instructions for AI agents
    • Assign work to agents, review their output and fix or redirect anything that falls short
    • Build and document repeatable workflows so tasks run the same way every time
    • Track what each agent is working on and report status clearly and briefly
    • Spot where a new tool, automation or integration would save real time, and set it up
  • Driving Results for Clients
    • Build and run lead-generation campaigns for clients across social, ads, email and landing pages
    • Set up automated follow-up that nurtures leads into paying customers
    • Produce campaign content with AI tools: social posts, ad copy, emails, landing pages, short-form video
    • Set up and manage AI agents inside client businesses when they need them
    • Track lead volume and conversions for each client and report results clearly
What You Bring:
We care more about what you have actually done with AI than about degrees or titles.

Required:
  • You know which AI agents, coding tools and deployment platforms lead the field right now, and why. This changes monthly and you keep up without being told
  • You have set those tools up yourself and run them daily to ship real work, not just chat with them
  • You can package a repeatable workflow so any agent runs it the same way every time
  • You can build, deploy and update a live website
  • AI image and video: you can take a real photo and bring it to life by enhancing, editing and animating it into video
  • A critical eye: you catch when AI output is wrong, generic or off-brand, and you fix it
  • Self-direction: you take a goal, run with it and report back without hand-holding
  • Digital marketing for lead generation: strong command of social, paid ads, email, SEO and content, and a track record of using them to drive leads and nurture them until they convert
Nice To Have:
  • Agency or freelance marketing experience with real client results
  • Automation, backend and database experience
  • Traditional design and video editing skills

title: Corporate Risk Management Senior Specialist
description:
We are EDP, a global energy company present in around 29 markets with a particular emphasis on renewable energies. With more than 45 years of experience, we have been consolidating a relevant presence on the world energy scene based on the commitment to be all-green by 2030, leading the energy transition. With more than 13,000 employees around the world, we are committed to using our energy and heart to drive a better tomorrow.

We work to make energy efficiency, and the energy transition a reality. Networking and technological innovation provide an opportunity for accelerated learning, while generating value for our customers’ businesses.

We are looking for a Corporate Risk Management Senior Specialist to join our team.

What you will do:

• Prepare regular reports and presentations for the EDP Executive Team and other senior stakeholders on the evolution of risk across the Group, namely the Risk Monitoring Committee and the Risk Appetite Dashboard.

• Develop projects to support the EDP Executive Team in managing Strategic Risks, particularly geopolitical and supply chain risks, defining actionable plans and triggers for extreme events.

• Develop an aggregated view of EDP Group risks for Budgets and Business Plans, assessing potential impacts on Net Income under stressed scenarios and consolidating risk assessments from different business areas.

• Identify, assess and quantify additional risks, including risks related to Commercial Operation Date (COD) delays.

• Lead projects aimed at accelerating risk management across the company, conducting in-depth analyses of specific businesses and risk areas and presenting recommendations to the Executive Team, particularly at the Global Risk Committee.

• Lead the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, including defining the Group's overall risk appetite, structuring ERM policies, organising the annual Risk Summit and coordinating the risk training plan.

• Manage risk-related communication with external stakeholders, contributing to the External Report and sustainability indexes.

• Perform advanced technical risk management activities to support the identification, analysis, modelling and mitigation of significant risk exposures across the organisation.

• Proactively lead projects, engage with relevant stakeholders and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across different business areas and geographical locations.

• Challenge existing practices and identify opportunities to improve risk management processes, methodologies and governance.

• Monitor emerging risks, industry trends, best practices and new technologies relevant to risk management.

Work site: Hybrid

City: Lisbon, Portugal

Contract: Full-Time

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Risk Management, Finance, Business, Engineering or related disciplines, preferably with a strong quantitative component. Additional certifications are a plus.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and support risk modelling activities.

• Strategic thinking and the ability to challenge existing practices and contribute to the development of innovative solutions.

• Experience in modelling and data analysis, particularly using Excel or similar tools.

• Strong understanding of risk identification, assessment and mitigation principles.

• Good understanding of Risk Appetite principles and risk governance standards.

• Excellent communication, teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage with stakeholders across different functions and geographical locations.

• Strong sense of accountability, decision-making capabilities and commitment to process optimisation and innovation.

• Ability and willingness to lead projects autonomously, demonstrating initiative and a proactive approach.

• Fluency in English, Portuguese and/or Spanish.

Nice to have:

• Professional experience in risk management, preferably within a corporate or multinational environment.

• Experience with Advanced Analytics tools, such as Python or R.

• Experience with communication and visualisation tools, such as PowerPoint and Power BI.

• Experience working with Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its applications in risk management.

• Knowledge of emerging technologies, industry trends and best practices in Enterprise Risk Management (ERM).

More than academic knowledge and technical skills, we are looking for ambitious people who are enthusiastic about the future and who bring human skills aligned with our purpose.

Equal opportunities for all

Our vision is that each person combines their unique characteristics and experiences to fulfill our mission of creating new energy for the planet. We are an inclusive employer, ensuring all candidates are treated fairly throughout the recruitment process. We welcome and value all people, and we are committed to fostering a sense of belonging for each person who is part of the EDP group.

Need more reasonsto apply?

As a top employer we:

  • Empower our employees through a positive and innovative work environment that promotes collaboration and agile decision-making;
  • Respect and value each person, providing a flexible, healthy, and inclusive workplace with a range of attractive benefits;
  • Provide a meaningful work experience and prepare our people for future challenges through different opportunities for development and internal mobility;

Our efforts have resulted in several distinctions over time, highlighting the EDP group's strong positioning and its dedication and commitment to attracting and retaining the best talent:

  • Top employer certification by Top Employers Institute
  • Part of the Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index
  • Global certification as a family-responsible company by Fundación Másfamília
  • Top 100 Workplaces by Houston Chronicle

title: Assurance Lead
description:
Assurance Lead

The opportunity

Downer is seeking an experienced Assurance Lead to join our Energy and Utilities business within Power Projects.

Reporting to the Head of HSEQ and Governance, this role will lead and coordinate assurance activities across Health and Safety, Environment, Quality, Field and Training within a major infrastructure environment.

You will provide practical, evidence based assurance that project controls are implemented and effective, compliance risks are identified and visible, corrective actions are effectively managed and project teams remain prepared for internal, client and regulatory assurance activities.

Working closely with project leadership, HSEQ, Quality, Environment, Training and delivery teams, you will help strengthen governance, improve audit readiness and drive continuous improvement across the project lifecycle.

Key responsibilities will include

• Developing and maintaining project assurance plans and audit schedules aligned with business requirements

• Planning and conducting risk based audits across Health and Safety, Environment, Quality, Field and Training

• Supporting mobilisation and project readiness reviews to ensure appropriate systems, resources, processes and responsibilities are established

• Conducting document reviews, interviews, field verification and evidence based assurance activities

• Supporting project teams with self audits and preparation for internal, client, certification and regulatory audits

• Managing audit findings, nonconformities and corrective actions, including monitoring closure and verifying effectiveness

• Providing clear assurance reporting, compliance insights and recommendations to project and business leadership

• Monitoring assurance trends, compliance results and recurring findings to identify opportunities for improvement

• Maintaining accurate and controlled assurance records, dashboards and reporting

• Working closely with project leaders and functional specialists while maintaining independent and evidence based assurance judgement.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for an experienced assurance professional who can combine strong technical knowledge with a practical understanding of major infrastructure delivery.

You will ideally bring

• A tertiary qualification in quality, safety, environmental management, engineering, business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience

• A minimum of five years experience within assurance, auditing, integrated management systems, governance or compliance in a large multidisciplinary organisation

• Demonstrated experience delivering risk based assurance across major transmission, substation, linear infrastructure or comparable high risk construction projects

• Lead Auditor qualification across ISO 9001, ISO 45001 and or ISO 14001, or the ability to obtain this within an agreed timeframe

• Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 and integrated management systems

• A sound understanding of first, second and third line assurance, construction and commissioning interfaces, objective evidence, compliance scoring and corrective action effectiveness

• Experience managing audit schedules, findings, corrective actions, controlled records and senior stakeholder reporting

• Strong report writing, data analysis, facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills

• Proficiency across Microsoft 365, SharePoint and Power BI, with experience using audit and action management systems considered advantageous

• The confidence to provide independent, evidence based judgement and constructively challenge ineffective controls

• Strong planning skills and the ability to manage competing priorities within a complex project environment.

What we offer

This is an opportunity to take on a key assurance role within Downer’s Power Projects business and contribute to the successful delivery of significant Australian infrastructure.

You will work alongside experienced project and functional leaders, gaining broad exposure across Health and Safety, Environment, Quality, Field and Training assurance while helping drive improvements across systems, controls and project delivery.

You will also have the opportunity to contribute lessons and improvements across the broader Power Projects business, helping strengthen assurance capability beyond your immediate project environment.

About Energy and Utilities

Downer is the leading provider of integrated services in Australia and New Zealand. Through trusted relationships and world leading insight we work closely with our customers to design, build and sustain assets, infrastructure and facilities.

Our Energy and Utilities business provides end to end services across power, gas, water and telecommunications sectors, supporting critical infrastructure and communities across Australia and New Zealand.

At Downer we plan, create and sustain. Downer is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where we value different perspectives and experiences.

How to apply

To apply for this opportunity, please submit your application online via the Downer careers website.

We encourage applications from candidates from diverse backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

Please note that Downer does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Unsolicited resumes submitted by recruitment agencies will not be considered and no agency fees will be payable.

title: Truck Lead
description:

Planning and organizing

  • Consults with supervisor and truck coordinator regarding any potential issues.
  • Controls according to establish policies, standards, and procedures, employee performance, conduct, dress, hygiene, sanitation, and personal appearance related to truck.
  • Studies all evidence of waste – time, materials, and recommendations for prevention.

  • Ability to establish, maintain and enforce consistently high-performance standards.

  • Ability to supervise, coach, develop, lead & motivate employees.
  • Demonstrates a genuine enthusiasm and warmth towards the guest and attitude of service. Is self- motivated and competitive. Is driven to grow and develop personally while developing those around them.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing. Ability to listen effectively, process information quickly, and transfer knowledge to others in accordance with company values of trust, respect & commitment to excellence.

  • Must be comfortable working nights, weekends, and varied hours.

title: Actuarial Assistant Manager, RP&C VSSC, Asia
description:
The Opportunity


The Actuarial Assistant Manager, RP&C VSSC, Asia supports the delivery and ongoing enhancement of IFRS 17 reporting across Asia. The role interprets actuarial and financial reporting requirements, translates them into practical business and system requirements, and consolidates and analyzes results to provide clear explanations of key outcomes. Working closely with partners and regional stakeholders, the incumbent helps design controlled and efficient reporting processes, validates the accuracy and effectiveness of IFRS 17 solutions, and strengthens team capability through clear documentation and training. The role also provides flexible actuarial support, including AXIS modelling, based on evolving business priorities.


Established in 2012, MGS Actuarial is a global center of excellence with more than 200 professionals supporting Valuation, Asset and Liability Modelling, Experience Analytics, Pricing, and other actuarial services. MGS Actuarial offers global career opportunities, a market-leading actuarial development program, job rotations, and a collaborative environment that supports professional growth.


Position Responsibilities

  • Support the implementation and ongoing enhancement of IFRS 17 reporting by interpreting technical requirements and translating them into clear business and system requirements.
  • Consolidate and analyze financial and actuarial data, investigate key movements, and clearly explain results to relevant stakeholders.
  • Support the design and implementation of future-state reporting processes that are efficient, well controlled, and compliant with valuation control requirements across business units.
  • Advise on and perform validation of IFRS 17 solutions, with a focus on accuracy, completeness, operational efficiency, and alignment with business requirements.
  • Develop and maintain clear process documentation, guidance materials, and training to support knowledge transfer and consistent execution across the team.
  • Provide ad hoc actuarial and modelling support, including AXIS-related work, in response to evolving team and business priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, or a related field.
  • At least five years of actuarial experience in life insurance or financial services.
  • Significant progress toward an Associate designation from a recognized actuarial organization, such as the Society of Actuaries or the Actuarial Society of the Philippines.
  • Strong knowledge of life insurance valuation, actuarial modelling, reserve analysis, and financial reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently develop or maintain actuarial models and analyze reserves, Drivers of Earnings, and related actuarial results.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex actuarial matters to stakeholders at different levels of the organization.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple deliverables while meeting deadlines in a dynamic environment.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across functions and geographies.
  • Self-motivated and accountable, with sound professional judgment.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement, professional development, and becoming a trusted actuarial business partner.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Manager, Fatigue Projects
description:
• 24-month contract to lead strategic projects that directly influence the future of Cabin Crew operations
  • Partner with senior operational, safety and industrial stakeholders to deliver meaningful business outcomes.
  • Build new capability and drive complex change in a highly regulated, safety-critical environment.

About the Role

As the Manager, Fatigue Projects, you will lead the delivery of key initiatives within the Cabin Crew Fatigue Risk Management Program, including projects supporting Project Sunrise.

The Fatigue Risk Management team plays a critical role in supporting frontline Cabin Crew by designing, implementing and continuously improving the systems, frameworks and controls that support managing Cabin Crew fatigue and ensuring safety remains our first priority. Working at the intersection of safety, operations and workforce planning, the team develops practical solutions that support safe, efficient and sustainable operations.

This role has been established to lead the delivery of strategic projects that will shape future Cabin Crew operations. You will be responsible for embedding governance frameworks, operational processes, fatigue rules, training and supporting systems, ensuring initiatives are successfully implemented and transitioned into long-term operational ownership.

This is an excellent opportunity for a strong project professional with experience in a safety-sensitive environment who enjoys solving complex problems, influencing outcomes and delivering meaningful change within a large and dynamic organisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of strategic fatigue-related projects, including Project Sunrise readiness initiatives.
  • Develop and implement frameworks, governance models and operational processes that support future-state Cabin Crew operations.
  • Manage project scope, timelines, resources, risks and reporting to ensure successful delivery.
  • Identify operational and fatigue-related risks and develop practical solutions that support safe and sustainable outcomes.
  • Drive stakeholder engagement across operational, safety, industrial and leadership groups.
  • Develop communication and engagement strategies that support successful implementation and adoption of change.
  • Monitor project performance, identify issues and proactively manage delivery risks.
  • Coach and support team members and stakeholders to build capability and drive solution-focused outcomes.
  • Ensure key initiatives are embedded into day-to-day operations and transitioned into sustainable business ownership.

About You

You are a highly capable project leader who thrives in complex, fast-paced and highly regulated environments. You have a track record of successfully delivering large-scale initiatives that require strong governance, stakeholder engagement and disciplined execution, while balancing competing priorities and navigating ambiguity.

You bring a practical and solutions-focused mindset, with the ability to move seamlessly between strategy and delivery. Ideally, you'll have experience within safety, risk management, human factors or a related discipline. However, we're equally interested in experienced project leaders who have successfully delivered complex compliance, regulatory change or safety initiatives in highly regulated, operational or safety-sensitive environments. You're comfortable challenging thinking, identifying risks and influencing outcomes, but you're equally focused on finding workable solutions and maintaining momentum.

You are known for your ability to establish credibility quickly, build trusted relationships and work effectively across all levels of an organisation. Whether engaging with operational leaders, frontline employees, specialist subject matter experts or industrial stakeholders, you communicate with confidence, professionalism and authenticity.

You'll also bring:

  • Strong project management capability, including governance, risk management, planning, reporting and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience delivering outcomes within aviation, transport, rail, maritime, defence, mining, energy, healthcare or other highly regulated, safety-critical industries will be highly regarded.
  • Experience in fatigue risk management or safety risk management will be highly regarded
  • A practical, action-oriented and solution-focused approach, with the resilience to work through challenge, ambiguity and stakeholder resistance while maintaining a focus on outcomes.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build credibility and drive outcomes across diverse groups and competing priorities.
  • Experience working with operational workforces, employee representatives, unions or other industrial stakeholders.
  • A practical, action-oriented and solution-focused approach, combined with the resilience to navigate ambiguity, challenge and change in a complex environment.

Why Qantas?

You'll join a team where safety, collaboration and continuous improvement are at the centre of everything we do.

There are many different opportunities across our business, which means you'll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. You'll be supported by experienced leaders and colleagues while working on initiatives that directly contribute to the future of Cabin Crew operations.

Your development is a priority for us. You'll have the opportunity to broaden your project leadership capability, build relationships across the business and contribute to some of the most significant operational initiatives underway at Qantas.

The Qantas Employee Benefits Program Offers Amazing Benefits That Extend Well Beyond Travel

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe for you, your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities, including paid parental leave and additional purchased leave options for eligible employees.
  • We'll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships, access discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment.

title: Cloud Adoption Engineer — Oracle Government, Defense & Intelligence
description:
Cloud Adoption Engineer — Oracle Government, Defense & Intelligence

Build the Foundation for Successful Cloud Adoption

Oracle Government, Defense & Intelligence is seeking a Cloud Adoption Engineer to help U.S. Federal Government customers establish secure, scalable, and operationally ready Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments.

Successful cloud adoption requires sound foundations across tenancy design, networking, identity, security, governance, observability, and automation. As a Cloud Adoption Engineer, you will work directly with customers to assess readiness, identify technical dependencies, design foundational architectures, and validate that environments are ready for adoption.

You will combine hands-on engineering, architectural judgment, and customer collaboration to turn complex requirements into practical designs, reusable infrastructure code, actionable implementation guidance, and clear operational ownership.

  • Must possess or have the ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI with Poly

  • This is a HYBRID position that involves a combination of remote, in-office work and meetings at the client site. Candidates must be based in the greater Washington DC area.

What You’ll Do

Assess Customer Readiness

  • Engage customer stakeholders to understand mission objectives, business drivers, technical environments, and adoption priorities.
  • Lead discovery across applications, databases, infrastructure, networking, identity, security, operations, governance, and automation.
  • Assess workload dependencies, migration suitability, technical constraints, and foundational requirements.
  • Develop evidence-based readiness assessments identifying gaps, risks, recommendations, accountable owners, and target dates.
  • Recommend adoption sequencing and migration-readiness actions based on technical dependencies and customer priorities.

Design OCI Foundations

  • Translate customer requirements into secure, resilient, and implementation-ready OCI foundation architectures.
  • Design tenancy and compartment structures, landing zones, environment separation, naming, tagging, governance, and cost controls.
  • Develop network designs covering VCNs, subnets, routing, DNS, segmentation, and hybrid connectivity.
  • Guide identity federation, access policies, least privilege, multifactor authentication, and emergency access arrangements.
  • Define logging, monitoring, security telemetry, alert routing, and integration with customer security operations.
  • Document architecture decisions, alternatives, tradeoffs, dependencies, and exceptions.

Build Infrastructure-as-Code and Automation

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain OCI foundation components using Terraform and OCI Resource Manager.
  • Create reusable Terraform modules and manage state, resource dependencies, and environment-specific configurations.
  • Develop Python scripts to integrate APIs, configure cloud resources, validate deployments, and automate repeatable tasks.
  • Manage infrastructure and automation code in Git-based repositories using branching, pull requests, and peer review.
  • Apply secure practices for credentials, secrets, access permissions, and deployment execution.
  • Troubleshoot provisioning failures, configuration errors, permissions, and infrastructure dependencies.
  • Document deployment procedures and enable customer and delivery teams to maintain and extend the automation.

Enable Implementation

  • Translate architecture designs into actionable implementation tasks with sequencing, ownership, and acceptance criteria.
  • Conduct technical working sessions, demonstrations, and hands-on exercises to help teams implement agreed designs.
  • Collaborate with professional services, delivery partners, and customer engineers to resolve foundational implementation blockers.
  • Guide deployment practices that support consistency, repeatability, and operational sustainability.

Validate Readiness and Transfer Ownership

  • Review deployed foundations against agreed architecture and operational readiness criteria.
  • Validate connectivity, identity, security controls, logging, monitoring, and automation through documented evidence.
  • Track unresolved gaps and exceptions, ensuring risks are addressed or formally accepted by accountable owners.
  • Prepare operational handoff packages covering architecture, infrastructure code, deployment procedures, runbooks, support paths, and outstanding actions.
  • Transfer knowledge to receiving teams and confirm their acceptance of operational ownership.

Improve Repeatable Adoption Practices

  • Use and improve shared discovery workbooks, readiness assessments, design templates, architecture decision records, and handoff checklists.
  • Apply existing Oracle documentation, reference architectures, training, and labs to customer needs.
  • Contribute reusable infrastructure modules, automation scripts, engineering patterns, and lessons learned.
  • Maintain broad capability across cloud adoption foundations while developing deeper expertise in networking, identity, security operations, or Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Communicate progress, risks, recommendations, and decisions clearly to customer and Oracle stakeholders.

How You’ll Work

You will own the quality and completion of assigned Cloud Adoption Engineering deliverables, working with the Senior Manager of Cloud Adoption Engineering and relevant technical specialists.

Your focus will be cloud foundation readiness. You will coordinate application implementation, migration execution, and ongoing production operations with the teams responsible for those activities.

Required Qualifications

  • Must possess or have the ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI with Poly
  • Five or more years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, architecture, or technical delivery.
  • Hands-on experience with OCI, AWS, Azure, OR Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience designing, implementing, or assessing enterprise cloud foundations.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud networking, identity and access management, security, compute, storage, and observability.
  • Experience assessing customer environments, workload dependencies, and migration requirements.
  • Experience developing, deploying, and maintaining Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform, including reusable modules, state management, and environment-specific configurations.
  • Experience using Python, with the ability to develop scripts that configure cloud resources, integrate APIs, validate deployments, and automate operational tasks.
  • Experience managing infrastructure code in Git-based repositories, including branching, pull requests, peer review, and version control.
  • Experience troubleshooting infrastructure deployments and automation, including configuration errors, resource dependencies, permissions, and failed provisioning.
  • Ability to translate requirements into architecture designs, implementation guidance, and readiness recommendations.
  • Strong customer discovery, technical facilitation, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Understanding of federal cloud security and compliance requirements and their implications for architecture and operational readiness.
  • Ability to manage assigned technical work, communicate risks, and coordinate across customer and delivery teams.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.

Preferred Qualifications (not required):

  • Experience supporting U.S. Federal Government customers.
  • OCI expertise across tenancy design, landing zones, networking, identity federation, and security operations integration.
  • Experience with OCI Resource Manager, OCI CLI, and OCI SDKs.
  • Experience integrating infrastructure deployments with CI/CD pipelines and automated validation.
  • Familiarity with Shell scripting, Ansible, or other configuration management and automation tools.
  • Experience with Oracle applications, databases, middleware, or VMware environments.
  • Familiarity with FastConnect, Site-to-Site VPN, enterprise identity providers, and SIEM/SOC integration.
  • Knowledge of cloud governance, cost accountability, resilience, and disaster recovery.
  • Relevant cloud architecture, networking, security, or automation certifications.

What Success Looks Like

Customers understand their adoption requirements, dependencies, risks, and next steps. Foundation designs are actionable, infrastructure deployments are repeatable, readiness recommendations are supported by evidence, and operational responsibilities are clearly accepted.

Your work helps customers move forward with greater confidence, fewer foundational blockers, and a sustainable path to OCI adoption.

Join Oracle and help build the foundations for successful federal cloud adoption.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Senior Product Designer (Chief Operations Office Business Unit)

Do work that matters

At CommBank, we are transforming how operations work across the Bank - reimagining the systems, tools and experiences that enable our people to deliver for customers every day.

You’ll join a cross-functional team shaping a next-generation operations platform - designed to simplify and standardise complex processes, improve how work is allocated and managed, and unlock more consistent, efficient outcomes for both staff and customers.

This work sits at the intersection of experience, data, orchestration and AI, with an ambition to create scalable, reusable foundations that support a wide range of operational processes across the Bank.

About the role

As a Senior Product Designer, you will be a highly capable individual contributor embedded in a cross-functional product squad, trusted to operate with a high degree of autonomy, with direction from a Principal Designer.

You will take ownership of significant areas within a complex platform problem space - driving design from early problem framing through to delivery and continuous improvement. You will independently navigate ambiguity, shape well-defined problem spaces, and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and Data to influence direction, challenge thinking, and ensure design is central to decision-making.

This role is suited to someone who combines strong systems thinking with hands-on craft, and who is comfortable leading workstreams, raising the bar for quality, and driving outcomes without requiring close direction.

What you’ll do

Deliver complex design outcomes

  • Lead end-to-end design for substantial problem areas, from discovery through to delivery and optimisation.
  • Translate complex operational challenges into clear, scalable experience solutions.
  • Drive design quality and consistency across workflows, contributing to more standardised and reusable approaches.

Drive discovery and problem framing

  • Lead and facilitate discovery within your problem space, identifying unmet needs and opportunities.
  • Define hypotheses, success measures and experiments to guide decision-making.
  • Use evidence to challenge assumptions and shape direction, not just validate solutions.

Design for scale and systems

  • Create experience models, flows and interaction patterns that scale across multiple use cases.
  • Consider platform, data and operational contexts - including how work is surfaced, managed and measured.
  • Balance short-term delivery with longer-term experience coherence.

Influence and align teams and stakeholders

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering and stakeholders to shape priorities and solutions.
  • Influence decisions through clear rationale, strong design artefacts and evidence-led storytelling.
  • Proactively identify and resolve misalignment across squads where experiences intersect.

Lift design quality and capability

  • Set a high bar for design craft, clarity and systems thinking within your squad.
  • Contribute actively to critique, collaboration and knowledge sharing across the design community.
  • Act as a trusted design voice, helping others navigate complexity and raise their practice.

What you’ll bring

  • Strong experience designing complex digital products, platforms or services end-to-end within cross-functional teams.
  • Proven ability to own and drive design outcomes independently in ambiguous, high-complexity environments.
  • Demonstrated strength in systems thinking and designing for scale across workflows or journeys.
  • Experience leading discovery, framing problems and shaping direction using evidence.
  • Confidence influencing Product, Engineering and business stakeholders through clear thinking and strong rationale.
  • Ability to balance strategic intent with hands-on execution across UX and UI.
  • Strong communication, facilitation and storytelling skills.
  • Demonstrated familiarity with emerging AI-enabled design and rapid prototyping tools, with the ability to leverage modern AI-assisted workflows to accelerate iteration, collaboration, and business requirement sign-off.
  • Experience with tools such as Figma Make, Claude Code, Codex, or similar tooling is highly desirable.
  • A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership, strong craft and measurable impact.

Why join us

  • Work on meaningful, high-impact challenges that improve outcomes for both staff and customers.
  • Contribute to building scalable operational platforms used across the Bank.
  • Be part of a collaborative product and design culture with opportunities to grow and stretch.
  • Access strong design leadership, community and investment in your development.

Please apply with a copy of your CV and link to your portfolio. We look forward to hearing from you !

title: Service Desk Analyst
description:
Verra Mobility is a global smart mobility technology business with a clear purpose: making roads safer and journeys easier. We partner with governments and road authorities to deliver technology that improves road safety, encourages responsible driving and helps protect the communities who use our roads every day.

As a Service Desk Analyst, you’ll provide first and second line IT support to our UK Operations team and colleagues across the international business.   • Experience supporting Windows and Microsoft 365, administering accounts in Active Directory or a similar identity platform, and using a service desk ticketing system.

Entry Level Pet Grooming Trainee

No Grooming Experience Required | Paid Training | Career Path with Dogs

Love dogs and want to build a real career, but do not have formal pet care experience? We train reliable, motivated people to become professional pet groomers.

At Bark & Mane of Greater Memphis, formerly Aussie Pet Mobile, many of our groomers started in customer service, restaurants, retail, daycare, veterinary clinics, and other hands-on jobs before learning grooming with us.

This is a full-time trainee position for someone who wants to learn a skilled trade, work with dogs every day, and build strong earning potential over time.

What You Will Learn

You will receive paid, hands-on training to become a professional pet groomer. During training, you will learn dog handling, bathing, drying, grooming skills, safety, customer communication, van care, and the daily process of mobile grooming.

After training, you will work independently in a company mobile grooming vehicle at clients’ homes. Our dispatch team handles scheduling, route planning, and customer support so you can focus on the pets, the clients, and the quality of your work.

Why People Like This Career

• Paid training to become a professional pet groomer
• 4 day work week once training is complete
• Work independently during the day with support from our office team
• Tips and performance based bonus opportunities
• Health, dental, vision, PTO, paid holidays, and 401k with company match
• A skilled trade with strong long term earning potential

What To Expect

This is active, physical work. You will stand, bend, lift, clean, drive between appointments, communicate with clients, and safely handle dogs of different sizes and temperaments.

Training schedules may differ from the regular groomer schedule. Once trained and running appointments, groomers generally work 4 days per week, including Saturdays.

After training, compensation is commission based with tips and bonus opportunities. Established full-time groomers on our team commonly earn approximately $60,000 to $90,000 per year including tips, depending on performance, availability, speed, and the client base they build. Individual earnings are not guaranteed.

We provide a professional starter grooming tool kit, with repayment handled over time during the first several months. Full details are reviewed during the hiring process.

What We Are Looking For

• No formal grooming or pet care experience required
• Valid driver’s license and reasonably clean driving record
• Reliable attendance and dependable transportation
• Comfortable working with dogs and learning safe handling
• Friendly, professional communication with clients
• Willingness to learn, accept feedback, and improve
• Ability to work independently without being micromanaged
• Interest in building a long-term career, not just finding a short term job

If you want to learn a valuable skill, work with dogs, and build a career with strong earning potential, apply today to become an Entry Level Pet Grooming Trainee.

title: Country Study Start Up Specialist
description:
Turn study plans into active clinical trial sites, and help bring new medicines closer to patients.

We’re looking for a proactive Country Study Start Up Specialist to take ownership of the critical activities that move clinical studies from planning through to site activation in Australia.

Working across studies and sites, you’ll be at the centre of the start-up process, coordinating ethics submissions, essential documentation, informed consent materials and site activation requirements while partnering with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Contracts, CRAs and regional and global Study Start Up teams. You’ll anticipate roadblocks, bring the right people together and help keep studies progressing on time and to a high standard.

This is an opportunity for someone with clinical research, study start-up, site activation or regulatory submissions experience who enjoys solving problems, managing competing priorities and seeing their work translate into sites becoming ready to enrol patients.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure successful and on time and quality execution of start-up and maintenance activities for assigned sites and studies; site assignment scope primarily central IRB/EC sites. Establish the
  • country/site activation plans and priorities including risk assessment and mitigation plans with CCOM/COM, Area SSU and CSM Lead, Contract Manager, CTS/Regulatory Affairs.
  • Proactively identify and communicate issues impacting delivery and providing proposed solutions
  • Attend regional/area start up calls and providing input for assigned sites/studies. Collection of essential documents from sites and completing quality check (ALCOA).
  • Compile and submit ethics and other required local submissions including customization of ICFs, patient facing materials and safety reporting. Coordinate with Regulatory and CTS on CA submission and approval status to assure alignment with other site activation requirements.
  • Collaborate with contract manager, CRA, Area CSM Lead as required to assure timely site activation.
  • Reviewing site and/or IRB/EC comments on ICFs and routing for approval by required functional areas. Trigger clinical supply shipments.
  • Complete IP release activities and triggering IP shipment.
  • Issue site green light letter and activating sites in IXRS. Track all start up and maintenance related activities in Vault SSU as appropriate. Maintain local country and site intelligence database and EDLs in Vault.
  • Maintain SSU performance metrics and KPIs for assigned sites/studies. Provide start up updates and metrics to CCOM/COM and Area SSU and CSM Leads. Ensure audit/inspection readiness.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate and divisional policies and procedures in alignment with worldwide regulations and guidelines.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives as required.
  • Report any adverse event within 24 hours as per AbbVie’s policies and procedures.
  • Proactively participate in AbbVie’s WHS programs, adhere to policies and promote a safe work environment at all times.
  • Adhere to AbbVie’s codes of conduct and compliance processes, including timely training and maintaining ethics and integrity.
  • Other ad hoc duties such as administrative duties, as requested.
  • Bachelor's Degree (degree in health care or scientific field) highly preferred or equivalent years of experience required
  • A minimum of 1-2 years of clinical research experience and preferably 1+ years of study start up management experience for the designated region.
  • Experience working with remote/virtual teams
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills and the ability to evaluate complex issues from multiple perspectives.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and communicate with clarity, flexibility and adaptability to changing requirements.
  • Demonstration of successful execution, preferably in start up, and aptitude for managing multiple priorities in a fast‐paced environment.

title: Pod Lead - Civil and structural Engineering
description:
About Turing:
Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Civil or Structural Engineering expert to lead a pod of trainers building realistic, terminal-based technical tasks for Terminal Bench Science. You will review every task your trainers produce for engineering correctness, reproducibility, and grader reliability, and coach trainers to consistently deliver high-quality tasks.

Reporting Structure:
Reports to the Civil & Structural Engineering Team Lead. Leads a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers.

What you'll do:
  • Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, structural and geotechnical models, load cases, simulation data, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
  • Validate tasks involving structural analysis, finite-element methods (FEA), earthquake and wind engineering, structural dynamics, geotechnical modeling, hydraulics, hydrology, transportation, and infrastructure systems.
  • Ensure tasks require genuine multi-step engineering reasoning and reflect realistic civil and structural engineering workflows.
  • Verify engineering accuracy across units, equilibrium, boundary conditions, load combinations, design codes, numerical stability, convergence, and safety factors.
  • Validate computational models, solvers, dependencies, and simulation results for reproducibility and technical correctness.
  • Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as forces, deflections, drifts, settlements, factors of safety, flow rates, and structural performance.
  • Identify technical errors, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering analysis.
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to task developers and track revisions through completion.
  • Mentor and support technical trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and productivity, and resolve technical blockers.
  • Maintain quality standards, technical documentation, and best practices across engineering task development.

What we're looking for:
  • Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • Strong programming experience in Python, C/C++, Julia, Fortran, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
  • Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: structural analysis, FEA, earthquake engineering, geotechnical modeling, or hydraulic/hydrological modeling.
  • Strong understanding of engineering principles, numerical methods, simulation workflows, and model validation.
  • Working knowledge of engineering design standards such as ASCE 7, ACI, AISC, Eurocodes, or IS codes.
  • Experience reviewing complex technical work, engineering simulations, research outputs, or computational models.
  • Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical inaccuracies, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
  • Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
  • Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

Nice to have:
  • Experience with engineering simulation and analysis tools such as OpenSees/OpenSeesPy, Code_Aster, CalculiX, FEniCS, Gmsh, PyNite, EPANET, SWMM, HEC-RAS, MODFLOW, SUMO, QGIS, or GDAL.
  • Familiarity with commercial engineering software such as SAP2000, ETABS, Abaqus, PLAXIS, or .
  • Experience with nonlinear time-history analysis, performance-based design, reliability analysis, or structural health monitoring.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
  • Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
  • Professional engineering licensure such as PE, SE, CEng, or equivalent.
  • Industry experience working on buildings, bridges, transportation networks, water systems, or major infrastructure projects.
  • Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

Offer Details:
  • Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: Permanency Mediation Training Specialist/Supervisor Part-Time

title: Founding Head of Senior School
description:
Head of Senior School

SPGS International School (Singapore)

An exceptional opportunity to shape the future of one of the world's most distinguished educational institutions as it establishes its international presence in Singapore.

SPGS International School (Singapore) is seeking an inspirational and ambitious Founding Head of Senior School to join our dynamic Senior Leadership Team and play a defining role in the development of an extraordinary new school.

Rooted in the 120-year heritage of St Paul's Girls' School in London, consistently recognised as one of the UK's most academically successful schools, SPGS International brings a remarkable educational tradition to Singapore. Our ambition is to create something genuinely special: a school where intellectual curiosity, academic excellence, creativity and individuality flourish together, and where young people are encouraged to think independently, question confidently and discover the joy of learning.

This is a rare opportunity to be part of a founding leadership team, combining the heritage and educational philosophy of an internationally renowned institution with the energy, ambition and possibilities of a new school. Working closely with the Founding Head of School, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to shape the Senior School from its earliest stages, building its academic culture, developing an exceptional team of teachers and establishing the traditions, experiences and expectations that will define the school for generations to come.

We are looking for an outstanding educational leader who combines intellectual ambition with warmth, imagination and a genuine commitment to the development of young people. The successful candidate will share our conviction that exceptional academic outcomes are not the sole purpose of education, but the natural consequence of an environment in which students are inspired, challenged, supported and deeply known.

As Head of Senior School, you will lead the development of an ambitious British curriculum, including IGCSE and A Level pathways, while championing an educational experience that extends far beyond examinations. From scholarship, oracy and independent research to the performing arts, sport and service, you will help create a school in which students are encouraged to pursue their interests, develop their character and realise their potential.

Above all, we are seeking someone who is excited by the opportunity to build. Someone who enjoys working collaboratively with talented and committed colleagues, who brings both vision and the determination to turn ideas into reality, and who recognises the extraordinary privilege of helping to establish a new school with such a distinguished heritage.

For the right candidate, this is more than a senior leadership appointment. It is an opportunity to help write the next chapter in the story of SPGS, and to create an educational legacy of lasting significance in Singapore.

We warmly welcome applications from accomplished and aspiring senior leaders who share our educational philosophy and are excited by the opportunity to contribute to the founding of SPGS International School (Singapore).

Berlin · Primarily on-site · 3–6 months · Mandatory study internship

About the Role

#DAMUR is a Berlin-based high-end fashion label connecting gender-neutral fashion with music, nightlife, performance and contemporary culture.

You will translate the #DAMUR identity into clear, consistent and high-impact visual assets for digital, e-commerce, print and live environments. This role focuses on graphic design; the Social Media intern handles filming, posting and community management.

A Professional Working Internship

This is a professional working internship—not a classroom, observation placement or beginner software course.

We provide clear briefs, creative direction, professional context and feedback. In return, you must already understand typography, layout and visual hierarchy and be able to use Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign confidently. We do not teach basic design software from the beginning.

You do not need to understand the complete #DAMUR visual system on your first day, but you must be able to interpret a brief, propose solutions, revise your work precisely and deliver organised final files. We are looking for students who want to contribute to real projects—not wait for every step to be taught or repeatedly explained.

What You’ll Do

You’re a Strong Fit If

title: Pod Lead - Chemistry
description:

Role Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Chemistry expert to lead a pod of trainers building realistic, terminal-based scientific tasks for Terminal Bench Science. You will review every task your trainers produce for chemical correctness, reproducibility, safety, and grader reliability, and coach trainers to consistently deliver high-quality, challenging tasks.

What you'll do:
  • Review trainer tasks end to end, including task statements, molecular structures, spectra and datasets, force-field parameters, environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
  • Verify that tasks reflect authentic chemistry research workflows and require genuine multi-step reasoning rather than a single library call or lookup.
  • Check that software versions, force fields, basis sets, functionals, and dependencies are pinned and that results are reproducible.
  • Validate chemical correctness, including units such as Hartree, eV, kcal/mol, and kJ/mol; charge and spin multiplicity; stereochemistry and tautomer handling; method specifications; SCF and geometry convergence; frequency checks for minima and transition states; equilibration; and sampling adequacy.
  • Ensure tolerances reflect method-dependent, numerical, and stochastic variation without accepting chemically incorrect results.
  • Ensure graders verify energies, geometries, thermodynamic quantities, rate constants, spectral assignments, or molecular properties rather than formatting.
  • Ensure tasks cannot be gamed through hard-coded outputs, reading test files, or bypassing the intended computation.
  • Screen tasks for chemical safety and dual-use concerns.
  • Escalate content involving the synthesis or enhancement of hazardous, toxic, or controlled substances.
  • Provide clear, actionable written feedback and track revisions through closure.
  • Onboard and mentor trainers on task design standards, common pitfalls, and grader design.
  • Allocate work across the pod and track throughput and quality metrics.
  • Escalate blockers.
  • Maintain pod documentation covering guidelines, recurring issues, and exemplary tasks.

  • Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced experience in chemistry or a closely related field.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, Julia, or Fortran, with Linux and terminal proficiency.
  • Hands-on experience with computational chemistry, molecular simulation, cheminformatics, or chemical data analysis.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with free-energy methods, reaction mechanism analysis, machine-learned potentials, or spectroscopy simulation.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI systems, automated testing, and HPC environments.
  • Experience designing benchmarks, programming tasks, or simulation-based evaluations.

description:
# VP – Capital Markets

## Company Overview
WeRize is India's first social distribution AI fintech platform serving the underserved aspirational middle-class across 5,000+ small cities in India (referred to as India-2). Founded in 2019, WeRize delivers secured and unsecured loans, insurance, and investment products through a unique three-sided marketplace connecting 17,000+ trained local freelancers with customers and partner financial institutions. Powered by a proprietary AI operating layer, WeRize fosters trust among distributors, customers, and manufacturers, enabling strong network effects and sustainable growth.

## Job Summary
The VP – Capital Markets is a high-impact executive leadership role responsible for driving the debt capital-raising mandate and building a resilient, diversified, and institutional-grade debt pipeline for WeRize’s in-house Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC). This role involves formulating balance-sheet growth strategies, structuring complex institutional transactions, expanding lender and investor coverage, and optimizing the overall cost of capital. The VP will lead end-to-end deal origination, structuring, negotiation, execution, and long-term relationship management with key stakeholders.

## Responsibilities
- **Institutional Debt Sourcing & Capital Mobilization:** Independently mobilize term debt, working capital facilities, and credit lines from private sector banks, public sector banks, large NBFCs, financial institutions, and Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) to support aggressive loan book growth.
- **Credit Rating & Market Positioning:** Drive capital mobilization strategies aligned with growth-stage credit ratings, particularly focusing on raising institutional debt and structuring transactions within the BBB rating band.
- **Capital Market Instruments:** Originate, structure, and place Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) and Commercial Papers (CPs) with institutional investors, family offices, and High Net Worth Individuals (HNIs).
- **Securitization & Structured Finance:** Architect and execute retail portfolio securitization transactions, including Pass-Through Certificates (PTCs), Direct Assignment (DA) routes, and co-lending/First Loss Default Guarantee (FLDG) frameworks.
- **Deal Structuring, Execution & Stakeholder Management:** Oversee preparation of Information Memorandums (IMs), rating agency presentations, financial models, and lender pitches; lead due diligence, credit appraisals, and risk evaluations; manage commercial and legal negotiations for facility agreements and security creation.
- **Treasury Strategy, Asset-Liability Management (ALM) & Portfolio Compliance:** Formulate strategic liability management plans to optimize liquidity, reduce borrowing costs, and manage interest rate risk; direct ALM, cash-flow forecasting, Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), and debt covenant compliance; resolve operational bottlenecks to ensure timely debt disbursements.
- **Leadership & Ecosystem Networking:** Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite and senior leaders across banks and financial institutions; mentor and lead a high-performing team across debt syndication, documentation, and compliance functions.

## Qualifications
- **Experience:** Minimum 15+ years of hands-on experience in institutional debt raising, debt capital markets (DCM), or treasury leadership.
- **Industry Background:** Mandatory experience in NBFCs; additional exposure to Financial Services or FinTech sectors is a strong advantage.
- **Credit Rating Expertise:** Proven track record of raising and syndicating debt for entities rated in the BBB credit rating band across PSU/private banks, NBFCs, and capital markets.
- **Education:** Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA in Finance from a premier institute is mandatory.
- **Technical Knowledge:** Deep understanding of credit underwriting norms, securitization guidelines (PTC/DA), Reserve Bank of India (RBI) regulatory frameworks, NCD issuances, and covenant structures.
- **Location:** Based in Mumbai headquarters with willingness to travel and coordinate with Bengaluru HQ.

## Preferred Skills
- Strong negotiation skills in commercial and legal contexts.
- Expertise in preparing detailed financial models and strategic lender presentations.
- Ability to manage complex due diligence processes and address lender risk committee queries.
- Leadership skills to mentor and develop a team of directors and managers.
- Networking capabilities to cultivate relationships with senior stakeholders in financial institutions.

## Experience
- 15+ years in institutional debt raising, debt capital markets, or treasury leadership roles.
- Demonstrated experience in NBFC sector is mandatory.
- Experience working with PSU and private sector banks, NBFCs, and capital markets in raising debt within the BBB rating band.

## Environment
- The role is headquartered in Mumbai with frequent interactions and coordination with the Bengaluru office.
- The position requires travel and engagement with external stakeholders including banks, financial institutions, and investors.
- Work environment is corporate and fast-paced, involving strategic decision-making and leadership responsibilities.

title: Master Thesis - Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Dynamic Power System Characterization
description:
Master Thesis - Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Dynamic Power System Characterization

At the Institute of Climate and Energy Systems Engineering (ICE-1) we focus on the development of models and algorithms for simulation and optimization of decentralized, integrated energy systems. Such systems are characterized by high shares of renewable energies and increasing sector coupling, which leads to high spatial and temporal variability of energy supply and demand as well as a high degree of interdependence of material and energy flows. Our research at the ICE institute aims to provide scalable and faster-than-real-time capable methods and tools that enable the energy-optimal, cost-efficient and safe design and operation of future energy systems.

Your Job

The transition toward renewable and converter-interfaced energy resources is creating increasingly fast and complex dynamics in modern power systems. In this Master’s thesis, you will develop a physics-informed digital-twinning approach to better characterize these dynamics and estimate relevant electrical and control parameters from transient voltage and current data.

Your tasks will include:

  • Developing and analyzing representative dynamic simulation scenarios for electrical power systems
  • Extending kernel-based Gaussian Process methods for the estimation of electrical and control parameters
  • Integrating physical knowledge, such as governing differential equations and physical constraints, into probabilistic kernel models
  • Developing and evaluating a physics-informed digital-twinning methodology based on known system parameters and reference simulations
  • Assessing the approach with regard to estimation accuracy, uncertainty quantification, numerical robustness, and computational efficiency
  • Analyzing and documenting your results and deriving conclusions for the applicability of the developed approach

Your Profile

  • Excellent university degree (Bachelor) in field of Data Science or a comparable field i.e. Electrical Engineering, Computer Science/ Engineering, Physics or the like
  • Strong mathematical background
  • Interest in energy systems, power grids and their components
  • Excellent knowledge and experience in programming Python
  • Excellent knowledge and experience in machine learning
  • Excellent ability for cooperative collaboration
  • Very good command of written and spoken English with extensive vocabulary is required (at least B2 level according to the CEFR), ideally supported by a certificate confirming the language level. Knowledge of the German language is not mandatory but certainly appreciated

Our Benefits for You

We work on the very latest issues that impact our society and are offering you the chance to actively help in shaping the change! We offer ideal conditions for you to complete your studies:

  • Meaningful Tasks: Your thesis deals with a future-oriented, socially relevant topic with direct practical relevance in an international environment
  • Practical relevance: With us, you will gain valuable practical experience alongside your studies and actively participate in interdisciplinary projects, , including project meetings and, where appropriate, conferences.
  • Scientific environment: You can expect excellent scientific equipment, modern technologies, and qualified support from experienced colleagues
  • Personal responsibility: You organize your tasks independently - from preparation to implementation
  • Onboarding & teamwork: You can look forward to working in a dedicated, international, and collegial team. It is important to us that you quickly settle into the team and are given structured training for your tasks. We also support you from the very beginning and make your start easier with our Welcome Days and Welcome Guide
  • Work-life balance: We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your professional and personal life. You also have the option of flexible working (in terms of location), which is generally possible after consultation and in line with upcoming tasks and (on-site) appointments
  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours make it easier for you to balance work and study
  • Campus experience: Our research campus in the countryside creates ideal conditions for collegial exchange and sporting activities right on site. Our cafeteria offers a wide range of options—you can enjoy a relaxing lunch break with a lake view
  • Perspective: We provide strong support and mentoring to help you prepare for a future career in science or industry. If you have the appropriate qualifications and funding is available, the institute also offers the opportunity to pursue a PhD after completing your master's thesis
  • Fair remuneration: We will pay you a reasonable remuneration for your thesis

In addition to exciting tasks and a collegial working environment, we offer you much more: https://go.fzj.de/benefits

title: Pod Lead - Physics
description:
About Turing:
Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Physics expert to lead a pod of trainers building realistic, terminal-based scientific tasks for Terminal Bench Science. You will review every task your trainers produce for physical correctness, reproducibility, and grader reliability, and coach trainers to consistently deliver high-quality, challenging tasks.

What you'll do:
  • Review trainer tasks end to end, including task statements, datasets, simulation inputs, environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
  • Verify that tasks reflect authentic physics workflows and require genuine multi-step reasoning.
  • Check that tools, libraries, and dependencies are pinned and that results are reproducible.
  • Validate dimensional consistency, unit systems and conventions, conservation laws, symmetries, integrator energy drift, convergence, and statistical treatment of uncertainties.
  • Ensure tolerances reflect legitimate stochastic and numerical variation without accepting physically incorrect results.
  • Ensure graders verify observables, fitted parameters, uncertainties, or physical invariants rather than formatting.
  • Ensure tasks cannot be gamed through hard-coded outputs or bypassed computation.
  • Provide clear, actionable written feedback and track revisions through closure.
  • Onboard and mentor trainers.
  • Allocate work, track quality and throughput, and escalate blockers.
  • Maintain pod documentation covering guidelines, recurring issues, and exemplary tasks.

What we're looking for:
  • Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced experience in physics.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, Julia, or Fortran, with Linux proficiency.
  • Hands-on experience with computational physics, simulation, or physics data analysis.
  • Proven experience reviewing code, analyses, or research outputs.
  • Experience mentoring or leading small technical or research teams.
  • Excellent written communication skills for providing precise, constructive feedback

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Familiarity with QuTiP, Qiskit, Kwant, ITensor, ROOT, Geant4, Astropy, Dedalus, MEEP, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI systems, and automated testing.
  • Experience designing benchmarks or simulation-based evaluations.

Bonus Points:
  • Experience evaluating AI coding or terminal agents.
  • Experience working in large collaborations with formal internal review processes.
  • Prior experience in AI training or evaluation programs.

Offer Details:
  • Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

  • Demonstrate adherence to established safety policies and procedures.

  • Examine work and materials for compliance with specifications.

  • Accountable for safe work practices.

  • May be responsible for recording and reporting daily labor hours to timekeeper.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities\:

  • Ability to work on systems up to and including 13.8 KV.

  • Possess working knowledge of the National Electric Code.

  • Understand electrical circuits including the operation and function of typical electrical devices and machinery such as solenoids, relays, motors, transformers, switches, motor control centers, generators, batteries and lighting systems.

  • Experience working in Class One, Division I & II areas.

  • Understand Lock Out/Tag Out procedures.

  • Able to work as part of a team; communicate effectively with fellow workers and alternate.

  • Sound knowledge of operations and safety practices and policies.

  • Ability to lead a work crew to accomplish goals and objectives established by management.

  • Advanced leadership skills.

  • Ability to interpret electrical drawings and schematics.

  • Ability to do electrical work on both projects and maintenance.

  • Ability to work at facilities independently without direction or supervision.

Physical Demands/Work Environment\:

Work is performed in a remote Arctic environment with limited medical resources. Candidate understands the site is approximately 840 miles (at least 4 hours by air ambulance) from surgical, specialist, and tertiary medical care, and where medical evacuation from this location may be significantly delayed due to weather conditions. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the essential functions of this job, the employee is required to\:

  • Must have ability to stand, walk on level, uneven and slippery surfaces, sit, squat, kneel, crawl, reach through low and high ranges, work overhead, and exhibit normal balance and coordination. These basic physical requirements are essential for safe performance of the job in harsh environments with exposure to very cold temperatures and while wearing arctic gear.

  • Standing for prolonged periods of time.

  • Driving for prolonged periods of time in the dark and inclement weather

  • Ability to climb scaffold, ramps, stairs, equipment, portable ladders, and/or wellhouse/tank/facility fixed ladders of 20 feet or greater.

  • Ability to wear and utilize fall protection within manufacturer specifications.

  • Lift 50 lbs. from floor to waist with two hands.

  • Lift 50 lbs. from floor to shoulder with two hands.

  • Carry 50 lbs. for 15 feet with two hands.

  • Push/pull 60 lbs. sled for 20 feet.

  • Push/pull 90 lbs. cart for 20 feet.

This job description is intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of the job incumbents. Worley provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, including both applicants and employees, to allow the individual to perform the essential functions of the job, unless doing so would create an undue hardship.

In-Vehicle Monitoring System\: As part of our commitment to safety and accountability, company vehicles are equipped with in-cab cameras and vehicle monitoring systems. These systems may record video and audio, as well as collect GPS location, vehicle speed, harsh braking, rapid acceleration and other driving behaviors. All data is subject to review by management to ensure compliance with company policies and safe driving.

description:
About the Role

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the financial strategy of a leading regional fintech. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will own the FP&A engine across multiple markets, products, and entities, with your analyses directly informing strategic decisions across new products, partnerships, and markets. This is not a reporting-coordination role: on the processes you own, your judgment is the deliverable. We are looking for someone who forms a view and puts their name on it, challenges the business when the numbers don’t support the story, and is hungry to build rather than maintain.

What You Will Do

  • Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A): Own budgeting, forecasting, and monthly and weekly reporting cycles - delivered decision-ready and owning the recommendation

  • Fundraising & Investor Relations: Support capital-raising efforts by leading data room preparation — assembling, analysing, and quality-checking the financial models, performance data, and supporting materials that underpin investor due diligence.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or professional certification (CFA, CPA) preferred
  • 8–10+ years of experience in investment banking, strategic finance, or corporate FP&A, ideally in a high-growth or tech-driven environment
