title: Supervisor, Hardware Reliability (Starlink)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SUPERVISOR, HARDWARE RELIABILITY (STARLINK)

At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.

As a Supervisor on the Starlink Hardware Reliability team, you will lead a group of technicians and specialists responsible for root causing production failures on Starlink hardware. You will own the day-to-day operations of the production root cause lab and drive improvements that directly enhance product reliability and manufacturing quality.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of reliability technicians and specialists performing root cause analysis on electrical systems and PCBAs
  • Drive root cause findings into actionable improvements with manufacturing and design teams to reduce failure rates and improve yield
  • Own day-to-day operations of the production root cause lab, including technician scheduling, equipment maintenance, lab organization (5S), and resource planning
  • Develop and implement new processes and tools that improve the team’s ability to efficiently and accurately root cause electrical failures
  • Establish clear priorities across multiple shifts and ensure timely communication of findings and recommendations to production stakeholders
  • Define and track team performance metrics and key indicators, holding the team accountable to measurable outcomes
  • Identify development opportunities for team members that align with both individual growth and Starlink program goals

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 3+ years of quality or reliability experience in a manufacturing environment

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, aerospace engineering, or related technical field
  • Demonstrated experience performing root cause analysis on electrical systems and PCBAs with expertise in diagnosing and resolving issues related to solder joint quality, component failures, and manufacturing/assembly defects
  • Experience training, mentoring, and developing technicians or junior engineers
  • Proven ability to work in a fast-paced, highly iterative environment with rapidly changing priorities
  • Strong track record of influencing cross-functional teams through data-driven analysis and clear communication
  • Demonstrated ability to organize, prioritize, and drive completion of work across a team
  • Experience jumping into ambiguous problems and driving them to resolution
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience in consumer electronics, aerospace, automotive, or other high-volume hardware manufacturing environments
  • Familiarity with quality management systems (ISO 9001 or equivalent)

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to work extended hours, weekends, and offsite as needed
  • This position is based in Bastrop, TX and requires being onsite - remote work not considered
  • Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching may be required to perform functions of this position
  • Able to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted

title: Cultural Programming & Exhibition Production Internship (m/f/d)
description:
Cultural Programming & Exhibition Production Internship (m/f/d)

Turn artists, ideas and empty spaces into exhibitions, screenings, talks and live cultural moments.

Berlin · Primarily on-site · 3–6 months · Mandatory study internship

About the Role

#DAMUR is a Berlin-based high-end fashion label connecting gender-neutral fashion with music, nightlife, performance and contemporary culture.

You will support interdisciplinary cultural projects across contemporary art, fashion, electronic music, performance and queer culture. You will contribute to #DAMUR projects and the development of 25hrs LOVE, moving from research and artist communication to planning, installation, opening and exhibition take-down.

A Professional Working Internship

This is a professional working internship—not a classroom, observation placement or beginner curatorial course.

We provide clear briefs, professional context, feedback and access to real cultural projects. In return, you must already be able to research independently, organise information, communicate professionally and support practical production work. We do not teach the fundamentals of research, project organisation or professional communication from the beginning.

You do not need to arrive with an established cultural network, but you must be resourceful, reliable and ready to follow a project from an initial idea to practical execution. We are looking for students who want to contribute to real cultural projects—not wait for every step to be taught or repeatedly explained.

What You’ll Do

  • Research emerging artists, designers, performers, filmmakers and cultural initiatives
  • Shortlist artists and projects that fit a clear curatorial concept
  • Prepare concise visual research and support artist or gallery outreach
  • Maintain timelines, artwork lists, technical information and installation plans
  • Coordinate practical details with artists, technicians, suppliers and transport partners
  • Track replies, deadlines, confirmations and outstanding information
  • Support packing, installation, lighting, labelling, openings and exhibition take-down
  • Take responsibility for defined research, coordination and production tasks
  • Keep project files, contact information and production documents organised

You’re a Strong Fit If

  • You study cultural management, curatorial studies, art, architecture, spatial design, event production or a related subject
  • You are curious about emerging culture and research beyond obvious names
  • You can explain why an artist, project or format fits a specific curatorial direction
  • You combine creative judgment with strong organisation and follow-through
  • You communicate professionally in English
  • You can move a defined task forward without step-by-step supervision
  • You ask focused questions, act on feedback and communicate early when blocked
  • You enjoy practical, on-site work and are prepared to support physical installation and take-down
  • You care about both the cultural idea and the quality of its execution
  • German, Adobe, Canva or project-management experience is a plus

What You’ll Gain

  • Real responsibility within cultural programming and exhibition production
  • Experience taking a cultural project from initial research to opening
  • Direct contact with artists, venues, technicians and cultural partners
  • Practical experience with artwork lists, timelines, installation planning and on-site production
  • Direct professional feedback on the quality, relevance and execution of your work
  • Portfolio-relevant responsibility, subject to confidentiality

Practical Information

  • Location: Berlin, primarily on-site
  • Start: As soon as possible; the exact date is agreed with the selected candidate
  • Duration: 3–6 months
  • Eligibility: This must be a mandatory internship required by your university or a recognised study programme. Erasmus+ placements are welcome when they meet this condition
  • You must already have the right to complete an internship in Germany; we cannot provide employer visa sponsorship
  • Transport support: Your Berlin AB ticket or Deutschlandticket is fully covered
  • Studio benefits: Daily warm homemade lunch, La Marzocco espresso, snacks and drinks
  • Schedule: Occasional evening or weekend work may be needed for events; this will always be agreed in advance

How to Apply

Apply in English through FashionUnited by clicking "Apply.”

Upload your CV in PDF format. A portfolio or relevant cultural, curatorial, exhibition or event project example is welcome but optional.

In the Motivation field, answer the following in a maximum of 300 words:

  1. Name one exhibition, screening, cultural programme or live event you admire. What made it effective or memorable?
  2. Tell us about one cultural project, exhibition or event task you were responsible for. What did you do, and what was the result?
  3. State your earliest possible start date, how long you can stay (3–6 months), and confirm that this is a mandatory study internship.

No formal cover letter is required. We want to understand how you research, organise and respond to a brief—not read a generic letter about your background or what you hope to gain. Please answer all three questions directly.

title: Sale Photo & Listing Assistant
description:
Join Our Team at Caring Transitions of Beaverton, OR!

Position: Sale Photo & Listing Assistant
Location: Beaverton, OR (Greater Portland Area; jobs throughout Oregon)
Type: Part-Time

About Us
Caring Transitions of Beaverton, OR, is a growing small business that has spent the past three years providing compassionate relocation, downsizing, and estate liquidation services for seniors. Our mission is to make life’s transitions smoother and give our clients peace of mind during what can be a challenging time.

About This Role
Is photography your hobby? Do you notice the light in a room, retake a shot because it’s slightly blurry, and care how your photos turn out? Then this role could be a great fit.

We’re looking for a photography enthusiast, not a professional, who enjoys taking great pictures and wants to put that skill to work. You’ll photograph furniture, collectibles, antiques, artwork, jewelry, and everyday household items for our online auctions, consignment sales, and estate sales. Better photos sell items for more, and that directly benefits the seniors and families we serve.

Why Join Us?

  • Get Paid for Your Hobby: Use your eye for photography every day on a huge variety of items, from mid-century furniture to vintage cameras to fine china.
  • Impactful Work: Every item you photograph helps a senior or their family get the most from their belongings during a big life change.
  • Collaborative Environment: Be part of a supportive team where your contributions are valued and you can grow with us.
  • Flexible Hours: Typical hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, scheduled around our sales.

What You’ll Do

  • Photograph Items with Care: Take several photos of each item: front, back, labels, maker’s marks, serial numbers, and any damage. Make the most of available light and backgrounds, and show each item honestly and at its best.
  • Label Each Item: Follow our item-numbering system so every photo is matched to the right item and listing.
  • Capture the Details Buyers Ask About: Measure furniture and larger items, photograph signatures, and note anything the camera can’t show, like a wobble or a smell.
  • Upload & Organize: Upload each sale’s photos to our shared folders, organized by sale, so listings can be prepared quickly.
  • Review & Fix: Check draft listings for accuracy, then retake photos or add notes wherever something is unclear or missing.
  • Stage for Sales: Help arrange, group, and prepare items for online auctions, consignment, and estate sales, and pitch in on other sale prep as needed.
  • Collaborate: Work closely with our team and, at times, with clients and their families, with a professional and empathetic approach.

Who We’re Looking For

  • Passionate About Photography: You enjoy taking photos and care about quality: focus, lighting, framing, and true-to-life color. Experience with a smartphone or a camera is welcome. No professional background needed.
  • Detail-Oriented: You notice chips, stains, missing pieces, and maker’s marks, and you capture them. Honest listings build buyer trust.
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with smartphone apps, Google Drive, and scheduling and time-keeping tools.
  • Organized & Consistent: You follow the same steps every time, even on a 300-item sale.
  • Empathetic & Respectful: You understand that these are people’s personal belongings and treat clients and their homes with care.
  • Physically Capable: Able to lift and move items weighing 40–60 pounds and to stand, bend, and kneel for extended periods.
  • Reliable: Reliable transportation to job sites across the Greater Portland area and beyond.
  • Flexible & Adaptable: Able to work in varied environments, including cluttered or unclean spaces (we provide gloves and aprons).

Compensation

  • Starting pay: $17–$22.50 per hour, based on experience.

How to Apply
If you love photography and enjoy helping people, we’d love to hear from you! Please submit your resume and a short cover letter explaining why you’re a great fit. Please include 3–5 photos you’ve taken that you’re proud of. Photos of objects or still life are especially helpful.

Availability

  • Part-time, flexible hours. Let us know your availability when you apply.

Equal Opportunity Employer
Caring Transitions of Beaverton is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Ministry Assistant
description:

1

ABOUT US

The Salvation Army is a Christian movement and one of Australia's largest and most-loved charities. We believe in doing good that transforms lives and futures for the better. It is this belief which drives us to find new ways and places where we can make a difference. From times of personal crisis to moments of national grief, we are always here — providing support, safety, community, and opportunity.

Why this role matters


At The Salvation Army, we are called to share the love of Jesus by caring for people, building healthy communities, creating faith pathways and working for justice. Every day, through local Corps and centres across Australia, we create opportunities for people to experience belonging, discover hope, encounter Christ and live out their God-given purpose.


As a Ministry Assistant, you will play a vital role in supporting the mission and ministry of the local Corps. This is an opportunity to use your gifts, faith and passion for people to help others grow spiritually, build meaningful relationships and experience the transforming love of Jesus.



About the role


This is your opportunity to make a meaningful ministry impact by helping people encounter Jesus, grow in faith and actively participate in the life and mission of The Salvation Army.


Working closely with local ministry leaders and volunteers, you will support the delivery of worship, discipleship, pastoral care and community-based mission activities. You will help foster an environment where people are encouraged to explore faith, experience authentic community and discover opportunities to serve and grow.

Reporting to the Corps Officers, this is a 12 month max-term, full-time role, located in Little Mountain, QLD, Australia



How you will make an impact


  • Support and contribute to worship services, prayer gatherings, discipleship opportunities and other faith-based ministry activities.
  • Build authentic relationships that encourage spiritual growth, connection and a sense of belonging.
  • Provide pastoral care, prayer and practical support to individuals and families within the Corps and wider community.

  • Recruit, equip, encourage and support volunteers to fulfil their gifts and contribute to local mission outcomes.
  • Assist with the planning, coordination and delivery of ministry programs, outreach initiatives and community events.
  • Contribute to a culture of welcome, discipleship, service and prayer that reflects the mission and values of The Salvation Army.



What you will bring


  • A personal commitment to the Christian faith and the mission of The Salvation Army.
  • A heart for ministry and a passion for sharing the love of Jesus through service, discipleship and community engagement.
  • Experience in ministry, church leadership, pastoral care, discipleship, community outreach or volunteer-led activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to build authentic relationships with people from diverse backgrounds and life experiences.

Requirements

  • Current driver's licence.



Why join us?


When you join The Salvation Army, you become part of something bigger than a job. You join a movement of people committed to sharing hope, serving others and seeing lives transformed through the love of Jesus.


Eligible employees can access a range of benefits including:

  • Purchased Leave Scheme (up to 8 weeks) and 5 days paid leave per year to experience working in other TSA programs or activities.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Access to EAP and health & wellness initiatives incl Fitness Passport
  • Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander supports such as: Burra Burra Network (pastoral care network), Cultural Events, Sorry Business and Ceremonial Leave (up to 10 days)
  • Ongoing training and development opportunities that enhance on the job skills and proficiency.
  • Rewarding and fulfilling purpose driven careers that have positive and sustainable / social impacts.

A calling to ministry


We recognise that ministry is more than a profession. It is an opportunity to faithfully serve God and others through practical action, authentic relationships and the proclamation of the Gospel.

If you are passionate about helping people encounter Jesus, grow in community and discover hope for the future, we'd love to hear from you.



How to apply

  • Your faith journey and commitment to Christian ministry.
  • Your relevant ministry, church, volunteer or community experience.
  • Why you are interested in serving with The Salvation Army.
  • How your skills and experience align with the requirements of the role.


Applications will be assessed as received and may close prior to the advertised closing date if a suitable candidate is identified.

description:

In this role, you will manage lower and production environments, maintain system performance and security baselines, and assist cross-functional development teams in onboarding and integrating automated continuous delivery toolsets.

Responsibilities:

DevSecOps Platform Administration & Maintenance

  • Perform regular maintenance, software updates, and security patch management across lower and upper environments.

  • Monitor platform availability, resource utilization, and overall system compute and memory performance.

  • Administer identity and access control, including Single Sign-On (SSO) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

Core Toolchain Management

  • GitHub Enterprise: Manage organizational units, user permissions, licensing allocations, and conﬁgure self-hosted runners for development teams.

  • CloudBees Jenkins: Administer controllers and agents at the server level, provision resources, and maintain core controller conﬁgurations.

  • SonarQube: Maintain server environments, manage user and project assignments, and conﬁgure code analysis proﬁles.

  • JFrog Artifactory & Xray: Administer artifact repositories, manage permissions, and conﬁgure vulnerability scanning policies.

Pipeline Integration & Operational Support

  • Assist engineering and delivery teams with onboarding onto shared services platforms.

  • Support developers in integrating automated code analysis, artifact management, and security scans into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Triage and resolve platform-related operational issues and access requests in a timely manner.

  • Maintain alignment with organizational security standards, access governance, and change management procedures.

Qualification & Requirements:

  • Experience: 3–6+ years of relevant experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, or Systems Administration in enterprise settings.

  • Platform Expertise: Proven administrative experience with GitHub Enterprise, CloudBees Jenkins (or enterprise Jenkins), SonarQube, and JFrog Artifactory & Xray.

  • Identity & Access: Experience managing RBAC policies and enterprise authentication integrations (SSO, SAML, LDAP).

  • Infrastructure: Practical background in Linux/Unix administration, environment monitoring, and performance maintenance.

  • Security Hygiene: Familiarity with routine security patching, access governance, and standard organizational clearance/trust requirements.

Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code practices and conﬁguration automation tools.

  • Exposure to containerized platforms and modern cloud service environments.

  • Relevant vendor or industry technical certiﬁcations (e.g., Cloud, Jenkins, GitHub, or Security).

Note: Candidate must be a U.S. citizen or green card holder who has resided in the U.S. for at least 3 years with the ability to obtain a public trust clearance.

title: ARC Research Fellow, Social Performance and Indigenous Cultural Heritage – Identified s25
description:
• Faculty of Engineering, Architecture and Information Technology / Sustainable Minerals Institute / ARC Training Centre for Archaeology on the Resources Sector
  • Full-time fixed-term position for 2 years
  • Base salary will be in the range $119,462.94 - $141,545.09 + 17% super (Academic Level B)
  • This position is open to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates only, as a genuine occupational requirement to inform mining and social performance, cultural heritage management in the resources sector, and community engagement
  • Based at our St Lucia Campus with travel to remote areas


Acknowledgement of Country

The University of Queensland (UQ) acknowledges the Traditional Owners and their custodianship of the lands on which UQ operates. We pay our respects to their Ancestors and their descendants, who continue cultural and spiritual connections to Country. We recognise their valuable contributions to Australian and global society.


About This Opportunity

Join the Centre for Social Responsibility in Mining (CSRM) within the Sustainable Minerals Institute, and the Australian Research Council Training Centre for Archaeology in the Resources Sector as a Research Fellow and contribute to applied research that responds to the social challenges and opportunities associated with resource extraction. In this collaborative, multidisciplinary role, you will deliver funded research projects, build meaningful relationships with Indigenous communities as rights and interest holders and industry partners, and translate research into outcomes that create academic and real-world impact.

The role will contribute to the ARC Training Centre for Archaeology in the Resources Sector, a collaboration involving Traditional Owners, universities, resources companies, archaeologists, and cultural heritage experts. The Centre aims to develop new approaches to safeguarding Indigenous cultural heritage and strengthening cultural heritage management within the resources sector.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Research: Coordinate, design and deliver applied research within the ARC Training Centre and CSRM projects, including data collection and analysis, literature reviews, high-quality publications, end-user knowledge products, project proposals and funding applications, while working collaboratively with Indigenous communities, industry partners and other research end users.
  • Teaching: Contribute to research training and teaching within CSRM through guest lectures, tutorials and short courses, while supporting professional development, knowledge transfer and curriculum activities aligned with research expertise.
  • Supervision and Researcher Development: Contribute to the supervision of Honours and Higher Degree by Research students, support UQ’s PhD cohort within the ARC Training Centre, and foster a collaborative research culture that supports peer learning and researcher capability development.
  • Citizenship and Service: Build purposeful partnerships within UQ and with Indigenous communities, industry, government, professional bodies and the wider community, while contributing to internal and external service activities and consistently demonstrating UQ values.

This is a research focused position. Further information can be found by viewing UQ’s Criteria for Academic Performance.

For further information, please click here to view the information booklet.


About You

The University of Queensland considers that to perform this role, it is essential that the person is an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander person. It is therefore a genuine occupational requirement under section 25 of the Anti-Discrimination Act 1991 (Qld). The position is therefore only open to Australian Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people. The successful candidate will be required to provide evidence to confirm that they are an Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person.

  • Completion of a PhD in a relevant discipline (e.g., social sciences, geography, anthropology, development studies, archaeology or related field).
  • Demonstrated understanding of the histories and distinct cultures of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, with demonstrated experience working and engaging effectively with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities.
  • Demonstrated experience in applied research, preferably in resource sectors, social performance, or governance-related areas.
  • Emerging track record of research outputs, including peer-reviewed publications and/or industry-focused reports.
  • Experience in qualitative and/or quantitative research methodologies.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and engage effectively with diverse stakeholders, including in regional and remote areas.
  • Demonstrated organisational and project support skills, with the ability to contribute to multiple projects.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and a commitment to ethical research practices and socially responsible research outcomes.
  • A current valid driver licence.


About UQ

As part of the UQ community, you will join a Group of Eight university recognised for excellence in teaching, research and engagement. UQ offers a supportive and rewarding academic environment, with benefits including recognition of prior service with other Australian universities, up to 26 weeks paid parental leave, 17.5% annual leave loading, flexible and hybrid working arrangements, access to exclusive internal‑only vacancies, cultural leave, and genuine career progression through the academic promotions process. You will also have opportunities to connect with vibrant staff networks, including the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Staff Network, fostering a strong sense of community and belonging.

UQ is committed to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples’ learning, discovery and engagement, and to playing a leading role in reconciliation in Australia. Guided by the University’s Strategic Plan, Stretch Reconciliation Action Plan and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Employment Strategy, we work in partnership with communities to embed reconciliation across our operations. Your cultural identity will be respected, valued and embraced, and you will be supported to contribute to an organisation that champions Indigenous voices.



About the ARC Training Centre for Archaeology in the Resources Sector

The ARC Training Centre is 5-year, $18m investment to transform cultural heritage management in the resources industry. Led by Flinders University with the University of Queensland, Southern Cross University and Partner Organisations (including Indigenous organisations, cultural heritage consultants and mining companies) it aims to strengthen Australia’s capability in responsible mining and cultural heritage management through training a highly skilled, interdisciplinary workforce that integrates Indigenous partnerships, archaeological expertise, critical thinking and social performance (https://www.archaeologytrainingcentre.org/).


Interested?

For more information about this opportunity, please contact Associate Professor Sarah Holcombe at s.holcombe@uq.edu.au. For application inquiries, please reach out to the Talent Acquisition team at talent@uq.edu.au, stating the job reference number (below) in the subject line.

When you apply, please ensure you upload a resume and cover letter summarizing how your background aligns to the ‘About You’ section. Please note that applications received via email will not be accepted.


Other Information

Pre-employment checks may include: verification of the right to work in Australia and qualification checks. This may also include checks relating to gender-based violence matters or other integrity and conduct requirements.

Relocating from interstate? We may support you with a relocation support package, however upfront costs will still be expected to be covered. You can find out more about life in Australia’s Sunshine State here.

We're dedicated to equity, diversity, and inclusion. We recognise that career pathways and opportunities differ, and encourage applications from candidates who may not meet every criteria but can demonstrate their potential relative to opportunity. We’re also happy to support any accessibility needs throughout the recruitment process. Just let us know how we can help by emailing talent@uq.edu.au or calling +61 7 3365 2623.

Applications close Sunday December 6th 2026 at 11.00pm AEST (R-69982).

title: Project Manager
description:
We currently have an opportunity for a Project Manager. Join our Health and Education team and play a key role in safely delivering facilities, refurbishment and capital works projects across the SA Schools PPP portfolio.
Reporting to the Asset Manager, you’ll manage projects from early scoping and procurement through construction, commissioning, financial close-out and handover. Working across live school environments, you’ll balance safety, quality, commercial requirements and stakeholder needs to deliver successful project outcomes.
What You'll Do
This role offers a broad scope, with key responsibilities including:
  • Manage a mixed portfolio of minor works, lifecycle, modification and higher-value capital projects from scope development through to operational handover.
  • Develop project briefs, scopes, budgets, schedules, risk registers, delivery strategies and reporting requirements.
  • Lead RFQ and tender processes, including documentation, market engagement, evaluation, recommendations and contractor appointment.
  • Control project costs, forecasts, progress claims, variations, commitments and commercial correspondence.
  • Coordinate schools, clients, operational teams, consultants and contractors while maintaining safety, quality, compliance and minimal disruption to school operations.

What You'll Bring

  • Demonstrated experience delivering facilities, building services, refurbishment or capital works projects from scoping through to handover.
  • Proven capability managing minor works and larger capital projects in live operational environments.
  • Experience managing procurement, RFQ and tender processes, tender evaluation, contractor appointment and contract administration.
  • Strong project planning, scheduling, cost control, risk management, commercial and stakeholder engagement capability.
  • A relevant tertiary, vocational or trade qualification. An HVAC or electrical trade background will be highly regarded.
Experience within education, health, public infrastructure, PPP or integrated facilities management environments will be highly regarded. A formal project management qualification such as PRINCE2 or PMP is desirable. You’ll also require a current construction industry White Card and unrestricted driver licence, or the capacity to obtain these before commencing site duties.
More than anything, you’ll bring a strong work ethic, a positive attitude and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes for our clients.

Why Downer?

Downer plans, creates and sustains essential public services across Australia and New Zealand. From hospitals to data centres and defence partnerships, we manage critical infrastructure that keeps communities thriving.

What it means to belong at Downer


We’re proud of our high-performance culture and commitment to diversity, offering:

  • Training and development to support and diversify your career.

  • With 30% of vacancies filled internally, you’ll find real opportunities to advance your career.

  • Perks@Downer, including healthcare discounts and savings on retail and car purchases.

  • Employee Assistance Program providing professional support for you and your family when you need it most.


You want your work to matter and so do we. With over 26,000 people across Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific, our team is made up of individuals with unique perspectives, backgrounds and ideas.

We know that diversity makes us stronger and we actively celebrate it through our commitment to inclusion and belonging.

We’re committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve and welcome people of all ages, genders, sexual orientations, cultures, abilities and lived experiences. We especially encourage applications from those whose voices have traditionally been underrepresented in our industry, including women, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples, Māori and Pasifika Peoples, veterans, people with disability and neurodivergent individuals. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with this role, we’d still like to hear from you. If it feels like the right fit, apply. Potential counts, and so do you.

As a WORK180 Endorsed Employer, we support flexibility that works for your life, inclusive leadership that values your voice and equitable access to opportunity so you can do your best work and bring your whole self to it.

If you need support or adjustments through the recruitment process, just let us know. We’re here to help you put your best foot forward.

title: Instrument Technician
description:

title: Safety 1
description:
Site Safety Manager (Construction / EHS)

Build safer projects. Protect people. Lead with impact.

At Incorp Industries, safety is more than compliance—it’s who we are. We provide scaffolding, industrial insulation, sheet metal, asbestos abatement, lead removal, sandblasting, and coating services to power plants, refineries, mills, universities, and major industrial facilities.

We are looking for Site Safety Managers to join our growing team on projects in North Carolina and the Midwest. Each manager is dedicated to one project at a time, supporting multi-craft construction teams through the life of the project. When one project ends, our team members transition to the next—providing stable, long-term career opportunities across regions.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead site safety programs, ensuring compliance with OSHA, EPA, MSHA, DOT, state, local, client, and company standards.
  • Conduct daily inspections, hazard assessments, and corrective action tracking.
  • Mentor and coach employees to build a strong, people-first safety culture.
  • Investigate incidents, document findings, and ensure lessons learned are shared.
  • Deliver site orientations and ongoing safety training.
  • Review new scopes of work to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Oversee safety aspects of scaffolding, insulation, blasting, abatement, and coatings projects.
  • Partner with site supervision and corporate safety teams to solve challenges and continuously improve.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • OSHA 30 certification.
  • Hands-on scaffold experience.
  • 3–5 years of EHS experience in construction or industrial settings.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to lead and mentor a diverse workforce.

Preferred:

  • OSHA 500 Trainer, HAZWOPER, or other advanced safety certifications.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish).
  • Asbestos/Lead abatement training.
  • MS Office competency.

Why Join Us

  • People-first culture: Safety is more than compliance—it’s how we protect and empower our teams.
  • Steady project work: Move from project to project without the seasonal layoffs common in the trades.
  • Impactful leadership: You’ll have a direct role in protecting crews and ensuring projects are completed safely and successfully.
  • Diverse industries: From power generation to manufacturing to higher education, every project brings unique challenges and learning opportunities.

title: Associate, Full-Stack Engineering
description:
As Associate, Full-Stack Engineering, you will build, test and support web applications as part of a small team. This role suits engineers who want broad hands-on experience across the frontend, backend and database.

  • Application development: Build features across the frontend, backend and database, translating requirements, particularly those of the audit department, into working software. Deliver assigned tasks to agreed timelines and quality expectations.
  • Engineering practices: Write secure, tested and well-documented code, and take part in code reviews. Follow the team's templates, conventions and quality controls, and use AI-assisted development tools responsibly.
  • APIs, data and platform: Develop APIs and data models, and deploy applications to the firm's central application platform using its CI/CD pipelines. Work with AI engineers to integrate AI services into applications.
  • Data security and confidentiality: Apply access controls and handle client data in line with the firm's data security and client-data confidentiality requirements.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: Work with business users and project sponsors to clarify requirements and acceptance criteria, and support user testing, implementation and adoption.
  • Application support: Document, monitor and maintain applications after go-live, and investigate and resolve production issues, escalating where needed.

Requirements:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.
  • Around 1-3 years of software engineering experience; fresh graduates with relevant internships, academic or personal projects are also welcome to apply.
  • Experience, through work or projects, building web applications and APIs backed by relational databases.
  • Familiarity with Git, testing and secure coding practices; exposure to containerisation (e.g. Docker), cloud services and CI/CD pipelines is an advantage.
  • Good problem-solving and communication skills, with attention to detail and a willingness to learn.
  • Interest in delivering technology solutions in professional services, audit or another regulated environment is an advantage.

title: Duty Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Serves as the property Manager on Duty and oversees all property operations, ensuring that the highest levels of hospitality and service are provided. Represents property management in resolving any guest or property related situation. Manages the flow of questions and directs guests within the lobby. Serves as Guest Relations Manager and handles the tracking of service issues.

You will join our Digital Transverse Functions Solutions Team (EIIF) whose objective is to build, develop and maintain new Digital solutions in different functional perimeters as HR, Corporate functions, Procurement, Quality & Programs.

You will be part of a multicultural team involved in the design, building and deployment of Digital solutions based on custom development or Saas solutions.

We are seeking an Experienced Technical Lead to oversee, mentor, and guide a newly recruited team of Junior Web Developers supporting the Procurement and Quality roadmap.

In this role, you will combine strong technical authority with hands-on architecture, code review, and developer coaching. You will drive the technical strategy, modernization, and long-term stability of our enterprise web applications while serving as the primary technical interface between business stakeholders and the development team.


YOUR CHALLENGES

As a Technical Lead, your mission spans four main pillars:


1. Team Leadership & Technical Governance

  • Mentorship & Code Quality: Lead, mentor, and foster technical growth for 3 Junior Developers. Establish best practices, continuous integration guidelines, and perform rigorous code reviews.
  • Architecture & Design: Define the technical architecture, design patterns, and standards across Front-end (Angular) and Back-end (Java Spring Boot) microservices/applications.
  • Agile & Delivery: Break down complex business demands into clear technical user stories, manage technical debt, and ensure high-quality, on-time technical deliveries.

2. System Architecture & Modernization (New Projects & Innovation)

  • Greenfield Architecture: Lead the architecture and implementation of new projects within the Procurement and Quality roadmap.
  • Infrastructure & Migration: Drive the modernization and migration of application components in our virtualized RedHat 8 infrastructure (Apache/Tomcat, CI/CD pipelines via GitLab & Jenkins).
  • API & System Integration: Oversee the design and implementation of robust RESTful APIs and integrations with enterprise systems.

3. Performance, Security & Scalability Optimization

  • Deep-Dive Auditing: Audit and optimize multi-layer application performance across both front-end (Angular/PrimeNG) and back-end (Java/SQL Server).
  • Data & Database Tuning: Lead complex SQL optimizations, Liquibase schema migrations, and Hibernate/JPA tuning to support increasing data volumes.
  • Security & Stability: Enforce application security standards, conduct root-cause analyses for critical production issues, and establish long-term system stability.

4. Change & Corrective Maintenance Leadership

  • Complex Problem Solving: Handle high-level escalations, complex bugs, and performance bottlenecks that go beyond junior troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and Procurement stakeholders to translate functional requirements into scalable technical solutions.

SKILLS

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you:

Education: Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

Experience: 5+ years of software development experience, including at least 1–2 years in a Technical Lead, Lead Developer, or Senior Architect role mentoring junior developers.

Technical Stack Mastery

  • Back-End Expertise: Master level in Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate, Maven, and REST API design.
  • Front-End Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Angular (latest versions), TypeScript, RxJS, Node, Bootstrap, and PrimeNG.
  • Database & ORM: Advanced SQL Server knowledge, complex query tuning, transaction management, and schema management via Liquibase.
  • DevOps & Infrastructure: Strong experience with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins pipelines, Linux, Apache HTTP Server, and Tomcat application servers.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) is a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • People Leadership & Mentorship: Passion for coaching junior talent, providing constructive feedback, and building a collaborative technical environment.
  • Resilience & Pragmatism: Drives in solving high-stakes technical incidents and navigating complex legacy-to-modern transitions.
  • Business insight & Service orientation: Ability to understand business priorities (Procurement/Quality) and communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

title: Python Developer
description:
About Us:
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. We especially welcome graduates from top computer science programs such as Stanford, MIT, Carnegie Mellon, UC Berkeley, Georgia Tech, and comparable institutions — though exceptional experience and skill always take precedence over pedigree.

As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections — with a primary focus on Python across backend services, data pipelines, and ML infrastructure, alongside JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go. You will evaluate and refine AI-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability, and work with cross-functional teams to enhance enterprise-level AI-driven coding solutions.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?
  • Work on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in Python, with additional work in JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go.
  • Evaluate and refine AI-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance AI-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks.
  • Build agents and automated verification tools in Python that can verify the quality of code and identify error patterns.
  • Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them.
  • Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task.

Required Skills:
  • Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more).
  • Strong expertise in Python with deep knowledge of frameworks, tooling, and best practices for building production-grade software.
  • Experience building full-stack applications and deploying scalable software using modern languages and tools.
  • Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales.

Engagement Details:

  • Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit).
  • Location: Candidates must be based in the United States.

Evaluation Process:
  • The application process takes 15–30 minutes.
  • Completion of an AI video interview is required.

title: General Manager - JW Marriott Hotel Jakarta
description:
HOTEL DESCRIPTION

JW Marriott Hotel Jakarta has 320 rooms and suites, 6 dining outlets, a fitness center, a spa, an outdoor pool, and an executive lounge. It offers 17 event venues with 31,215 sq ft of event space, including the Dua Mutiara Ballroom, which holds up to 900 guests.
The hotel is in Mega Kuningan, Jakarta's central business district, within walking distance of Lotte Shopping Avenue and Kuningan City Mall. It is about 1.9 miles from Setiabudi One and 13 miles from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport.

JOB SUMMARY

Functions as the primary strategic business leader of the property with responsibility for all aspects of the operation, including guest and employee satisfaction, human resources, financial performance, sales and revenue generation and delivering a return on investment to both Marriott International and property ownership. Verifies implementation of the Marriott brand service strategy and brand initiatives with the objective of meeting or exceeding guest expectations, increased profit and market share. Holds property leadership team accountable for strategy execution, and guides their individual professional development. The position ensures Marriott International sales engines are leveraged and initiates independent and proactive sales activities, when appropriate, to generate demand. Verifies that the objectives and goals of Marriott and property owners work together to achieve brand positioning and success. Builds owner loyalty through proactive communication, setting and managing expectations and delivering solid business results. The position is actively involved in the local community and builds strong relationships with local officials, businesses, and customers. Represents Marriott Hotels & Resorts and JW brand values in all leadership actions.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

The ideal candidate for this role would have previous work experience in Luxury brand and Indonesia as a General Manager.

Education and Experience

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years’ experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, finance and accounting, or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 6 years’ experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, finance and accounting, or related professional area.

JOB SPECIFIC TASKS

Business Strategy Development

Stays current with industry trends and monitors strengths and weakness of competition; explores new business opportunities; develops business plans designed to maximize property customer satisfaction, profitability, and market share; ensures property business plans are aligned with Marriott brand business strategies; translates Marriott global strategic plan into one that can be executed on property.

Business Strategy Execution

Executes business plans designed to maximize property customer satisfaction, profitability, and market share; ensures that property business plans and employees are aligned with MHR/JW brand business strategies; holds property leadership team accountable for successful delivery of business plans; experiments with new ideas and takes calculated risks to improve guest satisfaction and profitability; evaluates the success of property business strategies to inform future business plan enhancements; continually ensures business plans and actions have a positive impact on property performance.

Sales and Marketing

Works closely with Sales and Marketing team to develop revenue generating strategies for property; identifies new business leads, develops tailored sales approach, and actively pursues leads with Sales and Marketing team; ensures sales and marketing strategy is aligned with brand strategy and is effectively executed against established goals; ensures property leaders understand and leverage Marriott demand engines to full potential; augments guest preference for property through booking ease and quality interactions with sales force.

Talent Management and Organizational Capability

Creates a cohesive and high-performance Executive Committee that continuously strives for positive results and improvement; coaches Executive Committee by providing specific feedback and holds them accountable for performance; creates learning and development opportunities for employees; creates and effectively executes development plans for both direct reports based on their individual strengths, development needs, and career aspirations; ensures all managers are doing the same for their direct reports; identifies resource needs to strengthen property team; creates succession plans for future job openings; actively supports the staffing process; ensures effective work processes, systems and teamwork are in place to maximize individual and overall property performance.

Brand Champion

Serves as a passionate brand advocate and ensures that the intent of the brand is pulled through in the guest experience; communicates a clear and consistent message regarding property and MHR/JW brand goals to employees, property leadership team, and owners; serves as a role model by demonstrating exceptional work ethic and service delivery for all employees on property; champions change; inspires and motivates team to achieve operational excellence; represents MHR/JW brand values in all leadership actions.

Business Information Analysis

Reviews business related data such as market share, financial performance, inventory, employee engagement, and customer satisfaction; analyzes business information to proactively address changing market conditions, ensure property operates within budgetary guidelines, and achieves profit margin goals; uses business information to identify indicators of product and service successes and opportunities for improvement; integrates business information into business plans.

Employee and Labor Relations

Ensures all employees are treated fairly, and with respect; builds rapport with employees by fostering an environment of open communication and spending time with employees on the frontlines; makes self-available to employees (“open door policy”); ensures pay and benefits are appropriate for labor market; celebrates the success of employees in a public way; works with Human Resources to maximize employee engagement and monitor local labor environment to address issues as needed.

Revenue Management

Reliable clinical applications enable healthcare professionals to deliver effective, coordinated care. Rackner is seeking an experienced Clinical Workflow Analyst to diagnose complex electronic health record (EHR) issues, restore functional workflows, and strengthen application reliability in mission-critical federal healthcare environments.

In this hands-on role, you'll apply your EHR expertise to resolve challenging application issues, manage cases through confirmed resolution, and identify opportunities to improve clinical technology operations. What You'll Do

  • Evaluate the functional impact of application releases and changes, identifying workflow implications and communicating findings to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Provide functional application expertise during priority incidents, contributing to troubleshooting and coordinated resolution through case closure.

  • Provide functional application assistance during go-lives and clinical unit transitions, including occasional onsite engagement to address issues and facilitate operational readiness.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience supporting electronic health records (EHR) or clinical applications.
  • Direct professional experience supporting clinical workflows within designated military healthcare EHR environments.
  • Professional experience handling application support cases using ServiceNow.
  • Active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.
  • Strong functional troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across clinical and technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with specialized operational or field healthcare applications.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
  • Experience with EHR utilization analytics and application performance insights tools.

Why Rackner?

At Rackner, you'll contribute to meaningful federal healthcare technology initiatives that help clinical teams work more effectively. You'll have the opportunity to solve complex application challenges, collaborate with multidisciplinary professionals, and influence improvements that strengthen healthcare technology operations.

We value practical problem-solving, technical curiosity, accountability, and professionals who take ownership of delivering reliable solutions.

This is a remote, U.S.-based position requiring occasional travel to support clinical application go-lives and operational transitions.

title: Software Engineer - Python/Typescript
description:
About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.

About the Role

We’re looking for experienced, hands-on software engineers to help evaluate and improve AI coding models.

Rather than primarily building production applications, you’ll work with coding agents across real-world repositories and assess the quality of their work. You’ll review generated code and agent behavior, determine whether solutions are technically correct, identify failure modes, and create the evaluation signals and feedback used to improve model performance.

Think of the coding agent as another engineer whose work you’re reviewing: Can it understand the task? Did it choose the right approach? Is the resulting code correct, robust, and maintainable? Can you explain precisely where it succeeded or failed?

What You’ll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated code and solutions across real-world software repositories
  • Review agent behavior, tool usage, and code changes for correctness and quality
  • Identify technical errors, weak approaches, and recurring model failure modes
  • Compare model outputs and explain why one solution is better than another
  • Create and refine rubrics and evaluation criteria for coding tasks
  • Produce high-quality evaluation and preference data used to improve coding models
  • Build and maintain pipelines and infrastructure supporting data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows
  • Synthesize findings from data work into clear write-ups, updates, and recommendations for the team
  • Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers to translate qualitative judgment into scalable processes
  • Share clear, actionable findings with AI researchers and engineers

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience
  • Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or another major production language
  • Experience working in substantial real-world codebases
  • Strong code-review skills and technical judgment
  • Ability to clearly explain why an implementation is correct, incorrect, or could be improved
  • Strong written communication
  • Experience using modern LLMs or AI coding tools
Experience with LLM evaluation, coding agents, RLHF, preference data, rubric design, or post-training is a plus, but not required.

Engagement Details

  • Compensation: Market rate; please provide a specific hourly rate expectation
  • Availability: 40 hours/week preferred, with at least 6 hours of Pacific Time overlap
  • Type: Independent contractor
  • Duration: Approximately 3 months
  • Start: As soon as possible
  • Location: North America, LATAM, or India

Evaluation Process

  • AI interview (~25 minutes)
  • Practical code/AI evaluation exercise (~30 minutes)
  • Hiring manager interview (~20 minutes)

The practical exercise focuses on your ability to review and evaluate AI-generated code, not competitive programming or algorithm puzzles.

description:

Display basic ability to repair or replace PVC copper pipe (including soldering). Use the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Display working knowledge of all engineering computer programs related to preventative maintenance, energy management, and other systems, including devices that interact with such programs. Perform mid-level troubleshooting of hotel Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems. Display the ability to train and mentor other engineers (e.g., Engineer I). Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance. Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. At least 2 years of hotel engineering/maintenance experience.

title: Implementation and Optimization Manager
description:
About the Company

The next generation of independent cardiology is being built here. CardioOne is a physician-led, technology-driven cardiology platform built to empower independent practices to compete, and win, in a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape. Our mission is to provide cardiologists with the tools, infrastructure, and expertise they need to thrive while maintaining full clinical independence. We believe the best care is delivered by physicians who are empowered - not constrained - by the systems around them. We combine a deep bench of healthcare operators with purpose-built technology and AI-enabled solutions across operations, revenue cycle, imaging, and practice development. From real estate and advanced imaging to clinical workflows and data infrastructure, CardioOne delivers a fully integrated platform designed to drive growth, efficiency, and superior patient outcomes.

Backed by WindRose Health Investors and leading healthcare executives, CardioOne is building one of the most sophisticated and scalable cardiology MSOs in the country - designed to reimagine what is possible for independent cardiology.

About the Job

CardioOne is hiring a highly organized and experienced Healthcare Project Manager to join our dynamic team. You will be responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing multi-service line implementation projects from inception to completion and may include new programming as well as optimization of current programs. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering projects on time and within budget. You will work remotely and report directly to the VP of Implementation.

What you'll do:

  • Content expert for project management processes and methods.

  • Partner with the VP of Implementation to ensure new practices and new clinical programs are launched with appropriate clinical workflows, training, competencies, equipment readiness, quality controls, and escalation pathways.

  • Work closely with Revenue Cycle, Credentialing, Product, and other functional teams to support programs that are operationally sound, appropriately documented, compliant, and scalable across multiple states.

  • Focuses on enhancing practice efficiency and effectiveness through project management methods.

  • Owns creating and tracking projects within project management software.

  • Works collaboratively with the operations team, organizational leaders, staff, and physicians to assist in successful project implementation.

  • Supports interdisciplinary teams with an emphasis on developing and refining methodologies to continually improve the patient experience and practice engagement across CardioOne

  • Assists in development of program designs, including recommended workflows, policies, procedures, protocols, staffing models, competencies, training materials, implementation standards, performance measures, and continuous-improvement processes.

What you'll need:

  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business management, or a related field or equivalent job experience.

  • 5-10 years of relevant project management experience within the healthcare industry.

  • Start-up experience a plus.

  • Expert proficiency with Visio, Monday.com (or equivalent), and PowerPoint.

  • Proven experience in project management within medical practices, including successful project completion.

  • Strong knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance requirements, such as HIPAA, Medicare, and Medicaid.

  • Strong understanding of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), scheduling, and practice metrics.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders.

  • Project management certification (PMP or equivalent) is a plus, demonstrating a commitment to professional development and industry best practices.

Work Location:

Remote: Colorado (Denver preferred), Delaware, Florida, Illinois, Michigan, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Texas.

Additional Information:

Full time base salary range of $100,000 to $110,000. This role will have medical, dental, and vision benefits along with a matching 401K. Travel up to 15%.

title: Quality Specialist
description:
Benefits:
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • 401(k)
  • Employee discounts
Overview
ACCRETECH SBS, Inc., is a world leader in Automatic Balancing and process control solutions for grinding machines. The company designs, manufactures and markets the SBS system: a simple and reliable solution for in-process dynamic balancing of precision grinding machines.

Position Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and adaptable Quality Specialist to support quality assurance activities in our manufacturing operations. Operating from our Portland headquarters, this position plays an important role in maintaining quality records, supporting our ISO 9001 Quality Management System, performing product inspections, and coordinating nonconforming material and return processes. The ideal candidate is a quick learner with strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with colleagues across departments and international locations. Previous manufacturing or quality assurance experience is beneficial but not required; we value intellectual curiosity, initiative, sound judgment, and the ability to learn new technical concepts and systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Management System (QMS)
  • Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of the company's ISO 9001 Quality Management System
  • Maintain accurate quality records, procedures, and related documentation.
  • Assist with internal audits, corrective actions, and follow-up activities.
  • Record internally identified quality issues and improvement opportunities.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve quality processes and operational efficiency.
2. Quality Inspection and Verification
  • Perform visual and dimensional inspections of parts, materials, and finished products according to established procedures.
  • Verify product dimensions, specifications, and assembly completeness using technical drawings, part lists, and reference samples.
  • Use precision measuring equipment, including Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM), as trained and assigned.
  • Identify, document, and appropriately segregate nonconforming materials.
  • Perform applicable product and functional inspections following established procedures.
  • Maintain accurate inspection and testing records.
  • Interpret inspection results against established specifications and acceptance criteria.
3. Nonconforming Materials and Returns Management
  • Maintain accurate records of defective materials and nonconformances through the DMR process.
  • Support Return Material Authorization (RMA) activities involving customers and international affiliates.
  • Review return and exchange requests for completeness and request additional information when needed.
  • Enter, maintain, and update DMR, RMA, and related quality information in the company's core system.
  • Participate in return and exchange review meetings and document decisions and follow-up actions.
4. Quality Data and Inventory Coordination
  • Maintain accurate quality-related data in the company's core system.
  • Prepare and update quality assurance KPIs and supporting reports for regular management review.
  • Work with Inventory, Manufacturing, and Purchasing departments to ensure accurate tracking of materials undergoing inspection or quality verification.
  • Maintain the identification, status, and physical organization of materials in designated quality control areas.
  • Assist in resolving discrepancies in inspection records, inventory information, and related system data.
5. Communication and Continuous Improvement
  • Coordinate with colleagues across Quality, Manufacturing, Inventory, Purchasing, and Administration.
  • Communicate effectively with international colleagues, including those whose first language is not English.
  • Assist in investigating quality-related issues and implementing practical improvements.
  • Support clear documentation and communication of process changes.
  • Develop an understanding of the company's products, manufacturing processes, and quality requirements.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.
REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new technical concepts, procedures, and software systems.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including formulas, data organization, and basic charts.
  • Comfortable using business software, email, shared files, and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to work in a manufacturing environment and learn quality inspection procedures.
  • Professional, cooperative, adaptable, and service-oriented attitude.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience in quality assurance, manufacturing, inspection, or related business operations.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or other quality management systems.
  • Experience with precision measurement tools or Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM).
  • Ability to read technical drawings and understand dimensional specifications.
  • Intermediate or advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Japanese language proficiency, particularly for communication with Japanese-speaking colleagues.
  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
Physical Demands and Work Environment
The physical demands here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers; handle or feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

Note
This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. To perform this job successfully, the incumbents will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. Do you enjoy working end-to-end on modern IT solutions and collaborating closely with customers? Then this role is for you!

We are looking for a (Senior) Fullstack Developer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting. Tieto Tech Consulting is the leading digital accelerator for innovation and sustainable value creation. We combine business design with software engineering to bring digital business to life.

With a team of around 280 highly qualified employees at our locations in Vienna, Graz, and Linz and a global team of 8,000 colleagues, we are constantly striving to develop and grow. Our customers trust in our solutions, which is why we are continuously looking for new talents.

As a (Senior) Fullstack Developer, you will take ownership of technical solutions from concept to production, actively contributing to architecture, technology choices, and implementation quality. You will work closely with customers and interdisciplinary teams, contribute to technical decision-making, and ensure high-quality delivery across both frontend and backend.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a (Senior) Fullstack Developer, you

  • Design, develop, and implement high-quality fullstack solutions for customer projects
  • Work directly with customers to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Develop scalable backend services and modern frontend applications
  • Ensure high standards for code quality, security, performance, and maintainability

  • Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of cloud-native web solutions on hyperscaler platforms (e.g. Azure), including architecture decisions and best practices
  • Continuously evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and practices

Who we are looking for

  • 4+ years of experience as Fullstack Developer
  • Strong proficiency both in frontend (React and/or Angular) and backend technologies (Java and/or C#)
  • Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices as well as with databases and cloud services
  • Experience in the use of AI-assisted development tools and methodologies (e.g., GitHub Copilot, coding agents / agentic coding) to enhance development productivity and code quality, as well as to support documentation, testing, and problem-solving activities
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployment workflows
  • Strong communication skills and a customer-oriented mindset
  • A curious mindset and willingness to learn and share knowledge
  • Very good German and English skills

As a person, we believe you are a team player who takes action and demonstrates responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. With our agile end-to-end development process, you will continue to both learn from, and coach your colleagues, so communication is important for us. Technology is developing fast, so learning new innovative technologies is something you strive to do.

We offer

  • We offer you professional growth, meaningful projects, open culture, and an outstanding work-life balance!
  • We offer you an opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast-developing, and important sector.
  • We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful.

  • Additionally, we offer benefits like laptop and smartphone also for private use, health programs, team events, excellent public transport connection, food vouchers, contribution to the costs of the Austrian "Klimaticket”, fresh fruits, the perfect environment to prosper professionally, and a lot more.
  • Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.

The annual gross salary for this position will start from € 55.000,00 on a full-time basis, depending on your qualifications and experience.
