Job Description & Summary

Change Manager – PwC | Tech Hub

This role is being offered as a 12-month Fixed term Employment

You’ll help Australian businesses create value and improve the way they work. Tech Hub enables our company’s businesses to achieve their technology-driven goals. The work undertaken at Tech Hub covers a range of areas from leading and supporting the company through to the building or adoption of new technology, to protecting against risk, and delivering valuable data insights that transform our technology capabilities.

Change Management focuses on supporting all kinds of Digital Change initiatives to minimize disruption, reduce the risk of data and cyber breaches and ensure smooth transitions. As a Change Manager you will lead and coordinate change management activities across change initiatives.

You will translate change strategies into practical plans, assess impacts and risks, engage stakeholders, and support effective implementation. You will provide directions to Change Analysts and collaborate with business and technology teams to deliver measurable outcomes and maintain service quality.

Why PwC?


At PwC Australia, your skills meet purpose. We tackle big challenges across industries like finance, technology, energy, and health—giving you the chance to make a real impact. Here, your growth is our priority. You’ll work with leading teams, explore new technologies, and unlock your full potential.

Join a global community of more than 370,000 people who value bold ideas, collaboration, and lasting change. Together, we’re building trust and shaping the future.


What you’ll do:

  • Partner with Business Units and leaders to design and implement technology enabled change, including identifying benefits and measures of success and supporting associated tracking.
  • Shape and deliver change activities within technology programs and aligned with existing change approaches and frameworks.
  • Assess and manage change impacts and risks, develop practical mitigation actions, and support smooth implementation with minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Establish and manage key stakeholder relationships to drive engagement, manage expectations and build business support for change.
  • Guide and provide daily direction to Change Analysts and other team members, supporting capability development and quality delivery.
  • Contribute to the development of the Change & Upskilling Portfolio, including approaches, tools and ways of working.
  • Lead medium-scale change projects and contribute directly to large programs, using sound judgement within overarching guardrails.
  • Build strong sponsorship for change and develop communications for distribution through appropriate firmwide channels.

What we’re looking for:

  • Experienced in team leadership and management, including responsibility for team members to deliver results.
  • Strong understanding of change management frameworks (e.g., ADKAR).
  • Demonstrated knowledge of risk assessments and mitigation.
  • Proficiency in change management tools.
  • Strong knowledge of communication and learning strategies.
  • Ability to form effective business relationships and successfully manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Strong experience delivering technology-enabled change, using specialized change management expertise to provide advice, influence others and contribute directly to solutions.
  • Ability to solve complex work problems by applying overarching guardrails, experience and strong judgement.
  • Ability to consider broader direction and form annual priorities for own work and the team.
  • Ability to be actively involved in large projects and lead medium-scale projects. Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex and challenging environments and influence senior stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize and balance competing demands across multiple initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of delivery excellence and high-performing project teams, with the ability to uplift team standards and outcomes.
  • Strong financial acumen, including experience managing project budgets and balancing investment against delivery priorities
  • undefined

What you’ll gain:

  • The opportunity to work with leading organisations and cutting-edge technology that challenge and expand your expertise.
  • Flexibility means trusting you to choose when, where, and how you work—balancing what’s best for you, your team, and your clients to grow and thrive together.
  • Clear paths for career progression supported by continuous learning and leadership development.
  • Generous leave entitlements to support your work-life balance - including floating public holidays, birthday leave and ability to purchase additional leave on top of your four weeks.

We know that perks are as important as your financial rewards. Explore all the benefits that PwC has to offer here.

title: Multi Solution Architect
description:
The Opportunity

As a Multi-Solution Architect, you will be the senior technical authority across our Adobe Experience Cloud engagements, setting architecture direction and delivery standards across all Adobe projects, not just one. You will advise enterprise clients in banking, telco, airlines, hospitality, and retail on designing, delivering, and adopting MarTech solutions across Adobe Experience Platform, Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, Campaign, Experience Manager, Analytics, and Target.

You will also lead how AI is used in delivery, using generative assistants and agentic workflows to accelerate design, documentation, and enablement, and building AI-driven decisioning into the solutions we deliver.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide technical leadership across multiple concurrent Adobe projects, ensuring architectural consistency, quality, and on-time delivery.

  • Run architecture governance, including design reviews, solution assurance, risk assessments, and go-live readiness checks.

  • Step into at-risk engagements to stabilize and recover delivery, targeting zero-escalation go-lives.

  • Own end-to-end architecture for complex programs spanning CDP, journey orchestration, campaign, content, analytics, and personalization.

  • Translate industry marketing strategy into data models, identity and segmentation strategies, decisioning frameworks, and personalization use cases clients can operationalize.

  • Embed AI tools (co-pilots, LLM assistants, prompt-driven automation) across the delivery lifecycle, and design agentic solutions such as intelligent monitoring, anomaly detection, and next-best-action decisioning.

  • Guide clients on responsible AI adoption, including governance, privacy, and consent.

  • Lead workshops and hands-on enablement so client teams can extend, operate, and get lasting value from what we build.

  • Act as a trusted advisor from technical leads to C-suite, surfacing risks early and steering through ambiguity.

  • Mentor architects and consultants, contribute to pre-sales and RFP solutioning, and build reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and AI-enabled playbooks.

  • Identify opportunities to deepen Adobe adoption and expand client engagements.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 15+ years of hands-on consulting experience delivering enterprise SaaS or MarTech solutions, with deep expertise across the Adobe Experience Cloud stack.

  • Proven technical leadership across multiple concurrent programs, including architecture governance and delivery recovery.

  • Track record of owning enterprise-scale architecture end-to-end and resolving ambiguous requirements and cross-team trade-offs.

  • Deep marketing domain expertise in at least one vertical: banking, telecommunications, airlines, hospitality, or retail.

  • Hands-on experience applying AI-powered tools to accelerate delivery, and working knowledge of machine learning and agentic AI concepts.

  • Experience mentoring architects and contributing to pre-sales or RFP solutioning.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, and communication skills, with the presence to guide executives and engineers alike.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; a Master’s in Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field is a plus.

  • Travel up to 50%.

Bonus Experience

  • Designing agentic AI or autonomous monitoring solutions for MarTech environments.

  • Advanced use of AI coding assistants, prompt engineering, or LLM-driven workflow automation.

  • Experience with data pipelines, event streaming (Kafka, Kinesis), or ETL/ELT tools.

  • Adobe certifications (e.g., AEP, AJO, Real-Time CDP).

title: Technical Advertiser Solutions Consultant II
description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.


The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

Working from either our New York or LA office, you’ll collaborate with our Sales teams to drive revenue and performance for advertisers on Snap.


What you’ll do:

title: Fashion Design & Production Internship (m/f/d)
description:
Fashion Design & Production Internship (m/f/d)

Help create #DAMUR AW27/SS28—from first sketch to fitting, sample and runway.

Berlin · Primarily on-site · 3–6 months · Mandatory study internship

About the Role

#DAMUR is a Berlin-based high-end fashion label connecting gender-neutral fashion with music, nightlife, performance and contemporary culture.

You will support the complete AW27 collection-development process: approximately 30% creative development and 70% practical sampling, fittings, technical development and production organisation. This is not a styling or observation internship.

A Professional Working Internship

This is a professional working internship—not a fashion-school class, observation placement or beginner sewing course.

We provide clear briefs, professional context, technical feedback and access to a real runway collection. In return, you must already be able to sew confidently, understand garment construction and contribute to practical collection-development work. We do not teach basic sewing or garment construction from the beginning.

You do not need to know every technique on your first day, but you must be precise, resourceful and prepared for hands-on work. You should be able to complete defined tasks, apply fit corrections and maintain organised technical information without waiting for every step to be taught or repeatedly explained.

What You’ll Do

  • Research silhouettes, materials, trims and construction techniques
  • Support sketches, technical flats and collection-development boards
  • Source and organise fabrics, trims, labels and sample materials
  • Draft or adjust patterns and help make toiles, samples and alterations
  • Prepare fittings, record measurements and update fit corrections
  • Create and update tech packs
  • Track samples, deadlines, sample makers and suppliers
  • Complete assigned sewing, alteration and preparation tasks on time
  • Keep materials, patterns, samples and technical information organised

You’re a Strong Fit If

  • You study fashion design, garment technology, pattern cutting or a related subject
  • You sew confidently and understand garment construction
  • You have practical pattern-cutting and fitting skills and can create technical flats
  • You understand measurements, tech packs and production terminology
  • You can complete defined technical tasks without step-by-step supervision
  • You work precisely, follow corrections and communicate early when blocked
  • You are comfortable with practical, repetitive and deadline-driven work
  • You care about construction quality and fit—not only the initial design idea
  • CLO3D, Gerber, Lectra, tailoring, upcycling, German, Polish or Mandarin skills are a plus

What You’ll Gain

  • Real responsibility within the development of an AW27 runway collection
  • Hands-on experience across design, sampling, fittings and production
  • Experience working with patterns, technical information, samples and deadlines
  • Direct professional feedback on construction, fit, precision and work quality
  • Portfolio-relevant work, subject to confidentiality

Practical Information

  • Location:Berlin, primarily on-site
  • Start: As soon as possible; the exact date is agreed with the selected candidate
  • Duration: 3–6 months
  • Eligibility: This must be a mandatory internship required by your university or a recognised study programme. Erasmus+ placements are welcome when they meet this condition
  • You must already have the right to complete an internship in Germany; we cannot provide employer visa sponsorship
  • Transport support: Your Berlin AB ticket or Deutschlandticket is fully covered
  • Studio benefits: Daily warm homemade lunch, La Marzocco espresso, snacks and drinks
  • Schedule: Occasional evening or weekend work may be needed for events; this will always be agreed in advance

How to Apply

Apply in English through FashionUnited by clicking "Apply.”

Upload your CV in PDF format and a selected 6–12-page portfolio in PDF format. Include clear examples of your sewing, pattern-cutting, toile or garment-construction work.

In the Motivation field, answer the following in a maximum of 300 words:

  1. Which practical skills can you already perform confidently: sewing, pattern cutting, toile making, alterations, fitting preparation or creating tech packs?
  2. Which technical skill is currently your weakest, and what are you doing to improve it?
  3. State your earliest possible start date, how long you can stay (3–6 months), and confirm that this is a mandatory study internship.

No formal cover letter is required. We want to understand which practical skills you can already contribute and where you still need to improve. Please answer all three questions directly.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. title: Solution Architect (AWS / AI)
description:
Specialization: Cloud-Native & AI

Platform focus: AWS Deep

Location: Remote (US), with travel to client sites as needed

CapNexus is an AWS consulting partner specializing in AI and cloud engineering. We build and deliver software through agentic engineering: we build and operate the systems that produce code, direct AI tooling to accelerate delivery, and exercise the judgment that keeps AI-generated work correct. Everyone at CapNexus works fluently inside our delivery system, which combines agentic tooling, spec-driven development, evidence-based quality, and AI-augmented delivery governance.

Who You Are and What You'll Do:

CapNexus is looking for a Solutions Architect to translate client problems into technical solutions and own the architecture the engineering team builds against.

In this role, you'll focus on cloud-native applications with AI built in: serverless and container services, APIs, front ends, and the generative and agentic AI features inside them.

Your time splits evenly. About half is billable client delivery as the architect on an engagement. The other half is pre-sales, where you scope the opportunity and design the solution before the work is sold.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead solution design for an engagement: architecture, technology choices, integration, security, and cost.
  • Author the technical specifications the engineering team validates and builds from.
  • Translate business requirements into designs and roadmaps, and explain trade-offs in business terms.
  • Partner with the Lead Engineer as a peer: you decide the architecture, and they decide the implementation approach.
  • Support pursuits with solution design, estimates, and technical credibility.
  • Mentor engineers on design patterns and architectural thinking.
  • Design cloud-native application architectures on AWS (serverless, event-driven, and container-based) with generative and agentic AI features built in, including retrieval, agents, evaluation, and guardrails.
  • Design end-to-end AWS architectures across compute, data, networking, security, and AI services, and review them against the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
  • Lead discovery with client stakeholders and scope the systems involved: current state, requirements, constraints, integrations, and risks.
  • Produce the architecture and design documents an engagement is built from: solution architecture documents, architecture decision records, non-functional requirements, and diagrams.
  • Turn a scoped design into effort estimates and the technical content of proposals and statements of work.
  • Lead technical presentations, demos, and proof-of-concept builds that show clients how the solution works.
  • Partner with the Client Leader on pursuits. You own the solution and the estimate; pricing and contract terms are handled separately.

How You'll Work: Agentic Engineering:

You translate client problems into technical solutions and own the architecture the team builds against.

  • Solution design through agentic delivery. Design solutions that assume agentic engineering as the delivery model: account for what AI tooling accelerates, what it can't do, and where human judgment gates belong.
  • Delivery-approach design. Specify the delivery tooling for the engagement: the agent roles, conversion tools, templates, and validation gates the team builds through.
  • Agentic tooling fluency. Use Claude Code and Kiro to prototype architecture decisions, generate reference implementations, and test design assumptions before committing the team.
  • AI integration judgment. Decide where AI fits in the solution, and where it doesn't, and own the integration, data, security, and cost implications.
  • Quality standard ownership. Define the architecture quality bar the team builds against. The Lead Engineer executes to your standard; you own the standard.

What doesn't change at any level: judgment over correctness, the ability to tell when confident, plausible-looking AI output is quietly wrong. Tooling does the mechanical work; you're accountable for whether it's right.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of software, infrastructure, or data experience, including significant solution architecture work.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across application, data, infrastructure, and security.
  • Strong client communication: you can run an architecture review with executives and engineers in the same room.
  • Hands-on experience prototyping or testing designs with AI development tools such as Claude Code or Kiro, and a clear view of what AI tooling can and can't be trusted with in a production architecture.
  • A hands-on background building full-stack, cloud-native applications with AI features (for example, React or Angular front ends, Python or TypeScript services, and Amazon Bedrock) before moving into architecture.
  • 5+ years designing production architectures on AWS, with a working understanding of cost, scaling, security, and failure modes.
  • A current AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional certification.
  • Strong written and verbal communication: clear design documents, proposals, and executive presentations.
  • Solid business acumen: you connect architecture choices to cost, risk, time to value, and the client's business case.
  • Proven experience scoping systems and producing architectures and design documents that teams build from.
  • Pre-sales or consulting experience: discovery workshops, solution proposals, estimates, and demos.

Nice to Have:

  • AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01).
  • AWS Certified Security – Specialty.
  • Experience engaging AWS Professional Services during scoping.
  • Background in retail.

Our Culture:

Four keystones guide how we work:

  • Customer obsessed, delivery focused. We deliver what we promise. Trust = consistency × time.
  • Learning and sharing. We hire lifetime learners, and teaching others matters as much as knowing.
  • Growth and scalability. We value cross-functional skills over role boundaries, and simple solutions over clever ones.
  • All work is strategic. Every engagement, big or small, is a chance to earn trust that lasts.

We offer:

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits: Medical, dental, 401(k), and more

CapNexus is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees. Experience comes in many forms, and we’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align with what we have listed. We look forward to hearing from you.

No Agencies Please!
